Mustahiq-e-Tareef Quran-e-Majeed hum pehle bayan kar chuke hain ke Allah har amr ke shuru aur us ke khatmay par apni tareef-o-hamd karta hai, har haal mein woh qabil-e-hamd aur laiq-e-sana aur sazawar-e-tareef hai. Awwal-o-aakhir mustahiq-e-hamd faqat usi ki zaat-e-wala sifaat hai. Hum ne apne Nabi-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par Quran-e-Kareem nazil farmaya jo is kitab ko theek-thaak aur seedha aur raast rakha hai jis mein koi kaji, koi kasar, koi kami nahin. Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki rehbar, wazeh, jali, saaf aur wazeh hai. Badkaron ko daranay wali, nek karon ko khushkhabriyan sunanay wali, motadil, seedhi, mukhalifon, munkiron ko khaufnak azabon ki khabar denay wali yeh kitab hai. Jo azab Allah ki taraf ke hain duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi, aisay azab ke na us ke se azab kisi ke, na us ki si pakar kisi ki. Haan jo is par yaqeen kare, iman laye, nek amal kare usay yeh kitab ajr-e-azeem ki khushi sunati hai. Jis sawab ko paindagi aur dawam hai, woh jannat unhein milegi jis mein kabhi fana nahin, jis ki na'matein ghair-e-fani hain. Aur unhein bhi yeh azabon se aagah karta hai jo Allah ki aulad thehratay hain, jaise mushrikeen-e-Makkah ke woh farishton ko Allah ki betiyan batatay thay. Mushrikeen ke sawalat be-ilmi aur jahalat ke sath munh se bol partay hain, yeh to yeh un ke baray bhi aisi baatein be-ilmi se kehte rahe. Kalimat ka nasb tameez ki bina par hai, taqdeer-e-ibarat is tarah hai: Kaburat Kalimatuhum Hazih Kalimah. Aur kaha gaya hai ke yeh ta'ajjub ke tor par hai. Taqdeer-e-ibarat yeh hai: A'zam bi-kalimatihim kalimah, jaise kaha jata hai: Akrim bi-Zaidin rajula. Ba'az basriyon ka yahi qaul hai. Makkah ke ba'az qariyon ne isay Kalimatan parha, jaise kaha jata hai: A'zam qauluka wa kabura shanuka. Jamhoor ki qira'at par to ma'ani bilkul zahir hain ke un ke is kalmay ki burai aur us ka nihayat hi bura hona bayan ho raha hai, jo mehez be-daleel hai, sirf kazb-o-iftira hai. Isi liye farmaya ke mehez jhoot baktay hain. Is surat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh bayan ho gaya hai ke qurayshiyon ne Nadr bin Haris aur Uqbah bin Abu Mu'ait ko Madinay ke yahoodi ulama ke paas bheja ke tum ja kar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat kul halaat un se bayan karo, un ke paas aglay ambiya ka ilm hai, un se poocho un ki babat kya raye hai? Yeh dono Madinay gaye, ahbar-e-Madina se milay, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke halaat-o-ausaf bayan kiye, aap ki ta'leem ka zikr kiya aur kaha ke tum zi-ilm ho, batao un ki nisbat kya khayal hai? Unhon ne kaha dekho hum tumhein ek faisla-kun baat batatay hain, tum ja kar un se teen sawalat karo, agar jawab de dein to un ke sachay honay mein kuch shak nahin, beshak woh Allah ke Nabi aur Rasool hain aur agar jawab na de sakein to aap ke jhoota honay mein bhi koi shak nahin, phir jo tum chaho karo. Un se poocho aglay zamanay mein jo naujawan chalay gaye thay un ka waqia bayan karo, woh ek ajeeb waqia hai. Aur us shakhs ke halaat daryaft karo jis ne tamam zameen ka gasht lagaya tha, mashriq-o-maghrib ho aaya tha. Aur rooh ki mahiyat daryaft karo, agar bata de to usay Nabi maan kar us ki itteba karo aur agar na bata sakay to woh shakhs jhoota hai, jo chaho karo.

Yeh dono wahan se wapas aaye aur Quraishiyon se kaha lo bhai aakhri aur intehai faislay ki baat unhon ne bata di hai. Ab chalo Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawalat karein, chunancha yeh sab aap ke paas aaye aur teenon sawalat kiye. Aap ne farmaya tum kal aao main tumhein jawab doon lekin Insha'Allah kehna bhool gaye. Pandrah din guzar gaye na aap par wahi aayi na Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se un baaton ka jawab maloom karaya gaya. Ahl-e-Makkah josh mein aa gaye aur kehne lage ke lijiye sahib kal ka wada tha aaj pandrahwan din hai lekin woh bata nahin sake. Idhar aap ko dohra gham satane laga, Quraishiyon ko jawab na milne par un ki baatein sunne ka aur wahi ke band ho janay ka. Phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye, Surah Kahf nazil hui, isi mein Insha'Allah na kehne par aap ko danta gaya, un naujawanon ka qissa bayan kiya gaya aur us sayyah ka zikr kiya gaya aur aayat (وَيَسْــــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الرُّوْحِ ۭ قُلِ الرُّوْحُ مِنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّيْ وَمَآ اُوْتِيْتُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا 85؀) (17-Al-Isra: 85) mein rooh ki babat jawab diya gaya.

Aur unhein bhi yeh azabon se aagah karta hai jo Allah ki aulad thehratay hain, jaise mushrikeen-e-Makkah ke woh farishton ko Allah ki betiyan batatay thay. Mushrikeen ke sawalat be-ilmi aur jahalat ke sath munh se bol partay hain, yeh to yeh un ke baray bhi aisi baatein be-ilmi se kehte rahe. Kalimat ka nasb tameez ki bina par hai, taqdeer-e-ibarat is tarah hai: Kaburat Kalimatuhum Hazih Kalimah. Aur kaha gaya hai ke yeh ta'ajjub ke tor par hai. Taqdeer-e-ibarat yeh hai: A'zam bi-kalimatihim kalimah, jaise kaha jata hai: Akrim bi-Zaidin rajula. Ba'az basriyon ka yahi qaul hai. Makkah ke ba'az qariyon ne isay Kalimatan parha, jaise kaha jata hai: A'zam qauluka wa kabura shanuka. Jamhoor ki qira'at par to ma'ani bilkul zahir hain ke un ke is kalmay ki burai aur us ka nihayat hi bura hona bayan ho raha hai, jo mehez be-daleel hai, sirf kazb-o-iftira hai. Isi liye farmaya ke mehez jhoot baktay hain. Is surat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh bayan ho gaya hai ke qurayshiyon ne Nadr bin Haris aur Uqbah bin Abu Mu'ait ko Madinay ke yahoodi ulama ke paas bheja ke tum ja kar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat kul halaat un se bayan karo, un ke paas aglay ambiya ka ilm hai, un se poocho un ki babat kya raye hai? Yeh dono Madinay gaye, ahbar-e-Madina se milay, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke halaat-o-ausaf bayan kiye, aap ki ta'leem ka zikr kiya aur kaha ke tum zi-ilm ho, batao un ki nisbat kya khayal hai? Unhon ne kaha dekho hum tumhein ek faisla-kun baat batatay hain, tum ja kar un se teen sawalat karo, agar jawab de dein to un ke sachay honay mein kuch shak nahin, beshak woh Allah ke Nabi aur Rasool hain aur agar jawab na de sakein to aap ke jhoota honay mein bhi koi shak nahin, phir jo tum chaho karo. Un se poocho aglay zamanay mein jo naujawan chalay gaye thay un ka waqia bayan karo, woh ek ajeeb waqia hai. Aur us shakhs ke halaat daryaft karo jis ne tamam zameen ka gasht lagaya tha, mashriq-o-maghrib ho aaya tha. Aur rooh ki mahiyat daryaft karo, agar bata de to usay Nabi maan kar us ki itteba karo aur agar na bata sakay to woh shakhs jhoota hai, jo chaho karo.

Yeh dono wahan se wapas aaye aur Quraishiyon se kaha lo bhai aakhri aur intehai faislay ki baat unhon ne bata di hai. Ab chalo Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawalat karein, chunancha yeh sab aap ke paas aaye aur teenon sawalat kiye. Aap ne farmaya tum kal aao main tumhein jawab doon lekin Insha'Allah kehna bhool gaye. Pandrah din guzar gaye na aap par wahi aayi na Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se un baaton ka jawab maloom karaya gaya. Ahl-e-Makkah josh mein aa gaye aur kehne lage ke lijiye sahib kal ka wada tha aaj pandrahwan din hai lekin woh bata nahin sake. Idhar aap ko dohra gham satane laga, Quraishiyon ko jawab na milne par un ki baatein sunne ka aur wahi ke band ho janay ka. Phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye, Surah Kahf nazil hui, isi mein Insha'Allah na kehne par aap ko danta gaya, un naujawanon ka qissa bayan kiya gaya aur us sayyah ka zikr kiya gaya aur aayat (وَيَسْــــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الرُّوْحِ ۭ قُلِ الرُّوْحُ مِنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّيْ وَمَآ اُوْتِيْتُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا 85؀) (17-Al-Isra: 85) mein rooh ki babat jawab diya gaya.

Mushrikeen ki gumrahi par afsos na karo. Mushrikeen jo aap se door bhagte thay, iman na late thay us par jo ranj-o-afsos aap ko hota tha us par Allah Ta'ala aap ki tasalli kar raha hai jaise aur ayat mein hai ke un par itna ranj na karo, aur jagah hai un par itne ghamgeen na ho, aur jagah hai un ke iman na lane se apne aap ko halak na kar, yahan bhi yahi farmaya hai ke yeh is Quran par iman na layein to tu apni jaan ko rog na laga le is qadar gham-o-ghussa ranj-o-afsos na kar na ghabra na dil tang ho apna kaam kiye ja. Tabligh mein kotahi na kar. Rah-yafta apna bhala karenge. Gumrah apna bura karenge. Har ek ka amal us ke sath hai. Phir farmata hai duniya fani hai is ki zeenat zawal wali hai akhirat baqi hai is ki nemat dawami hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain duniya meethi aur sabz rang hai Allah Ta'ala is mein tumhein khalifa bana kar dekhna chahta hai ke tum kaise aamal karte ho? Pas duniya se aur aurton se bacho Bani Israel mein sab se pehla fitna aurton ka hi tha. Yeh duniya khatam hone wali aur kharab hone wali hai ujadne wali aur gharat hone wali hai zameen hamwar saaf reh jayegi jis par kisi qisam ki rooyidagi bhi na hogi. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ke kya log dekhte nahin ke hum ghair abad banjar zameen ki taraf pani ko le chalte hain aur is mein se kheti paida karte hain jise woh khud khate hain aur un ke chopaye bhi. Kya phir bhi un ki aankhein nahin khultin zameen aur zameen par jo hain sab fana hone wale aur apne malik-e-haqiqi ke samne pesh hone wale hain pas tu kuch bhi un se sune unhein kaise hi haal mein dekhe mutlaq afsos aur ranj na kar.

Ashab-e-Kahf ka qissa ijmali taur par bayan ho raha hai, phir tafseel ke sath bayan hoga. Farmata hai ke woh waqia hamari qudrat ke beshumar waqiat mein se ek nihayat mamooli waqia hai. Is se bade bade nishan roz-marra tumhare samne hain, aasman zameen ki paidaish, raat din ka aana jana, suraj chand ki itaat-guzari wagaira qudrat ki anginat nishaniyan hain jo batla rahi hain ke Allah ki qudrat be-andaz hai, woh har cheez par qadir hai, us par koi mushkil nahin. Ashab-e-Kahf se toh kahin zyada ta'ajjub-khez aur ahem nishan-e-qudrat tumhare samne din raat maujood hain. Kitab-o-Sunnat ka jo ilm maine tujhe ata farmaya hai woh Ashab-e-Kahf ki shaan se kahin zyada hai. Bahut si hujatein maine apne bandon par Ashab-e-Kahf se zyada wazeh kar di hain. Kahf kehte hain pahadi ghaar ko, wahin yeh naujawan chup gaye thay. Raqeem ya toh Aila ke paas ki wadi ka naam hai ya un ki is jagah ki imarat ka naam hai, yeh kisi abadi ka naam hai ya us pahad ka naam hai. Is pahad ka naam Najloos bhi aaya hai, ghaar ka naam Haizoom kaha gaya hai aur un ke kutte ka naam Humran bataya gaya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, saare Quran ko main jaanta hoon lekin lafz 'Hannan' aur lafz 'Awwah' aur lafz 'Raqeem' ko. Mujhe nahin maloom ke Raqeem kisi kitab ka naam hai ya kisi bina ka. Aur riwayat mein aap se marwi hai ke woh kitab hai. Saeed kehte hain ke yeh patthar ki ek loh thi jis par Ashab-e-Kahf ka qissa likh kar ghaar ke darwaze par use laga diya gaya tha. Abdur Rahman kehte hain Quran mein hai 'Kitab-e-Marqoom', pas aayat ke zahiri alfaaz toh is ki tayeed karte hain aur yahi Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ka mukhtar qaul hai ke Raqeem 'Fa'eel' ke wazan par 'Marqoom' ke ma'ani mein hai, jaise 'Maqtool' 'Qateel' aur 'Majrooh' 'Jareeh'. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh naujawan apne deen ke bachao ke liye apni qaum se bhaag khade hue thay ke kahin woh unhein deen se behka na dein, ek pahad ke ghaar mein ghus gaye aur Allah se dua ki ke, "Aye Allah! Hamein apni janib se rahmat ata farma, hamein apni qaum se chupaye rakh, hamare is kaam mein achhai ka anjam kar." Hadees ki ek dua mein hai ke, "Aye Allah! Jo faisla tu hamare haq mein kare use anjam ke lihaz se bhala kar." Musnad mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni dua mein arz karte ke, "Aye Allah! Hamare tamam kaamon ka anjam achha kar aur hamein duniya ki ruswai aur aakhirat ke azabon se bacha le." Yeh ghaar mein ja kar jo pad kar soye toh barson guzar gaye, phir hum ne unhein bedaar kiya. Ek sahib dirham le kar bazaar se sauda khareedne chale? Use hum bhi maloom karein. 'Amad' ke ma'ani adad ya ginti ke hain aur kaha gaya hai ke ghayat ke ma'ani mein bhi yeh lafz aaya hai, jaise ke Arab ke shairon ne apne shairon mein ise ghayat ke ma'ani mein bandha hai.

Halankeh yeh bayan guzar chuka hai Quraishiyon ne apna wafd Madine ke Yahood ke ulama ke paas bheja tha ke tum hamein kuch batlao ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki aazmaish kar lein toh unhon ne kaha ke tum Ashab-e-Kahf ka aur Zulqarnain ka waqea aap se daryaft karo aur Rooh ke talluq sawal karo. Pas maloom hota hai ke Yahood ki kitab mein inka zikr tha aur unhein is waqea ka ilm tha, jab yeh sabit hua toh yeh zahir hai ke Yahood ki kitab Nasraniyat se pehle ki hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai ke hum ne unhein qoum ki mukhalifat par sabr ata farmaya aur unhon ne qoum ki kuch parwah na ki balkeh watan aur rahat-o-aaram ki bhi taj diya. Baaz salaf ka bayan hai ke yeh log Roomi badshah ki aulad aur Room ke sardar thay. Ek martaba qoum ke sath eid manane gaye thay, us zamane ke badshah ka naam Daqyanus tha, bara sakht aur sarkash shakhs tha.

Sab ko shirk ki taleem karta aur sab se but-parasti karata tha. Yeh naujawan jo apne baap dadon ke sath is mele mein gaye the, unhon ne jab wahan yeh tamasha dekha toh un ke dil mein khayal aaya ke but-parasti mehez laghw aur batil cheez hai, ibadatein aur zabiha sirf Allah ke naam par hone chahiyein jo aasman-o-zameen ka khaliq-o-malik hai. Pas yeh log ek-ek kar ke yahan se rukne lage, ek darakht tale ja kar un mein se ek sahib baith gaye, dusre bhi yahin aa gaye aur baith gaye, teesre bhi aaye, chauthe bhi aaye, gharz ek-ek kar ke sab yahin jama ho gaye halankeh ek dusre mein ta'aruf na tha lekin imaan ki roshni ne ek dusre ko mila diya. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke roohein bhi ek jama shuda lashkar hain jo roz-e-azal mein ta'aruf wali hain, woh yahan mil-jul kar rehti hain aur jo wahin anjaan rahin un ka yahan bhi un mein ikhtilaf rehta hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Arab kaha karte the ke jinsiyat hi mel-jol ki illat hai. Ab sab khamosh the, ek ko ek se dar tha ke agar main apne ma-fi-zamir ko bata dunga toh yeh dushman ho jayenge, kisi ko dusre ki nisbat ittila na thi ke woh bhi is ki tarah qoum ki is ahmaqana aur mushrikana rasm se bezar hai. Aakhir ek dana aur jari naujawan ne kaha ke dosto! Koi na koi baat toh zaroor hai ke logon ke is aam shughal ko chhod kar tum un se yaksu ho kar yahan aa baithe ho, mera toh jee chahta hai ke har shakhs is baat ko zahir kar de jis ki wajah se us ne qoum ko chhoda hai. Is par ek ne kaha bhai baat yeh hai ke mujhe toh apni qoum ki yeh rasm ek aankh nahin bhati, jab ke aasman-o-zameen ka aur hamara tumhara khaliq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai toh phir hum us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat kyun karein? Yeh sun kar dusre ne kaha Allah ki qasam yahi nafrat mujhe yahan layi hai, teesre ne bhi yahi kaha. Jab har ek ne yahi wajah bayan ki toh sab ke dil mein mohabbat ki ek lehar daud gayi aur yeh sab roshan khayal muwahid aapas mein sache dost aur maa jaye bhaiyon se bhi zyada ek dusre ke khair-khwah ban gaye, aapas mein ittehad-o-ittefaq ho gaya. Yeh unhon ne ek jagah muqarrar kar li, wahin Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat karne lage. Rafta-rafta qoum ko bhi pata chal gaya, woh un sab ko pakad kar us zalim mushrik badshah aur ahl-e-darbar aur kul duniya ko us ki dawat di, dil mazboot kar liya aur saaf keh diya ke hamara Rabb wahi hai jo aasman-o-zameen ka malik-o-khaliq hai. Namumkin hai ke hum us ke siwa kisi aur ko ma'abood banayein, hum se yeh kabhi na ho sake ga ke us ke siwa kisi aur ko pukarein, is liye ke shirk nihayat batil cheez hai, hum is kaam ko kabhi nahin karne ke. Yeh nihayat hi beja baat aur laghw harkat aur jhooti raah hai. Kehte hain ke un ki is saaf goi aur haq goi se badshah bahut bigda, unhein dhamkaya, daraya aur hukum diya ke un ke libas utaar lo aur agar yeh baaz na aayenge toh main unhein sakht saza dunga.

Yahan hai hum ne unhein hidayat mein barha diya aur jagah hum aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَّاٰتٰىهُمْ تَقْوٰىهُمْ) (Surah Muhammad: 17) hidayat walon ko hidayat barh jati hai al-kh aur aayat mein hai (فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا فَزَادَتْھُمْ اِيْمَانًا وَّھُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ) (Surah At-Tawbah: 124) iman walon ke iman ko barhati hai al-kh aur jagah irshad hai aayat (هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ السَّكِيْنَةَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ لِيَزْدَادُوْٓا اِيْمَانًا مَّعَ اِيْمَانِهِمْ ۭ وَلِلّٰهِ جُنُوْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۭ وَكَان اللّٰهُ عَلِــيْمًا حَكِـيْمًا) (Surah Al-Fath: 4) taake woh apne iman ke sath hi iman mein aur barh jayen, isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain. Mazkoor hai ke yeh log Maseeh Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ke deen par thay, Wallahu A'lam. Lekin bazahir maloom hota hai ke yeh Maseeh (A.S) ke zamane se pehle ka waqea hai, iski ek daleel yeh bhi hai ke agar yeh log Nasrani hote toh Yahood is qadar tawajjo se na inke halaat maloom karte na maloom karne ki hidayat karte. Halankeh yeh bayan guzar chuka hai Quraishiyon ne apna wafd Madine ke Yahood ke ulama ke paas bheja tha ke tum hamein kuch batlao ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki aazmaish kar lein toh unhon ne kaha ke tum Ashab-e-Kahf ka aur Zulqarnain ka waqea aap se daryaft karo aur Rooh ke talluq sawal karo. Pas maloom hota hai ke Yahood ki kitab mein inka zikr tha aur unhein is waqea ka ilm tha, jab yeh sabit hua toh yeh zahir hai ke Yahood ki kitab Nasraniyat se pehle ki hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmata hai ke hum ne unhein qoum ki mukhalifat par sabr ata farmaya aur unhon ne qoum ki kuch parwah na ki balkeh watan aur rahat-o-aaram ki bhi taj diya. Baaz salaf ka bayan hai ke yeh log Roomi badshah ki aulad aur Room ke sardar thay. Ek martaba qoum ke sath eid manane gaye thay, us zamane ke badshah ka naam Daqyanus tha, bara sakht aur sarkash shakhs tha.

Sab ko shirk ki taleem karta aur sab se but-parasti karata tha. Yeh naujawan jo apne baap dadon ke sath is mele mein gaye the, unhon ne jab wahan yeh tamasha dekha toh un ke dil mein khayal aaya ke but-parasti mehez laghw aur batil cheez hai, ibadatein aur zabiha sirf Allah ke naam par hone chahiyein jo aasman-o-zameen ka khaliq-o-malik hai. Pas yeh log ek-ek kar ke yahan se rukne lage, ek darakht tale ja kar un mein se ek sahib baith gaye, dusre bhi yahin aa gaye aur baith gaye, teesre bhi aaye, chauthe bhi aaye, gharz ek-ek kar ke sab yahin jama ho gaye halankeh ek dusre mein ta'aruf na tha lekin imaan ki roshni ne ek dusre ko mila diya. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke roohein bhi ek jama shuda lashkar hain jo roz-e-azal mein ta'aruf wali hain, woh yahan mil-jul kar rehti hain aur jo wahin anjaan rahin un ka yahan bhi un mein ikhtilaf rehta hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Arab kaha karte the ke jinsiyat hi mel-jol ki illat hai. Ab sab khamosh the, ek ko ek se dar tha ke agar main apne ma-fi-zamir ko bata dunga toh yeh dushman ho jayenge, kisi ko dusre ki nisbat ittila na thi ke woh bhi is ki tarah qoum ki is ahmaqana aur mushrikana rasm se bezar hai. Aakhir ek dana aur jari naujawan ne kaha ke dosto! Koi na koi baat toh zaroor hai ke logon ke is aam shughal ko chhod kar tum un se yaksu ho kar yahan aa baithe ho, mera toh jee chahta hai ke har shakhs is baat ko zahir kar de jis ki wajah se us ne qoum ko chhoda hai. Is par ek ne kaha bhai baat yeh hai ke mujhe toh apni qoum ki yeh rasm ek aankh nahin bhati, jab ke aasman-o-zameen ka aur hamara tumhara khaliq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai toh phir hum us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat kyun karein? Yeh sun kar dusre ne kaha Allah ki qasam yahi nafrat mujhe yahan layi hai, teesre ne bhi yahi kaha. Jab har ek ne yahi wajah bayan ki toh sab ke dil mein mohabbat ki ek lehar daud gayi aur yeh sab roshan khayal muwahid aapas mein sache dost aur maa jaye bhaiyon se bhi zyada ek dusre ke khair-khwah ban gaye, aapas mein ittehad-o-ittefaq ho gaya. Yeh unhon ne ek jagah muqarrar kar li, wahin Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat karne lage. Rafta-rafta qoum ko bhi pata chal gaya, woh un sab ko pakad kar us zalim mushrik badshah aur ahl-e-darbar aur kul duniya ko us ki dawat di, dil mazboot kar liya aur saaf keh diya ke hamara Rabb wahi hai jo aasman-o-zameen ka malik-o-khaliq hai. Namumkin hai ke hum us ke siwa kisi aur ko ma'abood banayein, hum se yeh kabhi na ho sake ga ke us ke siwa kisi aur ko pukarein, is liye ke shirk nihayat batil cheez hai, hum is kaam ko kabhi nahin karne ke. Yeh nihayat hi beja baat aur laghw harkat aur jhooti raah hai. Yeh hamari qoum mushrik hai, Allah ke siwa dusron ki pukar aur un ki ibadat mein mashghool hai jis ki koi daleel yeh pesh nahin kar sakti, pas yeh zalim aur kazib hain. Kehte hain ke un ki is saaf goi aur haq goi se badshah bahut bigda, unhein dhamkaya, daraya aur hukum diya ke un ke libas utaar lo aur agar yeh baaz na aayenge toh main unhein sakht saza dunga.

Ab in logon ke dilon mein aur mazbooti aa gayi lekin yeh unhein maloom hogaya ke yahan reh kar hum deendari par qaim nahin reh sakte, is liye unhon ne qoum, watan, des aur rishte kunbay ko chhorne ka irada pukhta karliya. Yehi hukm bhi hai ke jab insaan deen ka khatra mehsoos kare us waqt hijrat kar jaye. Hadees mein hai ke insaan ka behtareen maal mumkin hai ke bakriyan hon jinhein le kar daman-e-koh mein aur marghzaron mein rahe sahe aur apne deen ke bachao ki khatir bhagta phire. Pas aise haal mein logon se alag thalag hojana amr-e-mashroo hai. Haan agar aisi halat na ho, deen ki barbadi ka khauf na ho to phir jangalon mein nikal jana mashroo nahin kyunke jumma jamaat ki fazeelat haath se jaati rehti hai. Jab yeh log deen ke bachao ke liye itni ahem qurbani par amada hogaye to un par Rabb ki rahmat nazil hui. Farmadiya gaya ke theek hai jab tum un ke deen se alag hogaye to behtar hai ke jismon se bhi un se juda ho jao. Jao tum kisi ghaar mein panah hasil karo, tum par tumhare Rabb ki rahmat ki chhaon hogi, woh tumhein tumhare dushman ki nigahon se chhupa lega aur tumhare kaam mein aasani aur rahat muhayya farmayega. Pas yeh log mauqa pa kar yahan se bhaag nikle aur pahar ke ghaar mein chhup rahe. Badshah aur qoum ne har chand un ki talash ki, lekin koi pata na chala, Allah ne un ke ghaar ko andhere mein chhupa diya. Dekhiye yehi balkay is se bohat zyada ta'ajjub khez waqia hamare Nabi Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ke sath pesh aaya. Aap ma'a apne rafeeq-e-khas yaar-e-ghaar Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke ghaar-e-Saur mein ja chhupe. Mushrikeen ne bohat kuch daur dhoop ki, tag-o-dau mein koi kami na ki, lekin Hazrat (ﷺ) unhein poori talash aur sakht koshish ke bawajood na mile, Allah ne un ki beenai chheen li, aas paas se guzarte the, aankhein phaad phaad kar dekhte the, Hazrat (ﷺ) agar kisi ne apne pair ki taraf bhi nazar daal li to hum dekh liye jayenge, Aap (ﷺ) ne itminan se jawab diya ke Abu Bakr! Un do ke sath tera kya khayal hai, jin ka teesra khud Allah Ta'ala hai. Quran farmata hai ke agar tum mere Nabi ki imdad na karo to kya hua? Jab kafiron ne use nikal diya, main ne khud is ki imdad ki jab ke woh do mein doosra tha, jab woh dono ghaar mein the, jab woh apne sathi se keh raha tha ke ghamgeen na ho Allah hamare sath hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apni taraf se sukoon us par nazil farmaya aur aise lashkar se us ki madad ki jise tum na dekh sakte the, aakhir us ne kafiron ki baat past kar di aur apna kalma buland farmaya. Allah izzat-o-hikmat wala hai. Sach to yeh hai ke yeh waqia Ashab-e-Kahf ke waqia se bhi ajeeb-tar aur anokha hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke in naujawanon ko qoum aur badshah ne pa liya, jab ghaar mein unhein dekh liya to bas kaha bas hum to khud hi chahte the, chunancha unhon ne us ka munh ek deewar se band kar diya ke yahin mar jayen, lekin yeh qaul ta'ammul talab hai, Quran ka farman hai ke subh-o-sham un par dhoop aati jaati hai waghera, Wallahu A'alam.

Ghaar aur suraj ki shua'ein yeh daleel hai is amr-e-ilahi ki ke is ghaar ka munh shumal rukh hai. Suraj ke tulu ke waqt un ke da'in janib dhoop ki chhaon jhuk jati hai pas dopahar ke waqt wahan bilkul dhoop nahin rehti. Suraj ki bulandi ke sath hi aisi jagah se shua'ein dhoop ki kam hoti jati hain aur suraj ke doobne ke waqt dhoop un ke ghaar ki taraf us ke darwaze ke shumal rukh se jati hai mashriq janib se. Ilm-e-hai'at ke janne wale ise khoob samajh sakte hain, jinhein suraj, chand aur sitaron ki chaal ka ilm hai. Agar ghaar ka darwaza mashriq rukh hota to suraj ke ghuroob ke waqt wahan dhoop bilkul na jati aur agar qibla rukh hota to suraj ke tulu ke waqt dhoop na pahunchti aur na ghuroob ke waqt pahunchti aur na saya da'in ba'in jhukta aur agar darwaza maghrib rukh hota to bhi suraj nikalne ke waqt andar dhoop na ja sakti balkay zawal ke baad andar pahunchti aur phir barabar maghrib tak rehti. Pas theek baat wahi hai jo hum ne bayan ki, falillahil hamd. Taqrizuhum ke ma'ani Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne tark karne aur chhor dene ke kiye, hamein is se koi faida nahin, na is se kisi shar'i maqsad ka husool hota hai. Phir bhi ba'az mufassireen ne is mein takleef uthai hai, koi kehta hai woh Aila ke qareeb hai, koi kehta hai Nainawa ke paas hai, koi kehta hai Room mein hai, koi kehta hai Balqa mein hai. Asal ilm Allah Ta'ala hi ko hai woh kahan hai, agar is mein koi deeni maslahat ya hamara koi mazhabi faida hota to yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala hamein bata deta, apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani bayan kara deta. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke tumhein jo jo kaam aur cheezein jannat se qareeb aur jahannam se door karne wali thin un mein se ek bhi tark kiye baghair main ne bata di hain. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne is ki sifat bayan farma di aur is ki jagah nahin batai. Farma diya ke suraj ke tulu ke waqt un ke ghaar se woh da'in janib jhuk jata hai aur ghuroob ke waqt unhein ba'in taraf chhor deta hai, woh is se farakhi mein hain, unhein dhoop ki tapish nahin pahunchti warna un ke badan aur kapray jal jate. Yeh Allah ki ek nishani hai ke Rabb unhein is ghaar mein pahunchaya jahan unhein zinda rakha, dhoop bhi pahunche, hawa bhi jaye, chandni bhi rahe taake na neend mein khalal aaye na nuqsan pahunche. Fi-alwaq'i Allah ki taraf se yeh bhi kamil nishan-e-qudrat hai. In naujawanon muwahhidon ki hidayat khud Allah ne ki thi, yeh rah-e-rast pa chuke thay, kisi ke bas mein na tha ke unhein gumrah kar sake aur is ke bar-aks jise woh rah na dikhaye us ka hadi koi nahin.

Ek aankh band ek khuli yeh so rahe hain lekin dekhne wala unhein bedaar samajhta hai kyunke un ki aankhein khuli hui hain. Mazkoor hai ke bheriya jab sota hai toh ek aankh band rakhta hai, ek khuli hoti hai phir use band kar ke use khol deta hai chunancha kisi shayar ne kaha hai: Yanaamu bi-ahdi muqlatayhi wa yattaqi bi-ukhra ar-razaya fahuwa yaqzanun naaim. Janwaron aur kiron makoron aur dushmanon se bachane ke liye toh Allah ne neend mein bhi un ki aankhein khuli rakhi hain aur zameen na kha jaye, karwatein gal na jayen is liye Allah Ta'ala unhein karwatein badlwa deta hai, kehte hain saal bhar mein do martaba karwat badalte hain. Un ka kutta bhi angnai mein darwaze ke paas mitti mein chaukhat ke qareeb bator pehredar ke bazu zameen par tikate hue baitha hua hai, darwaze ke bahar is liye hai ke jis ghar mein kutta, tasveer, junubi aur kafir shakhs ho us ghar mein farishte nahin jate. Jaise ke ek hasan hadith mein warid hua hai. Is kutte ko bhi isi halat mein neend aa gayi hai. Sach hai bhale logon ki sohbat bhi bhalai paida karti hai, dekhiye na is kutte ki kitni shaan ho gayi ke Kalam-e-Ilahi mein is ka zikr aaya. Kehte hain ke un mein se kisi ka yeh shikari kutta pala hua tha. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke badshah ke bawarchi ka yeh kutta tha. Chunke woh bhi un ke hum-maslak the. Un ke sath hijrat mein the. Un ka kutta un ke peeche lag gaya tha. Wallahu A'lam. Kehte hain ke Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke hathon Hazrat Zabihullah ke badle jo mendha zibah hua us ka naam Jareer tha. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko jis hudhud ne Malika-e-Saba ki khabar di thi us ka naam Anfar tha aur Ashab-e-Kahf ke is kutte ka naam Qateer tha aur Bani Israel ne jis bachre ki puja shuru ki thi us ka naam Mehmut tha. Hazrat Adam A.S behisht-e-bareen se Hind mein utre the, Hazrat Hawa Jeddah mein, Iblees dasht-e-Baisan mein aur saanp Isfahan mein. Ek qaul hai ke is kutte ka naam Humran tha. Neez is kutte ke rang mein bhi bahut se aqwal hain, lekin hamein hairat hai ke is se kya natija? Kya faida? Kya zaroorat? Balkeh ajab nahin ke aisi behsein mamnoo hon. Is liye ke yeh toh aankhein band kar ke patthar phenkna hai, be-daleel zaban kholna hai. Phir farmata hai ke hum ne unhein woh ra'ab diya hai ke koi unhein dekh hi nahin sakta, yeh is liye ke log un ka tamasha na bana lein, koi jurrat kar ke un ke paas na chala jaye, koi unhein hath na laga sake, woh aaram aur chain se jab tak Hikmat-e-Ilahi mutaqazi hai ba-aaram sote rahein. Jo unhein dekhta hai mare ra'ab ke kaleja thar-thara jata hai. Isi waqt ulte pairon wapas laut-ta hai, unhein nazar bhar kar dekhna bhi har ek ke liye muhaal hai.

Maut ke baad zindagi irshad hota hai ke jaise hum ne apni qudrat-e-kamilah se unhein sula diya tha, isi tarah apni qudrat se unhein jaga diya. Teen sau nau saal tak sote rahe lekin jab jaage bilkul waise hi thay, jaise sote waqt thay, badan baal khaal sab asli halat mein thay. Bas jaise sote waqt thay waise hi ab bhi thay. Kisi qisam ka koi taghayyur na tha. Aapas mein kehne lage ke kyun ji hum kitni muddat sote rahe? Toh jawab mila ke ek din balkay us se bhi kam kyunke subah ke waqt yeh so gaye thay aur us waqt shaam ka waqt tha is liye unhein yahi khayal hua. Lekin phir khud unhein khayal hua ke aisa toh nahin is liye unhon ne zehan ladana chhod diya aur faisla-kun baat keh di ke is ka sahi ilm sirf Allah Ta'ala ko hi hai. Ab chunke bhook pyaas maloom ho rahi thi is liye unhon ne bazaar se sauda mangwane ki tajweez ki. Daam un ke paas thay. Jin mein se kuch rah-e-Allah kharch kiye thay, kuch majood thay. Kehne lage ke isi shehar mein kisi ko daam de kar bhej do, woh wahan se koi pakeeza cheez khane peene ki laye yani umdah aur behtar cheez jaise aayat (وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهٗ مَا زَكٰي مِنْكُمْ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ اَبَدًا ۙ وَّلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُزَكِّيْ مَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيْعٌ عَلِيْمٌ 21؀) (24-An-Nur:21) yani agar Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-karam tum par na hota toh tum mein se koi paak na hota aur aayat mein hai (قَدْ اَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكّٰى 14 ۙ) (87-Al-A'la:14) woh falah pa gaya jis ne pakeezgi ki. Zakat ko bhi zakat isi liye kaha jata hai ke woh maal ko tayyab-o-tahir kar deti hai. Dusra qaul yeh hai ke murad bahut sara khana lane se hai jaise kheti ke badh jaane ke waqt Arab kehte hain zaka-al-zar'a aur jaise shayar ka qaul hai: Qabailuna sab'un wa antum thalathatun, wa asba'u azka min thalathin wat-tayyib. Pas yahan bhi yeh lafz ziyadati aur kasrat ke ma'ani mein hai lekin pehla qaul hi sahi hai is liye ke Ashab-e-Kahf ka maqsad is qaul se halal cheez ka lana tha, khwah woh ziyada ho ya kam. Kehte hain ke jaane wale ko bahut ehtiyat baratni chahiye, aane jaane aur sauda khareedne mein hoshiyari se kaam le jahan tak ho sake logon ki nigahon mein na chadhe, dekho aisa na ho koi maloom kar le. Agar unhein ilm ho gaya toh phir khair nahin. Daqiyanoos ke aadmi agar tumhari jagah ki khabar pa gaye toh woh tarah tarah ki sakht sazayein tumhein denge, ya toh tum un se ghabra kar deen-e-haq chhod kar phir se kafir ban jao ya yeh ke woh inhi sazayon mein tumhara kaam hi khatam kar dein. Agar tum un ke deen mein ja mile toh samajh lo ke tum nijaat se dast-bardar ho gaye, phir toh Allah ke yahan ka chhutkara tumhare liye muhaal ho jayega.

Dobara jeene ki hujjat irshad hai ke isi tarah hum ne apni qudrat se logon ko un ke haal par aagah kar diya taake Allah ke wa'ade aur Qayamat ke aane ki sachai ka unhein ilm ho jaye. Kehte hain ke us zamane ke wahan majood logon ko Qayamat ke aane mein kuch shukook paida ho chale the. Ek jamaat toh kehti thi ke faqat roohein dobara jee uthengi, jism ka iaada na hoga pas Allah Ta'ala ne sadiyon baad Ashab-e-Kahf ko jaga kar Qayamat ke hone aur jismon ke dobara jeene ki hujjat wazeh kar di hai aur aini daleel de di. Mazkoor hai ke jab un mein se ek sahib daam le kar sauda khareedne ko ghar se bahar nikle toh dekha ke un ki dekhi hui ek cheez nahin sara naqsha badla hua hai us shehar ka naam Afsus tha zamane guzar chuke the, bastiyan badal chuki thin, sadiyan beet gayi thin aur yeh toh apne nazdeek yahi samjhe hue the ke hamein yahan pahunche ek aadh din guzra hai yahan inqilab-e-zamana aur ka aur ho chuka hai jaise kisi ne kaha hai:

Ama ad-diyaru fa-innaha ka-diyarihim
Wa-ra'aytu rijalal-hayyi ghaira rijalih

Ghar go unhein jaise hain lekin qabeele ke log aur hi hain. Us ne dekha ke na toh shehar ki koi cheez apne haal par hai, na shehar ka koi bhi rehne wala jaan pehchan ka hai na yeh kisi ko jaanein na unhein aur koi pehchane. Tamam aam khaas aur hi hain. Yeh apne dil mein hairan tha. Dimagh chakra raha tha ke kal shaam hum is shehar ko chhod kar gaye hain. Yeh daf'atan ho kya gaya? Har chand sochta tha koi baat samajh mein na aati thi. Aakhir khayal karne laga ke shayad main majnoon ho gaya hoon ya mere hawas thikane nahin rahe ya mujhe koi marz lag gaya hai ya main khwab mein hoon. Lekin foran hi yeh khayalat hat gaye magar kisi baat par tasalli na ho saki is liye irada kar liya ke mujhe sauda le kar is shehar ko jald chhod dena chahiye. Ek dukan par ja kar use daam diye aur sauda khane peene ka talab kiya. Us ne us sikke ko dekh kar sakht tar ta'ajjub ka izhar kiya apne padosi ko diya ke dekhna yeh sikka kya hai kab ka hai? Kisi zamane ka hai? Us ne dusre ko diya us se kisi aur ne dekhne ko maang liya. Al-gharaz woh toh ek tamasha ban gaya har zaban se yahi nikalne laga ke is ne kisi purane zamane ka khazana paya hai, is mein se yeh laya hai is se pucho yeh kahan ka hai? Kaun hai? Yeh sikka kahan se paya? Chunancha logon ne use gher liya majma laga kar khade ho gaye aur upar tale tedhe tirche sawalat shuru kar diye. Us ne kaha main toh isi shehar ka rehne wala hoon, kal shaam ko main yahan se gaya hoon, yahan ka badshah Daqyanus hai. Ab toh sab ne qahqaha laga kar kaha bhai yeh toh koi pagal aadmi hai. Aakhir use badshah ke samne pesh kiya us se sawalat hue us ne tamam haal keh sunaya ab ek taraf badshah aur dusre sab log mutahayyir ek taraf se khud shashdar-o-hairan. Aakhir sab log un ke saath hue. Achha hamein apne aur sathi dikhao aur apna ghar bhi dikha do. Yeh unhein le kar chale ghar ke paas pahunch kar kaha tum zara thairo main pehle unhein ja kar khabar kar doon.

Un ke alag hat-te hi Allah Ta'ala ne un par be-khabari ke parde daal diye. Unhein na maloom ho saka ke woh kahan gaya? Allah ne phir is raaz ko makhfi kar liya. Ek riwayat yeh bhi aayi hai ke yeh log ma'a badshah ke gaye, un se mile, salam-o-alaik hui, baghal-geer hue, yeh badshah khud musalman tha. Is ka naam Tandoosis tha, Ashab-e-Kahf un se mil kar bahut khush hue aur mohabbat-o-unsiyat se mile jule, baatein keen, phir wapas ja kar apni apni jagah lete, phir Allah Ta'ala ne unhein faut kar liya, Rahimahumullah Ajma'een, Wallahu A'lam. Kehte hain ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) Habeeb bin Maslama ke sath ek ghazwe mein thay, wahan unhon ne Room ke shehron mein ek ghar dekha, jis mein haddiyan thin, logon ne kaha yeh haddiyan Ashab-e-Kahf ki hain, Aap (R.A) ne farmaya teen sau saal guzar chuke ke un ki haddiyan khokhli ho kar mitti ho gayin (Ibn-e-Jareer). Pas farmata hai ke jaise hum ne unhein anokhi tarz par sulaya aur bilkul anokhe taur par jagaya, isi tarah bilkul nirale tarz par ahl-e-shehar ko un ke halaat se mutalla farmaya taake unhein Allah ke wadon ki haqaniyat ka ilm ho jaye aur Qayamat ke hone mein aur us ke bar-haq hone mein unhein koi shak na rahe. Us waqt woh aapas mein sakht mukhtalif thay, lad jhagad rahe thay, ba'az Qayamat ke qail thay, ba'az munkir thay, pas Ashab-e-Kahf ka zuhoor munkiron par hujjat aur manne walon ke liye daleel ban gaya. Ab is basti walon ka irada hua ke un ke ghar ka munh band kar diya jaye aur unhein un ke haal par chhod diya jaye. Jinhein sardari hasil thi unhon ne irada kiya ke hum to un ke gird-o-pesh masjid bana lenge. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer un logon ke bare mein do qaul naqal karte hain, ek yeh ke un mein se musalmanon ne yeh kaha tha, dusre yeh ke yeh qaul kuffar ka tha. Wallahu A'lam. Lekin bazahir maloom hota hai ke is ke qail kalma-go thay, han yeh aur baat hai ke un ka yeh kehna achha tha ya bura? To is bare mein saaf hadith majood hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah Yahood-o-Nasara par la'nat farmaye ke unhon ne apne ambiya aur auliya ki qabron ko masjidein bana lin, jo unhon ne kiya us se Aap (ﷺ) apni ummat ko bachana chahte thay. Isi liye Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein jab Hazrat Daniyal (A.S) ki qabr Iraq mein payi to hukum farmaya ke use posheeda kar diya jaye aur jo ruq'a mila hai jis mein ba'az ladaiyon waghera ka zikr hai use dafan kar diya jaye.

Ashab-e-Kahf ki tadaad: Log Ashab-e-Kahf ki ginti mein kuch ka kuch kaha karte thay, teen qisam ke log thay, chauthi ginti bayan nahin farmayi. Do pehle ke aqwal ko toh za'eef kar diya ke yeh atkal ke tukke hain, be-nishane ke patthar hain, ke agar kahin lag jayen toh kamaal nahin, na lagen toh zawaal nahin. Haan, teesra qaul bayan farma kar sakoot ikhtiyar farmaya, tardeed nahin ki, yani saat woh aur aathwan unka kutta. Is se toh maloom hota hai ke yahi baat sahih aur waqay mein yunhi hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke aise mauqe par behtar yahi hai ke ilm Allah ki taraf use lota diya jaye. Aisi baaton mein koi sahih ilm na hone ki wajah se gaur-o-khauz karna abas hai, jis baat ka ilm ho jaye munh se nikale warna khamosh rahe. Is ginti ka sahih ilm bahut kam logon ko hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain main inhi mein se hoon, main janta hoon woh saat thay. Hazrat Ata Khurasani (R.H) ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur yahi hum ne pehle likha tha. In mein se ba'az toh bahut hi kam umr thay, unfwan-e-shabab mein thay. Yeh log din-raat Allah ki ibadat mein mashghool rehte thay, rote rehte thay aur Allah Ta'ala se faryad karte rehte thay. Marwi hai ke yeh toh nau thay, in mein se jo sab se bade thay unka naam Muksalamin tha, isi ne badshah se baatein ki thin aur use Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat ki dawat di thi. Baqi ke naam yeh hain: Fahastalamin, Tamleekh, Matunus, Kashtunus, Bairunus, Danimus, Batunus aur Qabus. Haan, Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki sahih riwayat yahi hai ke yeh saat shakhs thay, aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se bhi yahi maloom hota hai. Shuaib Jabai kehte hain inke kutte ka naam Humran tha, lekin in naamon ki sehat mein nazar hai, Wallahu A'lam. In mein ki bahut si cheezein Ahl-e-Kitab se li hui hain. Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko irshad farmaya ke aap inke bare mein zyada behas-o-mubahisa na karein, yeh ek nihayat hi halka kaam hai jis mein koi bada faida nahin aur na inke bare mein kisi se daryaft kijiye, kyunke umooman woh apne dil se jod kar kehte hain, koi sahih aur sachi daleel inke hathon mein nahin. Aur Allah Ta'ala ne, jo kuch aap ke samne bayan farmaya hai, yeh jhoot se paak hai, shak-shuba se door hai, qabil-e-imaan-o-yaqeen hai, bas yahi haq hai aur sab se muqaddam hai.

Insha'Allah kehne ka hukum Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Khatam-ul-Mursaleen Nabi ko irshad farmata hai ke jis kaam ko kal karna chaho toh yun na keh diya karo ke kal karunga balkeh us ke sath hi Insha'Allah keh liya karo kyunke kal kya hoga? Is ka ilm sirf Allah hi ko hai. Allam-ul-Ghuyub aur tamam cheezon par qadir sirf wahi hai. Us ki madad talab kar liya karo. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Hazrat Sulaiman bin Dawood (A.S) ki navve (90) biwiyan thin. Ek riwayat mein hai sau (100) thin. Ek mein hai behtar (72) thin toh aap ne ek baar kaha ke aaj raat mein in sab ke paas jaunga har aurat ko bacha hoga toh sab Allah ki raah mein jihad karenge, us waqt farishte ne kaha Insha'Allah keh. Magar Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne na kaha, apne irade ke mutabiq woh sab biwiyon ke paas gaye, magar siwaye ek biwi ke kisi ke haan bacha na hua aur jis ek ke haan hua bhi woh bhi aadhe jism ka tha. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) farmate hain us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai agar woh Insha'Allah keh lete toh yeh irada un ka pura hota aur un ki haajat-rawai ho jati. Aur yeh sab bache jawan ho kar raah-e-haq ke mujahid bante. Isi surat ki tafsir ke shuru mein is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool bayan ho chuka hai ke jab aap se Ashab-e-Kahf ka qissa daryaft kiya gaya toh aap ne farmaya ke main kal tumhein jawab dunga. Insha'Allah na kaha is bina par pandrah din tak wahi nazil na hui. Is hadith ko puri tarah hum ne is surat ki tafsir ke shuru mein bayan kar diya hai yahan dobara bayan karne ki haajat nahin. Phir bayan farmata hai ke jab bhool jaye tab apne Rab ko yaad kar yani Insha'Allah kehna agar mauqe par yaad na aaya toh jab yaad aaye keh liya kar. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is shakhs ke bare mein farmate hain jo half khaye ke use phir bhi Insha'Allah kehne ka haq hai go saal bhar guzar chuka ho. Matlab yeh hai ke apne kalam mein ya qasam mein Insha'Allah kehna bhool gaya toh jab bhi yaad aaye keh le go kitni muddat guzar chuki ho aur go us ka khilaf bhi ho chuka ho. Is se yeh matlab nahin ke ab us par qasam ka kaffara nahin rahega aur use qasam todne ka ikhtiyar rahe. Yehi matlab is qaul ka Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne bayan farmaya hai aur yehi bilkul theek hai isi par Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ka kalam mahmool kiya ja sakta hai un se aur Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marwi hai ke murad Insha'Allah kehna bhool jana hai. Aur riwayat mein is ke baad yeh bhi hai ke yeh An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ke sath makhsoos hai, dusra koi toh apni qasam ke sath hi mutasil taur par Insha'Allah kahe toh motabar hai. Yeh bhi ek matlab hai ke jab koi baat bhool jao toh Allah ka zikr karo kyunke bhool shaitani harkat hai aur zikr-e-Ilahi yaad ka zariya hai. Phir farmaya ke tujh se kisi aisi baat ka sawal kiya jaye ke tujhe is ka ilm na ho toh tu Allah Ta'ala se daryaft kar liya kar aur us ki taraf tawajjah kar taake woh tujhe theek baat aur hidayat wali raah bata aur dikha de. Aur bhi aqwal is bare mein marwi hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Insha'Allah kehne ka hukum Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Khatam-ul-Mursaleen Nabi ko irshad farmata hai ke jis kaam ko kal karna chaho toh yun na keh diya karo ke kal karunga balkeh us ke sath hi Insha'Allah keh liya karo kyunke kal kya hoga? Is ka ilm sirf Allah hi ko hai. Allam-ul-Ghuyub aur tamam cheezon par qadir sirf wahi hai. Us ki madad talab kar liya karo. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain Hazrat Sulaiman bin Dawood (A.S) ki navve (90) biwiyan thin. Ek riwayat mein hai sau (100) thin. Ek mein hai behtar (72) thin toh aap ne ek baar kaha ke aaj raat mein in sab ke paas jaunga har aurat ko bacha hoga toh sab Allah ki raah mein jihad karenge, us waqt farishte ne kaha Insha'Allah keh. Magar Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne na kaha, apne irade ke mutabiq woh sab biwiyon ke paas gaye, magar siwaye ek biwi ke kisi ke haan bacha na hua aur jis ek ke haan hua bhi woh bhi aadhe jism ka tha. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) farmate hain us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai agar woh Insha'Allah keh lete toh yeh irada un ka pura hota aur un ki haajat-rawai ho jati. Aur yeh sab bache jawan ho kar raah-e-haq ke mujahid bante. Isi surat ki tafsir ke shuru mein is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool bayan ho chuka hai ke jab aap se Ashab-e-Kahf ka qissa daryaft kiya gaya toh aap ne farmaya ke main kal tumhein jawab dunga. Insha'Allah na kaha is bina par pandrah din tak wahi nazil na hui. Is hadith ko puri tarah hum ne is surat ki tafsir ke shuru mein bayan kar diya hai yahan dobara bayan karne ki haajat nahin. Phir bayan farmata hai ke jab bhool jaye tab apne Rab ko yaad kar yani Insha'Allah kehna agar mauqe par yaad na aaya toh jab yaad aaye keh liya kar. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is shakhs ke bare mein farmate hain jo half khaye ke use phir bhi Insha'Allah kehne ka haq hai go saal bhar guzar chuka ho. Matlab yeh hai ke apne kalam mein ya qasam mein Insha'Allah kehna bhool gaya toh jab bhi yaad aaye keh le go kitni muddat guzar chuki ho aur go us ka khilaf bhi ho chuka ho. Is se yeh matlab nahin ke ab us par qasam ka kaffara nahin rahega aur use qasam todne ka ikhtiyar rahe. Aur bhi aqwal is bare mein marwi hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Ashab-e-Kahf kitna soye? Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (A.S) ko is muddat ki khabar deta hai, jo Ashab-e-Kahf ne apne sone ke zamane mein guzari ke woh muddat suraj ke hisab se teen sau saal ki thi aur chand ke hisab se teen sau nau saal ki theen. Fi-al-waqai shamsi aur qamari saal mein sau saal par teen saal ka farq padta hai, isi liye teen sau alag bayan kar ke phir nau alag bayan kiye. Phir farmata hai ke jab tujh se un ke sone ki muddat daryaft ki jaye aur tere paas is ka kuch ilm na ho aur na Allah ne tujhe waqif kiya ho to tu aage na badh aur aise umoor mein yeh jawab diya kar ke Allah hi ko sahih ilm hai, aasman aur zameen ka ghaib wohi jaanta hai, haan jise woh jo baat bata de woh jaan leta hai. Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain ke woh teen sau saal thaire the aur Allah Ta'ala ne is ki tardeed ki hai aur farmaya hai Allah hi ko is ka poora ilm hai. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) se bhi isi ma'ani ki qira'at marwi hai. Lekin Qatadah (R.H) ka yeh qaul ta'ammul talab hai is liye ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke haan shamsi saal ka riwaj hai aur woh teen sau saal maante hain, teen sau nau ka un ka qaul ta'ammul nahin, agar un hi ka qaul naqal hota to phir Allah Ta'ala yeh na farmata ke aur nau saal zyada kiye. Bazahir to yahi theek maloom hota hai ke khud Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala is baat ki khabar de raha hai na ke kisi ka qaul bayan farmata hai, yahi ikhtiyar Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka hai. Qatadah (R.H) ki riwayat aur Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) ki qira'at dono munqata hain. Phir shaaz bhi hain, jamhoor ki qira'at wohi hai jo Quranon mein hai pas woh shaaz daleel ke qabil nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko khoob dekh raha hai aur un ki aawaz ko khoob sun raha hai, in alfaaz mein tareef ka mubaligha hai, in dono lafzon mein madh ka mubaligha hai yani woh khoob dekhne sunne wala hai. Har maujood cheez ko dekh raha hai aur har aawaz ko sun raha hai koi kaam koi kalam us se makhfi nahin, koi us se zyada sunne dekhne wala nahin. Sab ke ilm dekh raha hai, sab ki baatein sun raha hai, khalq ka khaliq, amr ka maalik, wohi hai. Koi us ke farman ko rad nahin kar sakta hai. Us ka koi wazeer aur madadgar nahin na koi shareek aur musheer hai woh in tamam kamiyon se paak hai, tamam naqais se door hai.

Tilawat-o-Tableegh: Allah Kareem apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko apne kalaam ki tilawat aur uski tableegh ki hidayat karta hai, uske kalmaat ko na koi badal sake na taal sake, na idhar udhar kar sake, samajh le ke uske siwaye jaye-panah nahin, agar tilawat-o-tableegh chhod di toh phir bachao ki koi surat nahin. Jaise aur jagah hai ke aye Rasool jo kuch teri taraf tere Rab ki janib se utra hai uski tableegh karta reh agar na ki toh tune haq-e-risalat ada nahin kiya logon ke shar se Allah tujhe bachaye rakhe ga. Aur aayat mein hai (Innal-lazi farada 'alaikal-Qur'ana laradduka ila ma'ad, qul-Rabbii a'lamu man ja'a bil-huda wa man huwa fi dalalim-mubin) (28. Al-Qasas: 85) yani Allah Ta'ala tere mansab ki babat Qayamat ke din zaroor sawal kare ga. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa la tatrudil-lazina yad'una Rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-'ashiyyi yuriduna wajhah) (6. Al-An'am: 52) yani subh-o-sham yaad-e-Ilahi karne walon ko apni majlis se na hata. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke hum chhe gareeb ghurba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki majlis mein baithe hue the Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas, Ibn-e-Mas'ood, qabila Huzail ka ek shakhs, Bilal aur do aadmi aur itne mein mu'azzaz mushrikeen aaye aur kehne lage inhe apni majlis mein is jurrat ke sath na baithne do. Allah hi behtar janta hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jee mein kya aaya? Jo us waqt aayat (Wa la tatrudil-lazina yad'una Rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-'ashiyyi yuriduna wajhah) (6. Al-An'am: 52) utri. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek wa'iz qissa-goi kar raha tha jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye woh khamosh ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum bayan kiye chale jao. Main toh subh ki namaz se lekar aaftab ke nikalne tak isi majlis mein baitha jaon, yeh mujhe char ghulam azaad karne se zyada mehboob hai. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke zikr-e-Allah karne walon ke sath subh ki namaz se suraj nikalne tak baith jana mujhe toh tamam duniya se zyada pyara hai, aur namaz-e-asr ke baad se suraj ke ghuroob hone tak Allah ka zikr karna mujhe aath ghulamon ke azaad karne se zyada pyara hai go woh ghulam aulad-e-Ismail se garan-qadr aur qeemti kyun na hon, go un mein se ek-ek ki diyat barah-barah hazar ki ho toh majmooi qeemat chhiyanwe hazar ki hui. Ba'az log char ghulam batate hain lekin Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain Wallah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aath ghulam farmaye hain. Bazzar mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye ek sahib Surah Kahf ki qira'at kar rahe the Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekh kar khamosh ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yahi in logon ki majlis hai, jahan apne nafs ko rok kar rakhne ka mujhe hukm-e-Ilahi hua hai aur riwayat mein hai ke ya toh Surah Hajj ki woh tilawat kar rahe the ya Surah Kahf ki. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai farmate hain zikr-e-Allah ke liye jo majlis jama ho niyat bhi unki bakhair ho toh aasman se munadi nida karta hai ke utho Allah ne tumhe bakhsh diya tumhari buraiyan bhalaiyon se badal gayin.

Tabrani mein hai ke jab yeh aayat utri aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne kisi ghar mein thay, isi waqt aise logon ki talash mein nikle. Kuch logon ko zikr-e-Allah mein paya, jinke baal bikhre hue thay, khalein khushk thin, bamushkil ek-ek kapra unhein hasil tha, foran un ki majlis mein baith gaye aur kehne lage Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne meri ummat mein aise log rakhe hain, jin ke sath baithne ka mujhe hukm hua hai. Phir farmata hai un se teri aankhein tajawuz na karein, un yaad-e-Allah karne walon ko chhor kar maaldaron ki talash mein na lag jana jo deen se bargashta hain, jo ibadat se door hain, jin ki buraiyan barh gayi hain, jin ke aamal hamaqat ke hain to un ki pairwi na karna un ke tariqe ko pasand na karna un par rashk bhari nigahain na dalna, un ki ne'matein lalchai hui nazron se na dekhna. Jaise farman hai aayat (لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ 88؀) (Surah Al-Hijr: 88), hum ne unhein jo dunyawi aish-o-ishrat de rakhi hai yeh sirf un ki aazmaish ke liye hai. To lalchai hui nigahon se unhein na dekhna, darasal tere Rab ke paas ki rozi behtar aur bahut baqi hai.

Jahannam ki deewarein jo kuch main apne Rab ke paas se laya hoon wahi haq, sadaq aur sachai hai, shak shuba se bilkul khali. Ab jiska jee chahe maane, na chahe na maane. Na maanne walon ke liye aag Jahannam taiyaar hai, jiski chaar deewari ke jail khane mein yeh bebas honge. Hadees mein hai ke Jahannam ki chaar deewari ki wus'at chalees-chalees saal ki raah ki hai (Musnad Ahmad) aur khud woh deewarein bhi aag ki hain. Aur riwayat mein hai samundar bhi Jahannam hai phir is aayat ki tilawat farmayi aur farmaya wallah na is mein jaoon jab tak bhi zinda rahoon aur na iska koi qatra mujhe pahunche. Muhl kehte hain ghaleez paani ko jaise zaitoon ke tel ki talchhat aur jaise khoon aur peep jo behad garam ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ne ek martaba sona pighlaya jab woh paani jaisa ho gaya aur josh maarne laga farmaya muhl ki mushabahat is mein hai Jahannam ka paani bhi siyah hai, woh khud bhi siyah hai, Jahannami bhi siyah hain. Muhl siyah rang, badboodar, ghaleez gandi, sakht garam cheez hai, chehre ke paas jaate hi khaal jhulas kar is mein aaparegi. Quran mein hai woh peep pilaye jayenge bamushkil unke halq se utregi. Chehre ke paas aate hi khaal jal kar girparegi peete hi aantein kat jayengi unki haye-waye shor-o-ghul par yeh paani unko peene ko diya jayega. Bhook ki shikayat par Zaqqoom ka darakht diya jayega jis se unki khalein is tarah jism chhod kar utar jayengi ke unke pehchanne wala un khalon ko dekh kar bhi pehchan le, phir pyaas ki shikayat par sakht garam kholta hua paani milega jo munh ke paas pahunchte hi tamam gosht ko bhoon daale ga. Haye kya bura paani hai yeh woh garam paani pilaya jayega, unka thikana unki manzil unka ghar unki aaram-gah bhi nihayat buri hai. Jaise aur aayat mein (Innaha sa'at mustaqarran wa muqama) (25. Al-Furqan: 66) woh buri jagah aur behad kathan manzil hai.

Sonay ke kangan aur reshmi libas. Upar buray logon ka haal aur anjam bayan farmaya, ab nekon ka aaghaz-o-anjam bayan ho raha hai. Yeh Allah, Rasool aur Kitabullah ke mannay walay nek amal karnay walay hotay hain, un ke liye hamesha wali daimi jannatein hain, un ke balakhano ke aur baghat ke neechay nehrein lehrein le rahi hain. Us ke paas har waqt tarah tarah ki paidawar majood, maldar shakhs. Us ki dusri qira'at 'samar' bhi hai yeh jama hai 'samrat' ki jaise 'khashba' ki jama 'khashab'. Al-gharaz us ne ek din apne ek dost se fakhr-o-ghurur karte hue kaha ke main maal mein, izzat-o-aulad mein, jah-o-hasham mein, naukar chakar mein, tujh se zyada haisiyat wala hoon. Ek fajir shakhs ki tamanna yahi hoti hai ke duniya ki yeh cheezain us ke paas bakasrat hon. Yeh apne bagh mein gaya apni jaan par zulm karta hua yani takabbur, akar, inkar-e-qayamat aur kufr karta hua. Is qadar mast tha ke us ki zaban se nikla ke namumkin hai meri yeh lehlahati khetiyan, yeh phal-dar darakht, yeh jari neharain, yeh sarsabz belain, kabhi fana ho jayain. Haqiqat mein yeh us ki kam-aqli, be-imani aur duniya ki khar-masti aur Allah ke sath kufr ki wajah thi. Isi liye keh raha hai ke mere khayal se toh qayamat aane wali nahin. Aur agar bilfarz aayi bhi toh zahir hai ke Allah ka main pyara hoon warna woh mujhe is qadar maal-o-mata'a kaise de deta? Toh wahan bhi woh mujhe is se bhi behtar ata farmaye ga. Is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool Aas bin Wa'il hai jaise ke apne mauqa par aaye ga Insha'Allah.

Ahsan faramoshi mutaradif-e-kufr hai. Is ka kafir maldar ko jo jawab us momin muflis ne diya us ka bayan ho raha hai ke kis tarah us ne wa'z-o-pand ki, iman-o-yaqin ki hidayat ki aur gumrahi aur ghuroor se hatana chaha. Farmaya ke tu Allah ke sath kufr karta hai jis ne insani paidaish mitti se shuru ki, phir us ki nasl mile jule pani se jari rakhi, jaise ayat (Kaifa takfuruna billahi wa kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum, summa yumitukum summa yuhyikum summa ilaihi turja'un) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 28) mein hai ke tum Allah ke sath kaise kufr karte ho? Tum to murda the us ne tumhein zinda kiya. Tum us ki zaat ka, us ki nematon ka inkar kaise kar sakte ho? Us ki nematon ke, us ki qudraton ke beshumar namune khud tum mein aur tum par maujood hain. Kaun nadan aisa hai jo na janta ho ke woh pehle kuch na tha, Allah ne use maujood kar diya. Woh khud-ba-khud apne hone par qadir na tha, Allah ne us ka wujood paida kiya. Phir woh inkar ke laiq kaise ho gaya? Us ki tauheed-e-uluhiyat se kaun inkar kar sakta hai. Main to tere muqable mein khule alfaz mein keh raha hoon ke mera Rab wahi Allah wahdahu la sharika lahu hai, main apne Rab ke sath mushrik banna na-pasand karta hoon. Phir apne sathi ko nek raghbat dilane ke liye kehta hai ke apni lehlahti hui kheti aur hare bhare mewon se lade bagh ko dekh kar tu Allah ka shukr kyun nahin karta? Kyun Masha'Allah La Quwwata Illa Billah nahin kehta? Isi ayat ko samne rakh kar ba'az salaf ka maqoola hai ke jise apni aulad ya maal ya haal pasand aaye use yeh kalma parh lena chahiye. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jis bande par Allah apni koi nemat in'am farmaye, ahl-o-ayal hon, daulat-mandi ho, phir woh is kalma ko keh le to is mein koi aanch na aayegi siwaye maut ke, phir aap is ayat ki ta'weel karte. Hafiz Abu Al-Fatah kehte hain yeh hadith sahih nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya main tumhein jannat ka ek khazana bata doon? Woh khazana La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah kehna hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah farmata hai mere bande ne maan liya aur apna mamla mere supurd kar diya. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se phir poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya sirf La Haula nahin balki woh jo Surah Kahf mein hai Masha'Allah La Quwwata Illa Billah. Phir farmaya ke us nek shakhs ne kaha ke mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke woh mujhe aakhirat ke din is se behtar nematein ata farmaye aur tere is bagh ko jise tu hameshagiri wala samjhe baitha hai tabah kar de. Aasman se is par azab bhej de. Zor ki barish aandhi ke sath aaye. Tamam khet aur bagh ujar jayen. Sookhi saaf zameen reh jaye goya ke kabhi yahan koi cheez ugi hi na thi. Ya is ki nehron ka pani dhansa de. Ghaur masdar hai ma'ni mein gha'ir ke bator mubalaghe ke laya gaya hai.

Farmaya ke tu Allah ke sath kufr karta hai jis ne insani paidaish mitti se shuru ki, phir us ki nasl mile jule pani se jari rakhi, jaise ayat (Kaifa takfuruna billahi wa kuntum amwatan fa-ahyakum, summa yumitukum summa yuhyikum summa ilaihi turja'un) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 28) mein hai ke tum Allah ke sath kaise kufr karte ho? Tum to murda the us ne tumhein zinda kiya. Tum us ki zaat ka, us ki nematon ka inkar kaise kar sakte ho? Us ki nematon ke, us ki qudraton ke beshumar namune khud tum mein aur tum par maujood hain. Kaun nadan aisa hai jo na janta ho ke woh pehle kuch na tha, Allah ne use maujood kar diya. Woh khud-ba-khud apne hone par qadir na tha, Allah ne us ka wujood paida kiya. Phir woh inkar ke laiq kaise ho gaya? Us ki tauheed-e-uluhiyat se kaun inkar kar sakta hai. Main to tere muqable mein khule alfaz mein keh raha hoon ke mera Rab wahi Allah wahdahu la sharika lahu hai, main apne Rab ke sath mushrik banna na-pasand karta hoon. Phir apne sathi ko nek raghbat dilane ke liye kehta hai ke apni lehlahti hui kheti aur hare bhare mewon se lade bagh ko dekh kar tu Allah ka shukr kyun nahin karta? Kyun Masha'Allah La Quwwata Illa Billah nahin kehta? Isi ayat ko samne rakh kar ba'az salaf ka maqoola hai ke jise apni aulad ya maal ya haal pasand aaye use yeh kalma parh lena chahiye. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jis bande par Allah apni koi nemat in'am farmaye, ahl-o-ayal hon, daulat-mandi ho, phir woh is kalma ko keh le to is mein koi aanch na aayegi siwaye maut ke, phir aap is ayat ki ta'weel karte. Hafiz Abu Al-Fatah kehte hain yeh hadith sahih nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya main tumhein jannat ka ek khazana bata doon? Woh khazana La Haula Wala Quwwata Illa Billah kehna hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah farmata hai mere bande ne maan liya aur apna mamla mere supurd kar diya. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se phir poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya sirf La Haula nahin balki woh jo Surah Kahf mein hai Masha'Allah La Quwwata Illa Billah. Phir farmaya ke us nek shakhs ne kaha ke mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke woh mujhe aakhirat ke din is se behtar nematein ata farmaye aur tere is bagh ko jise tu hameshagiri wala samjhe baitha hai tabah kar de. Aasman se is par azab bhej de. Zor ki barish aandhi ke sath aaye. Tamam khet aur bagh ujar jayen. Sookhi saaf zameen reh jaye goya ke kabhi yahan koi cheez ugi hi na thi. Ya is ki nehron ka pani dhansa de. Ghaur masdar hai ma'ni mein gha'ir ke bator mubalaghe ke laya gaya hai.

Kaff-e-afsos, us ka kul maal, kul phal gharat ho gaya. Woh momin usay jis baat se dara raha tha, wahi ho kar rahi. Ab toh woh apne maal ki barbadi par kaff-e-afsos malne laga aur aarzu karne laga ke ae kaash! ke main Allah ke saath mushrik na banta. Jin par fakhr karta tha, un mein se koi us waqt kaam na aaya, farzand, qabeela sab reh gaya. Fikr-o-ghuroor sab mit gaya, na aur koi khara hua na khud mein hi koi himmat hui. Baaz log 'Hunalika' par waqf karte hain aur usay pehle jumlay ke saath mila lete hain, yani wahan woh inteqam na le saka. Aur baaz 'Muntasiran' par aayat kar ke aagay se naye jumlay ki ibtida karte hain. 'Wilayatuhu' ki dusri qira'at 'Walayatuhu' bhi hai. Pehli qira'at par matlab yeh hua ke har momin-o-kafir Allah hi ki taraf ruju karne wala hai, us ke siwa koi jaye-panah nahin, azaab ke waqt koi bhi siwaye us ke kaam nahin aa sakta. Jaise farman hai aayat (FALAMMA RA'AW BA'SANA QALU AMANNA BILLAHI WAHDAHU WA KAFARNA BIMA KUNNA BIHI MUSHRIKEEN - 40. Ghafir: 84) yani hamare azaab dekh kar kehne lage ke hum Allah-e-Wahid par imaan late hain aur is se pehle jinhein hum shareek-e-Ilahi thehraya karte thay, un se inkaar karte hain. Aur jaise ke Firaun ne doobte waqt kaha tha ke main us Allah par imaan lata hoon jis par Bani Israel imaan laye hain aur main musalmanon mein shamil hota hoon. Us waqt jawab mila ke ab imaan qabool karta hai? Is se pehle toh nafarman raha aur mufsidon mein shamil raha. Wao ke kasra ki qira'at par yeh ma'ani hue ke wahan hukm sahih taur par Allah hi ke liye hai. 'Lillahil-Haq' ki dusri qira'at Qaaf ke pesh se bhi hai kyunke yeh 'Al-Wilayatuhu' ki sifat hai, jaise farman hai aayat (AL-MULKU YAWMA'IDHINIL-HAQQU LIR-RAHMANI WA KANA YAWMAN 'ALAL-KAFIREENA 'ASEERA - 25. Al-Furqan: 26) mein hai. Baaz log Qaaf ke zer parhte hain, un ke nazdeek yeh sifat hai Haq Ta'ala ki. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (THUMMA RUDDU ILALLAHI MAWLAAHUMUL-HAQQI ALA LAHUL-HUKMU WA HUWA ASRA'UL-HAASIREEN - 6. Al-An'am: 62). Isi liye phir farmata hai ke jo a'maal sirf Allah hi ke liye hon, un ka sawab bahut hota hai aur anjaam ke lihaz se bhi woh behtar hain.

Hayat-o-maut ka naqsha duniya apne zawal, fana, khatmay aur bardbari ke lihaz se misl-e-aasmani barish ke hai jo zameen ke danon waghera se milta hai aur hazarha poday lahlahanay lagtay hain, tar-o-tazgi aur zindagi ke aasar har cheez se zahir honay lagtay hain lekin kuch dinon ke guzartay hi woh sookh saakh kar chora chora hojatay hain, aur hawayein unhein dayein bayein uraye phirti hain. Is halat par Allah qadir tha woh is halat par bhi qadir hai. Umooman duniya ki misal barish se bayan farmayi jati hai jaise Surah Hadid ki aayat (Innama masalul hayatid dunya kama-in anzalnahu minas sama-i fakhtalata bihi nabatul ardi mimma ya-kulun nasu wal an-aam) (Surah Yunus: 24) mein aur jaise Surah Zumar ki aayat (Alam tara annallaha anzala minas sama-i ma-an fa-akhrajna bihi samaratim mukhtalifan alwanuha wa minal jibali judadum bidun wa humrum mukhtalifun alwanuha wa gharabibu sood) (Surah Fatir: 27) mein. Jaise Surah Hadid ki aayat (I'lamu annamal hayatad dunya la'ibun wa lahwun wa zeenatun wa tafakhurum bainakum wa takasurun fil amwali wal aulad kamasali ghaisin a'jabal kuffara nabatuhu summa yahiju fatarahu musfarran summa yakunu hutama, wa fil akhirati azabun shadid, wa maghfiratum minallahi wa ridwan, wa mal hayatud dunya illa mata'ul ghurur) (Surah Al-Hadid: 20) mein. Sahih hadith mein bhi hai, duniya sabz rang meethi hai al-kh. Phir farmata hai ke maal aur betay duniya ki zindagi ki zeenat hain jaise farmaya hai aayat (Zuyyina linnasi hubbush shahawati) al-kh, insaan ke liye khwahishon ki mohabbat maslan auratein, betay, khazanay waghera muzayyan kar di gayi hain. Aur aayat mein hai (Innama amwalukum wa auladukum fitnah, wallahu indahu ajrun azeem) (Surah At-Taghabun: 15) tumhare maal tumhari auladein fitna hain aur Allah ke paas ajr-e-azeem hai. Yani us ki taraf jhukna us ki ibadat mein mashghool rehna duniya talbi se behtar hai isi liye yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke baqiyat-e-salihat har lihaz se umda cheez hai. Maslan panchon waqt ki namazein aur dua (SubhanAllah, walhamdulillah, wala ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, aur La ilaha illallah, aur SubhanAllah, aur Alhamdulillah, aur Allahu Akbar, aur La haula wala quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azeem). Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ke ghulam farmatay hain ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ek martaba apne sathiyon mein bethay huay thay jo muazzin pohancha aap ne pani mangwaya ek bartan mein qareeb teen pao ke pani aaya, aap ne wuzu kar ke farmaya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi tarah wuzu kar ke farmaya jo mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kar ke zuhr ki namaz ada kare to subah se le kar zuhr tak ke sab gunah maaf hojatay hain.

Phir Asr mein bhi isi tarah namaz parh li toh Zohar se Asr tak ke tamam gunah maaf, phir Maghrib ki namaz parhi toh Asr se Maghrib tak ke gunah maaf. Phir Isha ki namaz parhi toh Maghrib se Isha tak ke gunah maaf phir raat ko woh so raha subah uth kar namaz-e-Fajr ada ki toh Isha se le ke subah tak ke gunah maaf. Yehi woh nekiyan hain jo buraiyon ko door kar deti hain. Logon ne poocha yeh toh huin nekiyan ab ae Usman (R.A) aap batlaiye ke Baqiyat-e-Salihat kya hain? Aap ne farmaya dua (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wallahu Akbar wala haula wala quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azeem). Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) farmate hain Baqiyat-e-Salihat yeh hain dua (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar wala haula wala quwwata illa billah). Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) ne apne shagird Amara (R.H) se poocha ke batao Baqiyat-e-Salihat kya hain? Unhon ne jawab diya ke namaz aur roza. Aap ne farmaya tum ne sahi jawab nahin diya unhon ne kaha Zakat aur Hajj farmaya abhi jawab theek nahin hua suno woh paanch kalmay hain dua (La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala haula wala quwwata illa billah). Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal hua toh aap ne bajuz Alhamdulillah ke aur chaar kalmaat batlaye. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) bajuz La haula ke aur charon kalmaat batlate hain. Hasan (R.H) aur Qatadah (R.H) bhi in hi charon kalmaat ko Baqiyat-e-Salihat batlate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dua (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar) yeh hain Baqiyat-e-Salihat. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Baqiyat-e-Salihat ki kasrat karo poocha gaya woh kya hain? Farmaya millat, poocha gaya woh kya hai ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)? Aap ne farmaya Takbeer, Tahleel, Tasbeeh aur Alhamdulillah aur La haula wala quwwata illa billah (Ahmad). Salim bin Abdullah ke maula Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman kehte hain ke mujhe Hazrat Salim (R.H) ne Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (R.H) ke paas kisi kaam ke liye bheja toh unhon ne kaha Salim se keh dena ke falan qabr ke paas ke konay mein mujh se mulaqat karein. Mujhe un se kuch kaam hai chunancha dono ki wahan mulaqat hui salam-o-alaik hua toh Salim ne poocha kuch ke nazdeek Baqiyat-e-Salihat kya hain? Unhon ne farmaya dua (La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar aur SubhanAllah aur La haula wala quwwata illa billah). Salim ne kaha yeh aakhri kalma aap ne is mein kab se barhaya? Qurzi ne kaha main toh hamesha se is kalmay ko shumar karta hoon do teen baar yehi sawal jawab hua toh Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab ne farmaya kya tumhein is kalmay se inkaar hai? Unhon ne jawab diya ke haan inkaar hai.

Kaha suno main ne Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari (R.A) se suna hai unhon ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke aap farmate thay jab mujhe Me'raj karayi gayi main ne aasman par Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko dekha, aap ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se poocha yeh aap ke saath kaun hain? Jibraeel (A.S) ne jawab diya ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain unhon ne mujhe marhaba aur khush-aamdeed kaha aur farmaya aap apni ummat se farma dijiye ke woh jannat mein apne liye kuch baghaat laga lein is ki mitti paak hai, is ki zameen kushada hai. Main ne poocha wahan baghaat lagane ki kya surat hai? Farmaya La-haula wala quwwata illa billah bakasrat parhein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Nu'man bin Basheer (R.A) se riwayat hai ke ek raat Isha ki namaz ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamare paas aaye aasman ki taraf dekh kar nazrein neechi kar lein hamein khayal hua ke shayad aasman mein koi nayi baat hui hai phir aap ne farmaya mere baad jhoot bolne aur zulm karne wale badshah honge jo un ke jhoot ko tasleem kare aur un ke zulm mein un ki tarafdari na kare woh mera hai aur main us ka hoon. Logo sun rakho SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar yeh Baqiyat-e-Salihat yani baqi rehne wali nekiyan hain. Musnad mein hai aap ne farmaya wah wah paanch kalmaat hain aur neki ki tarazu mein behad wazni hain La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar SubhanAllah walhamdulillah aur woh bacha jis ke inteqal par us ka baap talab-e-ajr ke liye sabr kare. Wah wah paanch cheezein hain jo un ka yaqeen rakhta ho Allah se mulaqat kare woh qatan jannati hai. Allah par, Qayamat ke din par, jannat dozakh par, marne ke baad ke jee uthne par aur hisab par iman rakhe. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus (R.A) ek safar mein thay kisi jagah utre aur apne ghulam se farmaya ke chhuri lao khelein. Hassan bin Atiya kehte hain main ne us waqt kaha ke yeh aap ne kya kiya? Aap ne farmaya waqai main ne ghalti ki suno Islam lane ke baad se le kar aaj tak main ne koi kalma apni zaban se aisa nahin nikala jo mere liye lagam ban jaye, bajuz is ek kalme ke pas tum log ise yaad se bhula do aur ab jo main keh raha hoon ise yaad rakho main ne Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke jab log sone chandi ke jama karne mein lag jayen tum us waqt in kalmaat ko bakasrat parha karo. Dua (Allahumma inni as'aluka thabata fil amri wal 'azeemata 'alar-rushdi wa as'aluka shukra ni'matika wa as'aluka husna 'ibadatika wa as'aluka qalban saleeman wa as'aluka lisanan sadiqan wa as'aluka min khairi ma ta'lamu wa a'oodhu bika min sharri ma ta'lamu wa astaghfiruka lima ta'lamu innaka anta 'allamul ghuyub) yani Aye Allah main tujh se apne kaam ki sabit qadmi aur neki ke kaam ka poora qasd aur teri nematon ki shukarguzari ki taufiq talab karta hoon aur tujh se dua hai ke tu mujhe salamti wala dil aur sachi zaban ata farma tere ilm mein jo bhalai hai main us ka khwastgar hoon aur tere ilm mein jo burai hai, main us se teri panah chahta hoon. Parwardigar har us burai se meri tauba hai jo tere ilm mein ho beshak ghaib daan sirf tu hi hai.

Hazrat Saeed bin Junadah (R.A) farmate hain ke Ahl-e-Taif mein se sab se pehle main Nabi Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Main apne ghar se subh hi subh chal khara hua aur asr ke waqt Mina mein pahunch gaya, pahar par charha, phir utra phir An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahuncha, Islam qabool kiya, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe Surah Qul Huwallahu Ahad aur Surah Iza Zulzilat sikhayi aur yeh kalmaat taleem farmaye. Dua: (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar). Farmaya yeh hain baqi rehne wali nekiyan. Is sanad se marwi hai ke jo shakhs raat ko uthay wuzu kare, kulli kare, phir sau sau baar SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah parhay us ke sab gunah maaf ho jate hain bajuz qatl-o-khoon ke ke woh maaf nahin hota. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Baqiyat-e-Salihat zikr-e-Allah hai aur La ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, SubhanAllah, walhamdulillah, tabarak Allah, wala haula wala quwwata illa billah, wastaghfirullah, wa sallallahu ala rasulillah hai aur roza, namaz, hajj, sadaqah, ghulamon ki azadi, jihad, silah-rehmi aur kul nekiyan yeh sab Baqiyat-e-Salihat hain jin ka sawab jannat walon ko jab tak aasman-o-zameen hain milta rehta hai. Farmate hain pakeeza kalam bhi isi mein dakhil hai. Hazrat Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain kul aamal-e-saliha isi mein dakhil hain. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) bhi isay mukhtar batlate hain.

Hayat-o-maut ka naqsha duniya apne zawal, fana, khatmay aur bardbari ke lihaz se misl-e-aasmani barish ke hai jo zameen ke danon waghera se milta hai aur hazarha poday lahlahanay lagtay hain, tar-o-tazgi aur zindagi ke aasar har cheez se zahir honay lagtay hain lekin kuch dinon ke guzartay hi woh sookh saakh kar chora chora hojatay hain, aur hawayein unhein dayein bayein uraye phirti hain. Is halat par Allah qadir tha woh is halat par bhi qadir hai. Umooman duniya ki misal barish se bayan farmayi jati hai jaise Surah Hadid ki aayat (Innama masalul hayatid dunya kama-in anzalnahu minas sama-i fakhtalata bihi nabatul ardi mimma ya-kulun nasu wal an-aam) (Surah Yunus: 24) mein aur jaise Surah Zumar ki aayat (Alam tara annallaha anzala minas sama-i ma-an fa-akhrajna bihi samaratim mukhtalifan alwanuha wa minal jibali judadum bidun wa humrum mukhtalifun alwanuha wa gharabibu sood) (Surah Fatir: 27) mein. Jaise Surah Hadid ki aayat (I'lamu annamal hayatad dunya la'ibun wa lahwun wa zeenatun wa tafakhurum bainakum wa takasurun fil amwali wal aulad kamasali ghaisin a'jabal kuffara nabatuhu summa yahiju fatarahu musfarran summa yakunu hutama, wa fil akhirati azabun shadid, wa maghfiratum minallahi wa ridwan, wa mal hayatud dunya illa mata'ul ghurur) (Surah Al-Hadid: 20) mein. Sahih hadith mein bhi hai, duniya sabz rang meethi hai al-kh. Phir farmata hai ke maal aur betay duniya ki zindagi ki zeenat hain jaise farmaya hai aayat (Zuyyina linnasi hubbush shahawati) al-kh, insaan ke liye khwahishon ki mohabbat maslan auratein, betay, khazanay waghera muzayyan kar di gayi hain. Aur aayat mein hai (Innama amwalukum wa auladukum fitnah, wallahu indahu ajrun azeem) (Surah At-Taghabun: 15) tumhare maal tumhari auladein fitna hain aur Allah ke paas ajr-e-azeem hai. Yani us ki taraf jhukna us ki ibadat mein mashghool rehna duniya talbi se behtar hai isi liye yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke baqiyat-e-salihat har lihaz se umda cheez hai. Maslan panchon waqt ki namazein aur dua (SubhanAllah, walhamdulillah, wala ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, aur La ilaha illallah, aur SubhanAllah, aur Alhamdulillah, aur Allahu Akbar, aur La haula wala quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azeem). Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ke ghulam farmatay hain ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ek martaba apne sathiyon mein bethay huay thay jo muazzin pohancha aap ne pani mangwaya ek bartan mein qareeb teen pao ke pani aaya, aap ne wuzu kar ke farmaya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi tarah wuzu kar ke farmaya jo mere is wuzu jaisa wuzu kar ke zuhr ki namaz ada kare to subah se le kar zuhr tak ke sab gunah maaf hojatay hain.

Phir Asr mein bhi isi tarah namaz parh li toh Zohar se Asr tak ke tamam gunah maaf, phir Maghrib ki namaz parhi toh Asr se Maghrib tak ke gunah maaf. Phir Isha ki namaz parhi toh Maghrib se Isha tak ke gunah maaf phir raat ko woh so raha subah uth kar namaz-e-Fajr ada ki toh Isha se le ke subah tak ke gunah maaf. Yehi woh nekiyan hain jo buraiyon ko door kar deti hain. Logon ne poocha yeh toh huin nekiyan ab ae Usman (R.A) aap batlaiye ke Baqiyat-e-Salihat kya hain? Aap ne farmaya dua (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wallahu Akbar wala haula wala quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azeem). Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) farmate hain Baqiyat-e-Salihat yeh hain dua (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar wala haula wala quwwata illa billah). Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab (R.H) ne apne shagird Amara (R.H) se poocha ke batao Baqiyat-e-Salihat kya hain? Unhon ne jawab diya ke namaz aur roza. Aap ne farmaya tum ne sahi jawab nahin diya unhon ne kaha Zakat aur Hajj farmaya abhi jawab theek nahin hua suno woh paanch kalmay hain dua (La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala haula wala quwwata illa billah). Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se sawal hua toh aap ne bajuz Alhamdulillah ke aur chaar kalmaat batlaye. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) bajuz La haula ke aur charon kalmaat batlate hain. Hasan (R.H) aur Qatadah (R.H) bhi in hi charon kalmaat ko Baqiyat-e-Salihat batlate hain. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dua (SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wala ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar) yeh hain Baqiyat-e-Salihat. Unhon ne jawab diya ke haan inkaar hai.
