Sab ke sab maidan-e-hashr mein Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ki holnakiyon ka zikr farma raha hai aur jab ta'ajjub-khez bade bade kaam us din honge un ka zikr kar raha hai ke aasman phat jayega go tumhein jame hue dikhayi dete hain lekin us din toh badalon ki tarah tezi se chal rahe honge. Aakhir rui ke galon ki tarah ho jayenge, zameen saaf chatil maidan ho jayegi jis mein koi oonch-neech tak baqi na rahegi na is mein koi makan hoga na chappar. Sari makhlooq baghair kisi aad ke Allah ke bilkul samne hogi. Koi bhi Malik se kisi jagah chup na sake ga, koi jaye-panah ya sar chupane ki jagah na hogi. Koi darakht, patthar, ghaas-phoos dikhayi na dega, tamam awwal-o-aakhir ke log jama honge, koi chota bada ghair-hazir na hoga, tamam agle pichle is muqarrar din jama kiye jayenge, us din sab log hazir-shuda honge aur sab maujood honge. Tamam log Allah ke samne saff-basta pesh honge, rooh aur farishte saffein bandhe hue khade honge, kisi ko baat karne ki bhi taab na hogi ke dekho jis tarah hum ne tumhein awwal baar paida kiya tha isi tarah dusri baar paida kar ke apne samne khada kar liya, is se pehle toh tum is ke qail na the. Nama-e-aamal samne kar diye jayenge aur afsos-o-ranj se kahenge ke haye hum ne apni umr kaisi ghaflat mein basar ki, afsos bad-kirdariyon mein lage rahe aur dekho toh is kitab ne ek mamla bhi aisa nahin choda jise likha na ho, chote bade tamam gunah is mein likhe hue hain. Tabrani mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Hunain se farigh ho kar hum chale, ek maidan mein manzil ki. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se farmaya jao jise koi lakdi, koi koda, koi ghaas-phoos mil jaye le aao, hum sab idhar udhar ho gaye, chaptiyan, chhaal, lakdi, patte, kante, darakht, jhaad, jhankar jo mila le aaye. Dher lag gaya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekh rahe ho? Isi tarah gunah jama ho kar dher lag jata hai, Allah se darte raho, chote bade gunahon se bacho kyunke sab likhe ja rahe hain aur shumar kiye ja rahe hain, jo khair-o-sharr, bhalai-burai jis kisi ne ki hogi use maujood payega jaise aayat (Yau-ma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30) aur aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13) aur aayat (Yauma tublas-sara-ir) (Surah At-Tariq: 9) mein hai tamam chupi hui baatein zahir ho jayengi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har bad-ahd ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda hoga us ki bad-ahdi ke mutabiq jis se us ki pehchan ho jayegi. Aur hadith mein hai ke yeh jhanda us ki ranon ke paas hoga aur elaan hoga ke yeh falan bin falan ki bad-ahdi hai. Tera Rabb aisa nahin ke makhlooq mein se kisi par bhi zulm kare, haan albatta darguzar karna, maaf farma dena, afw karna, yeh us ki sifat hai.

Haan badkaron ko apni qudrat-o-hikmat, adl-o-insaf se woh saza bhi deta hai, jahannam gunahgaron aur nafarmanon se bhar jaye, phir kafiron aur mushrikon ke siwa aur momin gunahgar chhoot jayenge. Allah Ta'ala ek zarre ke barabar bhi na-insafi nahin karta, nekiyon ko barhata hai, gunahon ko barabar hi rakhta hai, adl ka tarazu us din samne hoga, kisi ke sath koi bad-sulooki na hogi, al-kh. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain: Mujhe riwayat pahunchi ke ek shakhs ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek hadith suni hai jo woh bayan karte hain. Main ne is hadith ko khaas un se sunne ke liye ek oont khareeda, saman kas kar safar kiya, mahina bhar ke baad Sham mein un ke paas pahuncha to maloom hua ke woh Abdullah bin Unais (R.A) hain. Main ne darban se kaha jao khabar karo ke Jabir darwaze par hai. Unhon ne poocha kya Jabir bin Abdullah? (R.A) Main ne kaha ji haan. Yeh sunte hi, jaldi ke mare chadar sambhalte hue jhat se bahar aa gaye aur mujhe lipt gaye. Mo'aniqa se farigh ho kar main ne kaha mujhe yeh riwayat pahunchi ke aap ne qisas ke bare mein koi hadith Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai, to main ne chaha ke khud aap se main woh hadith sun loon, is liye yahan aaya aur sunte hi safar shuru kar diya is khauf se ke kahin is hadith ke sunne se pehle mar na jaaun ya aap ko maut na aa jaye. Ab aap sunaiye woh hadith kya hai? Aap ne farmaya main ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Allah Azza-o-Jal Qayamat ke din apne tamam bandon ka apne samne hashr karega, nange badan, be-khatna, be-saro-saman. Phir unhein nida karega jise door nazdeek wale sab yaksan sunenge, farmayega ke main Malik hoon, main badle dilwane wala hoon. Koi jahannami us waqt tak jahannam mein na jaye ga jab tak us ka jo haq kisi jannati ke zimme ho main na dilwa doon, aur na koi jannati jannat mein dakhil ho sakta hai jab tak us ka haq jo jahannami par hai main dilwa doon, go ek thappar hi ho. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh haq kaise dilwaye jayenge halankeh hum sab to wahan nange paon, nange badan, be-maal-o-asbab honge. Aap ne farmaya haan us din haq nekiyon aur buraiyon se ada kiye jayenge. Aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke be-seeng wali bakri ko agar seengon-dar bakri ne mara hai to us se bhi us ko badla dilwaya jayega. Is ke aur bhi bahut shahid hain jinhein hum ne bil-tafseel ayat (وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِيْنَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَـيْــــــًٔا 47؀) (21. Al-Anbiya: 47) ki tafseer mein aur ayat (اِلَّآ اُمَمٌ اَمْثَالُكُمْ ۭمَا فَرَّطْنَا فِي الْكِتٰبِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُوْنَ 38؀) (6. Al-An'am: 38) ki tafseer mein bayan kiye hain.

Sab ke sab maidan-e-hashr mein Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ki holnakiyon ka zikr farma raha hai aur jab ta'ajjub-khez bade bade kaam us din honge un ka zikr kar raha hai ke aasman phat jayega go tumhein jame hue dikhayi dete hain lekin us din toh badalon ki tarah tezi se chal rahe honge. Aakhir rui ke galon ki tarah ho jayenge, zameen saaf chatil maidan ho jayegi jis mein koi oonch-neech tak baqi na rahegi na is mein koi makan hoga na chappar. Sari makhlooq baghair kisi aad ke Allah ke bilkul samne hogi. Koi bhi Malik se kisi jagah chup na sake ga, koi jaye-panah ya sar chupane ki jagah na hogi. Koi darakht, patthar, ghaas-phoos dikhayi na dega, tamam awwal-o-aakhir ke log jama honge, koi chota bada ghair-hazir na hoga, tamam agle pichle is muqarrar din jama kiye jayenge, us din sab log hazir-shuda honge aur sab maujood honge. Tamam log Allah ke samne saff-basta pesh honge, rooh aur farishte saffein bandhe hue khade honge, kisi ko baat karne ki bhi taab na hogi ke dekho jis tarah hum ne tumhein awwal baar paida kiya tha isi tarah dusri baar paida kar ke apne samne khada kar liya, is se pehle toh tum is ke qail na the. Nama-e-aamal samne kar diye jayenge aur afsos-o-ranj se kahenge ke haye hum ne apni umr kaisi ghaflat mein basar ki, afsos bad-kirdariyon mein lage rahe aur dekho toh is kitab ne ek mamla bhi aisa nahin choda jise likha na ho, chote bade tamam gunah is mein likhe hue hain. Tabrani mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Hunain se farigh ho kar hum chale, ek maidan mein manzil ki. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se farmaya jao jise koi lakdi, koi koda, koi ghaas-phoos mil jaye le aao, hum sab idhar udhar ho gaye, chaptiyan, chhaal, lakdi, patte, kante, darakht, jhaad, jhankar jo mila le aaye. Dher lag gaya toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekh rahe ho? Isi tarah gunah jama ho kar dher lag jata hai, Allah se darte raho, chote bade gunahon se bacho kyunke sab likhe ja rahe hain aur shumar kiye ja rahe hain, jo khair-o-sharr, bhalai-burai jis kisi ne ki hogi use maujood payega jaise aayat (Yau-ma tajidu kullu nafsim ma amilat min khairim muhdara) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 30) aur aayat (Yunabba-ul-insanu yauma-izin bima qaddama wa akhkhar) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13) aur aayat (Yauma tublas-sara-ir) (Surah At-Tariq: 9) mein hai tamam chupi hui baatein zahir ho jayengi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har bad-ahd ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda hoga us ki bad-ahdi ke mutabiq jis se us ki pehchan ho jayegi. Aur hadith mein hai ke yeh jhanda us ki ranon ke paas hoga aur elaan hoga ke yeh falan bin falan ki bad-ahdi hai. Tera Rabb aisa nahin ke makhlooq mein se kisi par bhi zulm kare, haan albatta darguzar karna, maaf farma dena, afw karna, yeh us ki sifat hai.

Haan badkaron ko apni qudrat-o-hikmat, adl-o-insaf se woh saza bhi deta hai, jahannam gunahgaron aur nafarmanon se bhar jaye, phir kafiron aur mushrikon ke siwa aur momin gunahgar chhoot jayenge. Allah Ta'ala ek zarre ke barabar bhi na-insafi nahin karta, nekiyon ko barhata hai, gunahon ko barabar hi rakhta hai, adl ka tarazu us din samne hoga, kisi ke sath koi bad-sulooki na hogi, al-kh. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain: Mujhe riwayat pahunchi ke ek shakhs ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek hadith suni hai jo woh bayan karte hain. Main ne is hadith ko khaas un se sunne ke liye ek oont khareeda, saman kas kar safar kiya, mahina bhar ke baad Sham mein un ke paas pahuncha to maloom hua ke woh Abdullah bin Unais (R.A) hain. Main ne darban se kaha jao khabar karo ke Jabir darwaze par hai. Unhon ne poocha kya Jabir bin Abdullah? (R.A) Main ne kaha ji haan. Yeh sunte hi, jaldi ke mare chadar sambhalte hue jhat se bahar aa gaye aur mujhe lipt gaye. Mo'aniqa se farigh ho kar main ne kaha mujhe yeh riwayat pahunchi ke aap ne qisas ke bare mein koi hadith Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai, to main ne chaha ke khud aap se main woh hadith sun loon, is liye yahan aaya aur sunte hi safar shuru kar diya is khauf se ke kahin is hadith ke sunne se pehle mar na jaaun ya aap ko maut na aa jaye. Mohsin ko chhor kar dushman se dosti bayan ho raha hai ke Iblees tumhara balkay tumhare asli baap Hazrat Adam A.S ka bhi qadeemi dushman raha hai. Apne Khaliq-o-Malik ko chhor kar tumhein us ki baat na manni chahiye. Allah ke ehsan-o-ikram, us ke lutf-o-karam ko dekho ke isi ne tumhein paida kiya, pala posa, phir usay chhor kar us ke balkay apne bhi dushman ko dost banana kis qadar khatarnak ghalti hai? Is ki poori tafseer Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuki hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida kar ke tamam farishton ko bator un ki tashreef, tazeem aur takreem ke samne sajda karne ka hukum diya. Sab ne hukum bardari ki lekin chunke Iblees bad-asal tha, aag se paida shuda tha, us ne inkar kar diya aur fasiq ban gaya. Farishton ki paidaish noorani thi. Sahih Muslim Shareef ki hadith mein hai ke farishtay noor se paida kiye gaye hain, Iblees sholay maarne wali aag se aur Adam A.S us se jis ka bayan tumhare samne kar diya gaya hai. Zahir hai ke har cheez apni asliyat par aa jati hai aur waqt par bartan mein jo ho wohi tapakta hai. Go Iblees farishton ke se aamal kar raha tha, unhi ki mushabahat karta tha aur Allah ki raza-mandi mein din raat mashghool tha, isi liye un ke khitab mein yeh bhi aa gaya lekin yeh suntay hi woh apni asliyat par aa gaya, takabbur us ki tabiyat mein sama gaya aur saaf inkar kar baitha. Us ki paidaish hi aag se thi jaise us ne khud kaha ke tu ne mujhe aag se banaya aur isay mitti se. Iblees kabhi bhi farishton mein se na tha, woh jinnaat ki asal hai jaise ke Hazrat Adam A.S insaan ki asal hain. Yeh bhi manqool hai ke yeh jinnaat ki ek qisam thi jo farishton ki tez aag ke sholay se thi. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Iblees shareef farishton mein se tha aur buzurg qabeelay ka tha, jannaton ka darogha tha, aasman-e-dunya ka badshah tha, zameen ka bhi sultan tha, is se kuch us ke dil mein ghamand aa gaya tha ke woh tamam ahl-e-aasman se shareef hai. Woh ghamand zahir ho gaya, az-roo-e-takabbur ke saaf inkar kar diya aur kafiron mein ja mila. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain woh jin tha yani jannat ka khazin tha jaise logon ko shehron ki taraf nisbat kar dete hain aur kehte hain Makki, Madani, Basri, Kufi. Yeh jannat ka khazin aasman-e-dunya ke kamon ka mudabbir tha, yahan ke farishton ka raees tha. Is masiyat se pehle woh malaika mein dakhil tha lekin zameen par rehta tha. Sab farishton se zyada koshish se ibadat karne wala aur sab se zyada ilm wala tha, isi wajah se phool gaya tha. Us ke qabeelay ka naam jin tha, aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan aamad-o-raft rakhta tha. Rabb ki nafarmani se ghazab mein aa gaya aur Shaitan-e-Rajeem ban gaya aur maloon ho gaya. Pas mutakabbir shakhs se tauba ki umeed nahin ho sakti, haan takabbur na ho aur koi gunah sarzad ho jaye to us se na-umeed na hona chahiye. Kehte hain ke yeh to jannat ke andar kaam-kaaj karne walon mein tha. Salaf ke aur bhi is bare mein bohat se aasar marwi hain lekin yeh aksar-beshtar Bani Israeli hain, sirf is liye naqal kiye gaye hain ke nigah se guzar jayen. Allah hi ko in ke aksar ka sahih haal maloom hai.

Haan Bani Israel ki riwayatein woh toh qatan qabil-e-tardeed hain jo hamare yahan ke dalail ke khilaf hon. Baat yeh hai ke hamein toh Quran kafi-o-wafi hai, hamein agli kitabon ki baton ki koi zaroorat nahin, hum un se mehez be-niyaz hain. Is liye ke woh tabdeel, tarmeem, kami-beshi se khali nahin, bahut si banawati cheezein un mein dakhil ho gayi hain aur aise log un mein nahin paye jate jo aala darje ke hafiz hon ke mail-kuchail door kar dein, khara khota parakh lein, ziyadati aur batil ke milane walon ki daal na galne dein jaise ke Allah Rahman ne is ummat mein apne fazl-o-karam se aise imam aur ulama aur sadat aur buzurg aur muttaqi aur pakbaz aur huffaz paida kiye hain jinhon ne ahadees ko jama kiya, tehrer kiya. Sahih, Hasan, Zaeef, Munkar, Matrook, Mauzoo sab ko alag alag kar dikhaya ya gharne walon, banane walon, jhoot bolne walon ko chhant kar alag khara kar diya taake Khatam-ul-Mursaleen-al-Aalameen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka pak aur mubarak kalam mehfooz reh sake aur batil se bach sake aur kisi ka bas na chale ke aap ke naam se jhoot ko riwaj de le aur batil ko haq mein mila de. Pas hamari dua hai ke is kul tabqa par Allah Ta'ala apni rehmat-o-raza mandi nazil farmaye aur un sab se khush rahe, Ameen! Ameen! Allah unhein Jannat-ul-Firdous naseeb farmaye aur yaqeenan un se dosti na karo aur mujhe chhor kar us se talluq na joro. Zalimon ko bada bura badla milega. Yeh maqam bhi bilkul aisa hi hai jaise Surah Yaseen mein qayamat, us ki holnakiyon aur nek-o-bad logon ke natijon ka zikr kar ke farmaya ke ae mujrimon tum aaj ke din alag ho jao, al-kh. Allah ke siwa sab hi be-ikhtiyar hain jinhein tum Allah ke siwa Allah banaye hue ho woh sab tum jaise hi mere ghulam hain. Kisi cheez ki malkiyat unhein hasil nahin. Zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein main ne unhein shamil nahin rakha tha balkeh us waqt woh majood bhi na thay tamam cheezon ko sirf main ne hi paida kiya hai. Sab ki tadbeer sirf mere hi hath hai. Mera koi shareek, wazeer, musheer, nazeer nahin. Jaise aur ayat mein farmaya (Qulid-u-allazeena za'amtum min doonillahi la yamlikoona misqala zarratin fis-samawati wa la fil-ardi wa ma lahum feehima min shirkin wa ma lahu minhum min zaheer) (Surah Saba: 22), jin jin ko tum apne guman mein kuch samajh rahe ho sab ko hi siwa Allah ke pukar kar dekh lo yaad rakho unhein aasman-o-zameen mein kisi ek zarre ke barabar bhi ikhtiyarat hasil nahin na un ka un mein koi sajha hai na un mein se koi Allah ka madadgar hai. Na un mein se koi shafa'at kar sakta hai, jab tak Allah ki ijazat na ho jaye al-kh. Mujhe yeh laiq nahin na is ki zaroorat ke kisi ko khusoosan gumrah karne walon ko apna dast-o-bazu aur madadgar banaun.

Apne Khaliq-o-Malik ko chhor kar tumhein us ki baat na manni chahiye. Allah ke ehsan-o-ikram, us ke lutf-o-karam ko dekho ke isi ne tumhein paida kiya, pala posa, phir usay chhor kar us ke balkay apne bhi dushman ko dost banana kis qadar khatarnak ghalti hai? Is ki poori tafseer Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein guzar chuki hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko paida kar ke tamam farishton ko bator un ki tashreef, tazeem aur takreem ke samne sajda karne ka hukum diya. Sab ne hukum bardari ki lekin chunke Iblees bad-asal tha, aag se paida shuda tha, us ne inkar kar diya aur fasiq ban gaya. Farishton ki paidaish noorani thi. Sahih Muslim Shareef ki hadith mein hai ke farishtay noor se paida kiye gaye hain, Iblees sholay maarne wali aag se aur Adam A.S us se jis ka bayan tumhare samne kar diya gaya hai. Zahir hai ke har cheez apni asliyat par aa jati hai aur waqt par bartan mein jo ho wohi tapakta hai. Go Iblees farishton ke se aamal kar raha tha, unhi ki mushabahat karta tha aur Allah ki raza-mandi mein din raat mashghool tha, isi liye un ke khitab mein yeh bhi aa gaya lekin yeh suntay hi woh apni asliyat par aa gaya, takabbur us ki tabiyat mein sama gaya aur saaf inkar kar baitha. Us ki paidaish hi aag se thi jaise us ne khud kaha ke tu ne mujhe aag se banaya aur isay mitti se. Iblees kabhi bhi farishton mein se na tha, woh jinnaat ki asal hai jaise ke Hazrat Adam A.S insaan ki asal hain. Yeh bhi manqool hai ke yeh jinnaat ki ek qisam thi jo farishton ki tez aag ke sholay se thi. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Iblees shareef farishton mein se tha aur buzurg qabeelay ka tha, jannaton ka darogha tha, aasman-e-dunya ka badshah tha, zameen ka bhi sultan tha, is se kuch us ke dil mein ghamand aa gaya tha ke woh tamam ahl-e-aasman se shareef hai. Woh ghamand zahir ho gaya, az-roo-e-takabbur ke saaf inkar kar diya aur kafiron mein ja mila. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain woh jin tha yani jannat ka khazin tha jaise logon ko shehron ki taraf nisbat kar dete hain aur kehte hain Makki, Madani, Basri, Kufi. Yeh jannat ka khazin aasman-e-dunya ke kamon ka mudabbir tha, yahan ke farishton ka raees tha. Is masiyat se pehle woh malaika mein dakhil tha lekin zameen par rehta tha. Sab farishton se zyada koshish se ibadat karne wala aur sab se zyada ilm wala tha, isi wajah se phool gaya tha. Us ke qabeelay ka naam jin tha, aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan aamad-o-raft rakhta tha. Rabb ki nafarmani se ghazab mein aa gaya aur Shaitan-e-Rajeem ban gaya aur maloon ho gaya. Pas mutakabbir shakhs se tauba ki umeed nahin ho sakti, haan takabbur na ho aur koi gunah sarzad ho jaye to us se na-umeed na hona chahiye. Kehte hain ke yeh to jannat ke andar kaam-kaaj karne walon mein tha. Salaf ke aur bhi is bare mein bohat se aasar marwi hain lekin yeh aksar-beshtar Bani Israeli hain, sirf is liye naqal kiye gaye hain ke nigah se guzar jayen. Allah hi ko in ke aksar ka sahih haal maloom hai.

Haan Bani Israel ki riwayatein woh toh qatan qabil-e-tardeed hain jo hamare yahan ke dalail ke khilaf hon. Baat yeh hai ke hamein toh Quran kafi-o-wafi hai, hamein agli kitabon ki baton ki koi zaroorat nahin, hum un se mehez be-niyaz hain. Is liye ke woh tabdeel, tarmeem, kami-beshi se khali nahin, bahut si banawati cheezein un mein dakhil ho gayi hain aur aise log un mein nahin paye jate jo aala darje ke hafiz hon ke mail-kuchail door kar dein, khara khota parakh lein, ziyadati aur batil ke milane walon ki daal na galne dein jaise ke Allah Rahman ne is ummat mein apne fazl-o-karam se aise imam aur ulama aur sadat aur buzurg aur muttaqi aur pakbaz aur huffaz paida kiye hain jinhon ne ahadees ko jama kiya, tehrer kiya. Sahih, Hasan, Zaeef, Munkar, Matrook, Mauzoo sab ko alag alag kar dikhaya ya gharne walon, banane walon, jhoot bolne walon ko chhant kar alag khara kar diya taake Khatam-ul-Mursaleen-al-Aalameen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka pak aur mubarak kalam mehfooz reh sake aur batil se bach sake aur kisi ka bas na chale ke aap ke naam se jhoot ko riwaj de le aur batil ko haq mein mila de. Pas hamari dua hai ke is kul tabqa par Allah Ta'ala apni rehmat-o-raza mandi nazil farmaye aur un sab se khush rahe, Ameen! Ameen! Allah unhein Jannat-ul-Firdous naseeb farmaye aur yaqeenan un se dosti na karo aur mujhe chhor kar us se talluq na joro. Zalimon ko bada bura badla milega. Yeh maqam bhi bilkul aisa hi hai jaise Surah Yaseen mein qayamat, us ki holnakiyon aur nek-o-bad logon ke natijon ka zikr kar ke farmaya ke ae mujrimon tum aaj ke din alag ho jao, al-kh. Allah ke siwa sab hi be-ikhtiyar hain jinhein tum Allah ke siwa Allah banaye hue ho woh sab tum jaise hi mere ghulam hain. Kisi cheez ki malkiyat unhein hasil nahin. Zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein main ne unhein shamil nahin rakha tha balkeh us waqt woh majood bhi na thay tamam cheezon ko sirf main ne hi paida kiya hai. Sab ki tadbeer sirf mere hi hath hai. Mera koi shareek, wazeer, musheer, nazeer nahin. Jaise aur ayat mein farmaya (Qulid-u-allazeena za'amtum min doonillahi la yamlikoona misqala zarratin fis-samawati wa la fil-ardi wa ma lahum feehima min shirkin wa ma lahu minhum min zaheer) (Surah Saba: 22), jin jin ko tum apne guman mein kuch samajh rahe ho sab ko hi siwa Allah ke pukar kar dekh lo yaad rakho unhein aasman-o-zameen mein kisi ek zarre ke barabar bhi ikhtiyarat hasil nahin na un ka un mein koi sajha hai na un mein se koi Allah ka madadgar hai. Na un mein se koi shafa'at kar sakta hai, jab tak Allah ki ijazat na ho jaye al-kh. Mujhe yeh laiq nahin na is ki zaroorat ke kisi ko khusoosan gumrah karne walon ko apna dast-o-bazu aur madadgar banaun.

Mushrik Qayamat ko sharminda honge. Tamam mushrikon ko Qayamat ke din sharminda karne ke liye sab ke samne kaha jaye ga ke apne shareekon ko pukaro jinhein tum duniya mein pukarte rahe taake woh tumhein aaj ke din ki museebat se bacha lein. Woh pukarenge lekin kahin se koi jawab na payenge. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Walaqad ji'tumuna furada kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin wa taraktum ma khawwalnakum wara'a zuhurikum) (Surah Al-An'am: 94). Hum tumhein isi tarah tanha tanha laye jaise ke hum ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya tha, ab tumhare sath un shareekon mein se kisi ek ko bhi nahin dekhte jinhein tum shareek-e-Ilahi thahraye hue the aur jin ki shafa'at ka yaqeen kiye hue the. Tumhare aur un ke darmiyan mein ta'alluqat toot gaye aur tumhare guman batil sabit ho chuke. Aur aayat mein hai (Wa qeela ud'u shuraka'akum fada'auhum falam yastajeebu lahum wa ra'awul-azaba law annahum kanu yahtadoon) (Surah Al-Qasas: 64). Kaha jaye ga ke apne shareekon ko pukaro, yeh pukarenge lekin woh jawab na denge, al-kh. Isi mazmoon ko aayat 'Wa man adhallu' se do aayaton tak bayan farmaya hai. Surah Maryam mein irshad hai ke unhon ne apni izzat ke liye Allah ke siwa aur bohat mabood bana rakhe hain, lekin aisa hargiz nahin hoga, woh to sab un ki ibadat ke munkir ho jayenge aur ulte un ke dushman ban jayenge. Un mein aur un ke maboodan-e-batil mein hum aar, hijab aur halakat ka garha bana denge taake yeh un se aur woh un se na mil sakein. Nek raah aur gumrah alag alag rahen, Jahannam ki yeh wadi unhein aapas mein milne na degi. Kehte hain yeh wadi lahu aur peep ki hogi, un mein aapas mein us din dushmani ho jayegi. Ba-zahir maloom hota hai ke murad is se halakat hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Jahannam ki koi wadi bhi ho ya aur koi faasle ki wadi ho, maqsood yeh hai ke un aabidon ko na mabood jawab tak na denge na yeh aapas mein ek dusre se mil sakenge, kyunke un ke darmiyan halakat hogi aur holnak umoor honge. Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ne kaha hai murad yeh hai ke mushrikon aur musalmanon mein hum aar kar denge. Jaise aayat (Wa yawma taqumus-sa'atu yawma'izin yatafarraqoon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 14) aur aayat (Faqim wajhaka lid-deenil-qayyimi min qabli ay-ya'tiya yawmul-la maradda lahu minallahi yawma'izin yassadda'oon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 43) aur aayat (Wamtazul-yawma ayyuhal-mujrimoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 59) aur aayat (Wa yawma nahshuruhum jamee'an summa naqulu lillazeena ashraku ayna shuraka'ukumullazeena kuntum taz'umoon) (Surah Al-An'am: 22) waghera mein hai. Yeh gunahgar Jahannam dekh lenge. Sattar hazar lagamon mein woh jakri hui hogi, har ek lagam par sattar sattar hazar farishte honge. Dekhte hi samajh lenge ke hamara qaid-khana yahi hai. Dakhle ke baghair dakhle se bhi zyada ranj-o-gham aur museebat-o-alam shuru ho jayega.

Azab ka yaqeen azab se pehle ka azab hum lekin koi chutkare ki raah na payenge koi nijaat ki surat nazar na aayegi. Hadith mein hai ke paanch hazaar saal tak kafir isi tharthari mein rahega ke jahannam uske saamne aur uska kaleja qabu se bahar hai.

Har baat saaf saaf keh di gayi. Insaanon ke liye hum ne is apni kitab mein har baat ka bayan khoob khol khol kar bayan kar diya hai taake log rah-e-haq se na behkein, hidayat ki rah se na bhatkein, lekin bawajood is bayan, is furqan ke phir bhi bajuz rah-yafta logon ke aur tamam ke tamam rah-e-najat se hate hue hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Hazrat Fatima (R.A) aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke paas un ke makan mein aaye aur farmaya tum soye hue ho, namaz mein nahin ho? Is par Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne jawab diya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hamari jaanein Allah ke haath mein hain, woh jab hamein uthana chahta hai utha bithaata hai. Aap (ﷺ) yeh sun kar baghair kuch farmaye laut gaye lekin apni zaano par haath maarte hue yeh farmate hue ja rahe the ke insaan tamam cheezon se zyada jhagralu hai.

Azab-e-Ilahi ke muntazir kuffar agle zamane ke aur is waqt ke kafiron ki sarkashi bayan ho rahi hai ke haq wazeh ho chukne ke baad bhi uski tabedari se ruke rehte hain. Chahte hain ke Allah ke azabon ko apni aankhon dekh lein, kisi ne tamanna ki ke aasman hum par gir pade, kisi ne kaha ke la jo azab la sakta hai le aa. Quraish ne bhi kaha, "Aye Allah! Agar yeh haq hai to hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya koi aur dardnak azab humein kar." Unhon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke, "Aye Nabi! Hum to tujhe majnoon jante hain aur agar filwaqay tu saccha Nabi hai to hamare samne farishte kyun nahin lata?" Waghaira waghaira. Pas azab-e-Ilahi ke intezar mein rehte hain aur uske mu'aine ke darpay rehte hain. Rasoolon ka kaam to sirf mominon ko basharatein dena aur kafiron ko dara dena hai. Kafir log na-haq ki hujatein kar ke haq ko apni jagah se phisla dena chahte hain lekin unki yeh chahat kabhi poori nahin hogi, haq unki batil baton se dabne wala nahin. Yeh meri aayaton aur darawne ki baton ko khali mazak samajh rahe hain aur apni be-imani mein badh rahe hain.

Bad tareen shakhs kaun hai? Fi-al-haqiqat is se barh kar paapi kaun hai? Jis ke samne us ke palne posne wale ka kalam parha jaye aur woh us ki taraf iltifat tak na kare, us se manos na ho, balkeh munh pher kar inkar kar jaye aur bad-amliyan aur siyah-kariyan us se pehle ki hain unhein bhi faramosh kar jaye. Is dhitai ki saza yeh hoti hai ke dilon par parde par jate hain, phir Quran-o-bayan ka samajhna naseeb nahin hota, kanon mein girani ho jati hai, bhali baat ki taraf tawajjah nahin rehti, ab lakh dawat-e-hidayat do lekin rah-yabi mushkil-o-muhal hai. Ae Nabi! Tera Rab bara hi meharban, bahut aala rahmat wala hai. Agar woh gunahgar ki saza jaldi hi kar dala karta, toh zameen par koi jandar baqi na bachta. Woh logon ke zulm se darguzar kar raha hai lekin is se yeh na samjha jaye ke pakre ga hi nahin. Yaad rakho woh sakht azabon wala hai. Yeh toh us ka hilm hai, parda-poshi hai, maafi hai taake gumrahi wale rah-e-rast par aa jayen, gunahon wale tauba kar len aur us ke daman-e-rahmat ko tham len. Lekin jis ne is hilm se faida uthaya aur apni sarkashi par jama raha toh us ki pakar ka din qareeb hai, jo itna sakht din hoga ke bachay boorhay ho jayen ge, hamal gir jayen ge, us din koi jaye-panah na hogi, koi chutkare ki surat na hogi. Yeh hain tum se pehle ki ummatein ke woh bhi tumhari tarah kufr-o-inkar mein par gayin aur aakhirash mita di gayin, un ki halakat ka muqarrara waqt aa pohancha aur woh tabah-o-barbad ho gayin. Pas ae munkiro! Tum bhi darte raho, tum Ashraf-ur-Rusul (ﷺ) hi ko sata rahe aur unhein jhutla rahe ho, halankeh agle kuffar se tum quwwat-o-taqat mein, saman-o-asbab mein bahut kam ho. Mere azabon se daro, meri baton se nasihat pakro.

Hazrat Musa A.S aur Allah ka ek banda. Hazrat Musa A.S se zikr kiya gaya ke Allah ka ek banda do darya milne ki jagah hai, us ke paas woh ilm hai jo tumhein hasil nahin. Aap ne usi waqt un se mulaqat karne ki thaan li. Ab apne saathi se farmate hain ke main toh pahunche baghair dam na loonga. Kehte hain yeh do samundar ek toh Bahira-e-Fars mashriqi aur dusra Bahira-e-Room maghribi hai. Yeh jagah Tanja ke paas maghrib ke shehron ke aakhir mein hai, wallahu aalam. Toh farmate hain ke go mujhe qarnon tak chalna pade koi harj nahin. Kehte hain ke Qais ki lughat mein baras ko huqab kehte hain. Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain, huqab se murad assi baras hain. Mujahid R.H sattar baras kehte hain. Ibn Abbas R.A zamana batlate hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hukum mila tha ke apne saath namak chadhee hui ek machhli lein, jahan woh gum ho jaye wahin hamara banda milega. Yeh dono machhli ko saath liye chale, Majma-ul-Bahrain mein pahunch gaye. Wahan Nehr-e-Hayat thi, wahin dono lait gaye. Us nehr ke pani ke chheente machhli par pade, machhli hilne julne lag gayi. Aap ke saath Hazrat Yusha A.S ki zanbeel mein yeh machhli rakhi hui thi aur woh samundar ke kinare tha. Machhli ne samundar ke andar kood jaane ke liye just lagayi aur Hazrat Yusha ki aankh khul gayi. Machhli un ke dekhte hue pani mein gayi aur pani mein seedha soorakh hota chala gaya, pas jis tarah zameen mein soorakh aur surang ban jati hai, isi tarah pani mein jahan se woh gayi soorakh ho gaya, idhar udhar pani khada ho gaya aur woh soorakh bilkul khula hua raha. Patthar ki tarah pani mein chhed ho gaya, jahan jis pani ko lagti hui woh machhli gayi wahan ka woh pani patthar jaisa ho gaya aur woh soorakh banta chala gaya. Muhammad bin Ishaq marfoo'an laye hain ke Huzoor ﷺ is baat ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke pani is tarah ibtida-e-duniya se nahin jama siwaye us machhli ke chale jaane ki jagah ke ird-gird ke pani ke. Yeh nishan misl soorakh-e-zameen ke barabar Musa A.S ke wapas pahunchne tak baqi hi rahe. Is nishan ko dekhte hi Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki talash mein toh hum thay. Jab machhli ko bhool kar yeh dono aage badhe. Yahan yeh baat yaad rakhne ki hai ke ek ka kaam dono sathiyon ki taraf mansoob hua hai. Bhoolne wale sirf Yusha thay. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yakhruju minhuma al-lu'lu'u wal-marjan) yani in dono samundaron mein se moti aur moongay nikalte hain. Halankeh do qaulon mein se ek yeh hai ke lu'lu aur marjan sirf khari pani mein se nikalte hain. Jab wahan se ek marhala aur tay kar gaye toh Hazrat Musa A.S ne apne saathi se nashta talab kiya aur safar ki takleef bhi bayan ki, yeh takleef maqsood se aage nikal aane ke baad hui. Is par aap ke saathi ko machhli ka chala jana yaad aaya aur kaha jis chattan ke paas hum thehre thay us waqt main machhli bhool gaya aur aap se zikr karna bhi Shaitan ne yaad se hata diya. Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat "an adhkurahu" hai. Farmate hain ke is machhli ne toh ajeeb-o-ghareeb taur par pani mein apni raah pakdi.

Usi waqt Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya lo aur suno isi jagah ki talash mein hum thay toh woh dono apne raaste par apne nishanat-e-qadam ke khoj par wapas lautay. Wahan hamare bandon mein se ek banday ko paya jisay hum ne apne paas ki rahmat aur apne paas ka ilm ata farma rakha tha. Yeh Hazrat Khizr A.S hain. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se kaha ke Hazrat Nauf ka khayal hai ke Khizr A.S se milne wale Musa, Bani Israel ke Musa na thay. Ibn Abbas R.A ne farmaya woh dushman-e-Rab jhoota hai, hum se Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne farmaya hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se unhon ne suna ke Hazrat Musa A.S kharay ho kar Bani Israel mein khutba kar rahe thay jo aap se sawal hua ke sab se bada aalim kaun hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke main. Toh chunke aap ne is ke jawab mein yeh na farmaya ke Allah janay is liye Rab ko yeh kalma na-pasand aaya, usi waqt wahi aayi ke haan Majma-ul-Bahrain mein hamara ek banda hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai. Is par Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya phir Parwardigar main us tak kaisay pahunch sakta hoon? Hukm hua ke apne sath ek machli rakh lo usay toshay-daan mein daal lo jahan woh machli gum ho jaye wahin woh mil jayenge. Toh aap apne sath apne sathi Yusha bin Nun A.S ko le kar chalay, pathar ke paas pahunch kar apne sar us par rakh kar do ghari so rahay. Machli us toshay-daan mein tarpi aur kood kar us se nikal gayi, samundar mein aisi gayi jaise koi surang laga kar zameen mein utar gaya ho, pani ka chalna behna Allah Ta'ala ne mauqoof kar diya aur taaq ki tarah woh surakh baqi reh gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S jab jaagay toh aap ke sathi yeh zikr aap se bhool gaye, usi waqt wahan se chal paray, din poora honay ke baad raat bhar chaltay rahay, subah Hazrat Musa A.S ko thakan aur bhook mehsoos hui, Allah ne jahan janay ka hukm diya tha jab tak wahan se aagay na nikal gaye thakan ka naam tak na tha, ab aap ne sathi se khana manga aur takleef bayan ki, us waqt aap ke sathi ne farmaya ke pathar ke paas jab hum ne aaram liya tha wahin usi waqt machli toh main bhool gaya aur is ke zikr ko bhi Shaitan ne bhula diya aur is machli ne toh samundar mein ajeeb taur par apni raah nikal li. Machli ke liye surang ban gayi aur un ke liye hairat ka baais ban gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki toh talash thi, chunancha apne nishan-e-qadam dekhte hue dono wapas huay, usi pathar ke paas pahunchay dekha ke ek sahib kapron mein liptay huay baithay hain. Aap ne salam kiya, us ne kaha ta'ajjub hai aap ki sar-zameen mein yeh salam kahan? Aap ne farmaya main Musa hoon, unhon ne poocha kya Bani Israel ke Musa? Aap ne farmaya haan aur main is liye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe woh sikhayen jo bhalai aap ko Allah ki taraf se sikhayi gayi hai. Aap ne farmaya Musa A.S aap mere sath sabr nahin kar sakte. Is liye ke mujhe jo ilm hai woh aap ko nahin aur aap ko jo ilm hai woh mujhe nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne dono ko judagana ilm ata farma rakha hai.

Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya Insha'Allah aap dekhenge ke main sabr karunga aur aap ke kisi farman ki nafarmani na karunga. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya achha agar tum mera saath chahte ho to mujh se khud kisi baat ka sawal na karna yahan tak ke main aap ko is ki babat khabardar karun. Itni baatein tay kar ke dono saath chale darya ke kinare ek kashti thi un se apne saath le jaane ki baat cheet karne lage unhon ne Khizr A.S ko pehchan liya aur baghair kiraya liye dono ko sawar kar liya. Kuch hi door chale honge ke Hazrat Musa A.S ne dekha ke Khizr A.S chup chap kashti ke takhte kulhare se tod rahe hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya yeh kya? In logon ne to hamare saath ehsan kiya baghair kiraya liye kashti mein sawar kiya aur aap ne is ke takhte todne shuru kar diye jis se tamam ahl-e-kashti doob jayen yeh to bada hi na-khushgawar kaam karne lage. Isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho main ne to tum se pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Musa A.S ma'zrat karne lage ke khata ho gayi bhoole se pooch baitha maaf farmaiye aur sakhti na kijiye. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain waqai yeh pehli ghalti bhool se hi thi farmate hain kashti ke ek takhte par ek chidiya aa baithi aur samundar mein chonch daal kar pani le kar ud gayi, us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne Hazrat Musa A.S se farmaya mere aur tere ilm ne Allah ke ilm mein se utna hi kam kiya hai jitna pani samundar mein se is chidiya ki chonch ne kam kiya hai. Ab kashti kinare lagi aur sahil par dono chalne lage ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ki nigah chand khelte hue bachon par padi un mein se ek bache ka sar pakad kar Hazrat Khizr A.S ne is tarah marod diya ke isi waqt us ka dam nikal gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ghabra gaye aur farmane lage baghair kisi qatl ke is bache ko aap ne na-haq maar dala? Aap ne bada hi munkar kaam kiya. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho isi ko main ne pehle hi se keh diya tha ke tumhari hamari nibh nahin sakti us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne pehle se zyada sakhti ki. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya achha ab agar main koi sawal kar baithun to beshak aap mujhe apne saath na rakhna yaqeenan ab aap ma'zoor ho gaye, chunancha phir dono hamrah chale ek basti walon ke paas pahunche un se khana manga lekin unhon ne un ki mehmandari se saaf inkar kar diya, wahin ek deewar dekhi jo jhuk gayi thi aur girne ke qareeb thi, isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne haath laga kar use theek aur durust kar diya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya khayal to farmaiye hum yahan aaye in logon se khana talab kiya unhon ne na diya mehman nawazi ke khilaf kiya un ka yeh kaam tha aap in se ujrat le sakte the. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya yeh hai mujh mein aur tum mein judai ab main tumhein in kamon ki asliyat batla dunga. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain kaash ke Hazrat Musa A.S sabr se kaam lete to in dono ki aur bhi bahut si baatein hamare samne Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qira'at mein 'wa kana wara'ahum' ke badle 'wa kana amamahum' hai aur 'safinatin' ke baad 'salihatan' ka lafz bhi hai aur 'wa ammal ghulamu' ke baad 'fa kana kafiran' ke lafz bhi hain. Aur sanad se bhi yeh hadith marwi hai is mein hai ke is patthar ke paas Hazrat Musa A.S ruk gaye wahin ek chashma tha jis ka naam 'Nahr-e-Hayat' tha is ka pani jis cheez ko lag jata hai woh zinda ho jati thi. Is mein chiriya ki chonch ka pani is samundar ke muqable mein, al-kh. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ke ghar mein un ke paas tha aap ne farmaya ke jis ko jo sawal karna ho kar le main ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe aap par fida kare Kufe mein ek wa'iz hain jin ka naam Nauf hai phir puri hadith bayan ki jaisa ke upar guzri is mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ke is khutbe se aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dilon mein narmi aa gayi thi, jab aap jaane lage to ek shakhs aap ke paas pahuncha aur us ne sawal kiya ke roo-e-zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin is par Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko itaab kiya kyunke unhon ne Allah ki taraf ilm ko na lautaya is mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne nishan talab kiya to irshad hua ke ek machhli apne saath rakh lo jis jagah is mein rooh parh jaye wahin par aap ki is shakhs se mulaqat ho gayi. Chunancha aap ne machhli li zanbeel mein rakh li aur apne saathi se kaha aap ka sirf itna hi kaam hai ke jahan machhli aap ke paas se chali jaye wahan aap mujhe khabar kar dena unhon ne kaha yeh to bilkul aasaan si baat hai. Un ka naam Yusha bin Noon tha. 'Laftan' se yahi murad hai. Yeh dono buzurg tar jagah mein ek darakht tale the Hazrat Musa A.S ko neend aa gayi thi aur Hazrat Yusha jaag rahe the jo machhli kood gayi unhon ne khayal kiya ke jagana to theek nahin jab aankh khule gi zikr kar doon ga. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke pani mein jaane ke waqt jo soorakh ho gaya tha use rawi-e-hadith Amr ne apne angoothe aur us ke paas ki dono ungliyon ka halqa kar ke dikhaya ke is tarah ka tha jaise patthar mein hota hai. Wapsi par Hazrat Khizr A.S samundar ke kinare sabz gaddi bichaye mile ek chadar mein lipte hue the is ka ek sira to dono pairon ke neeche rakha hua tha aur dusra kinara sar tale tha, Hazrat Musa A.S ke salam par aap ne munh khola. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya ke aap ke haath mein Taurat maujood hai wahi aasman se aa rahi hai kya yeh bas nahin? Aur mera ilm aap ke laiq bhi nahin aur na main aap ke ilm ke qabil hoon. Is mein hai ke kashti ka takhta tor kar aap ne ek taant se baandh diya tha. Pehli dafa ka aap ka sawal to bhoole se hi tha dusri martaba ka bator-e-shart ke tha haan teesri baar ka sawal qasdan alaihadgi ki wajah se tha. Is mein hai ke larkon mein ek larka tha kafir hoshiyar use Hazrat Khizr ne lita kar chhuri se zibah kar diya ek qira'at mein 'zakiyatan muslimatan' bhi hai.

Wara'ahum ki qira'at imamahum bhi hai. Is zalim badshah ka naam is mein Hado bin Bado hai aur jis bachay ko qatl kiya gaya tha us ka naam Jesoor tha. Kehte hain ke is larkay ke badlay un ke yahan ek larki hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) khutba kar rahe thay aur farmaya ke Allah ko aur us ke Amr-e-Ilahi ko mujh se zyada koi nahin janta. Al-kh. Yeh Nauf Ka'ab (R.A) ki biwi ke larkay ka qaul tha ke jis Musa ka in ayaton mein zikr hai yeh Musa bin Mesha thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke ae Allah agar tere bandon mein mujh se bada aalim koi ho to mujhe aagah farma, is mein hai ke namak charhi hui machli aap ne apne sath rakhi thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ne farmaya tum yahan kyun aaye? Aap ko to abhi Bani Israel mein hi mashghool-e-kaar rehna hai. Is mein hai ke chupi hui baatein Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ko maloom karayi jati thin to aap ne farmaya ke tum mere sath theher nahin sakte kyunke aap to zahir ko dekh kar faisla karenge aur mujhe raaz par ittila hoti hai, chunancha shart ho gayi ke go aap kaisa hi khilaf dekhein lekin lab na hilayein jab tak ke Hazrat Khizr khud na batlayein. Kehte hain ke yeh kashti tamam kashtiyon se mazboot, umda aur achi thi, woh bacha ek bemisal bacha tha, bada haseen, bada hoshiyar, bada hi tarar. Hazrat Khizr ne usay pakar kar pathar se us ka sar kuchal kar usay maar dala. Hazrat Musa khauf-e-Allah se kanp uthay ke nanha sa pyara beganah bacha is bedardi se baghair kisi sabab ke Hazrat Khizr ne jaan se maar dala. Deewar girti hui dekh kar theher gaye, pehle to usay baqaida giraya aur phir ba-aram chunne baithay. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ukta gaye ke baithe bithaye acha dhanda le baithe. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is deewar ke neeche ka khana sirf ilm tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur aap ki qoum Misr par ghalib aa gayi aur yahan aa kar woh ba-aram rehne sehne lage to hukm-e-Ilahi hua ke inhe Allah ke ehsanat yaad dila'o. Aap khutbay ke liye kharay hue aur Allah ke ehsanat bayan karne lage ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhe yeh yeh ne'matein ata farmayin, Aal-e-Firaun se us ne tumhe nijat di, tumhare dushmanon ko gharat aur gharq kar diya, phir tumhe un ki zameen ka malik kar diya, tumhare Nabi se baatein keen, usay apne liye pasand farma liya, us par apni mohabbat daal di, tumhari tamam hajatein poori keen, tumhare Nabi tamam zameen walon se afzal hain, us ne tumhe Taurat ata farmayi. Al-gharaz pooray zoron se Allah ki beshumar aur anginat ne'matein inhe yaad dilayin. Is par ek Bani Israel ne kaha fi-al-waqay baat yahi hai ae Nabi-e-Allah kya zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne besakhta farmaya ke nahin hai. Isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko bheja ke un se kaho ke tumhe kya maloom ke main apna ilm kahan kahan rakhta hoon? Beshak samundar ke kinare par ek shakhs hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Khizr (A.S) hain. Pas Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke un ko main dekh loon. Wahi hui ke achha samundar ke kinare jao, wahan tumhein ek machhli milegi, use le lo, apne sathi ko sonp do, phir kinare chal do, jahan tum machhli ko bhool jao aur woh tujh se gum ho jaye, wahin tum mere is nek bande ko paoge. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab chalte chalte thak gaye to apne sathi se, jo un ka ghulam tha, machhli ke bare mein sawal kiya. Us ne jawab diya ke jis patthar ke paas hum thehre the, wahin main machhli ko bhool gaya aur tujh se zikr karna shaitan ne bilkul bhula diya. Main ne dekha ke machhli to goya surang banati hui dariya mein ja rahi hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) bhi apni lakri se pani ko cheerte hue us ke peeche ho liye. Machhli jahan se guzarti thi us ke dono taraf ka pani patthar ban jata tha, is se bhi Allah ke Nabi sakht muta'ajjib hue. Ab machhli ek jazeere mein aap ko le gayi al-kh. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Hur bin Qais mein ikhtilaf tha ke Musa (A.S) ke yeh sahib kaun the. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne unhein bula kar apna ikhtilaf bayan kiya. Unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui woh hadith bayan ki jo taqreeban oopar guzar chuki hai. Is mein sail ke sawal ke alfaz yeh hain ke kya aap us shakhs ka hona bhi jante hain jo aap se zyada ilm wala ho?

Toh chunke aap ne is ke jawab mein yeh na farmaya ke Allah janay is liye Rab ko yeh kalma na-pasand aaya, usi waqt wahi aayi ke haan Majma-ul-Bahrain mein hamara ek banda hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai. Is par Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya phir Parwardigar main us tak kaisay pahunch sakta hoon? Hukm hua ke apne sath ek machli rakh lo usay toshay-daan mein daal lo jahan woh machli gum ho jaye wahin woh mil jayenge. Toh aap apne sath apne sathi Yusha bin Nun A.S ko le kar chalay, pathar ke paas pahunch kar apne sar us par rakh kar do ghari so rahay. Machli us toshay-daan mein tarpi aur kood kar us se nikal gayi, samundar mein aisi gayi jaise koi surang laga kar zameen mein utar gaya ho, pani ka chalna behna Allah Ta'ala ne mauqoof kar diya aur taaq ki tarah woh surakh baqi reh gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S jab jaagay toh aap ke sathi yeh zikr aap se bhool gaye, usi waqt wahan se chal paray, din poora honay ke baad raat bhar chaltay rahay, subah Hazrat Musa A.S ko thakan aur bhook mehsoos hui, Allah ne jahan janay ka hukm diya tha jab tak wahan se aagay na nikal gaye thakan ka naam tak na tha, ab aap ne sathi se khana manga aur takleef bayan ki, us waqt aap ke sathi ne farmaya ke pathar ke paas jab hum ne aaram liya tha wahin usi waqt machli toh main bhool gaya aur is ke zikr ko bhi Shaitan ne bhula diya aur is machli ne toh samundar mein ajeeb taur par apni raah nikal li. Machli ke liye surang ban gayi aur un ke liye hairat ka baais ban gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki toh talash thi, chunancha apne nishan-e-qadam dekhte hue dono wapas huay, usi pathar ke paas pahunchay dekha ke ek sahib kapron mein liptay huay baithay hain. Aap ne salam kiya, us ne kaha ta'ajjub hai aap ki sar-zameen mein yeh salam kahan? Aap ne farmaya main Musa hoon, unhon ne poocha kya Bani Israel ke Musa? Aap ne farmaya haan aur main is liye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe woh sikhayen jo bhalai aap ko Allah ki taraf se sikhayi gayi hai. Aap ne farmaya Musa A.S aap mere sath sabr nahin kar sakte. Is liye ke mujhe jo ilm hai woh aap ko nahin aur aap ko jo ilm hai woh mujhe nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne dono ko judagana ilm ata farma rakha hai.

Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya Insha'Allah aap dekhenge ke main sabr karunga aur aap ke kisi farman ki nafarmani na karunga. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya achha agar tum mera saath chahte ho to mujh se khud kisi baat ka sawal na karna yahan tak ke main aap ko is ki babat khabardar karun. Itni baatein tay kar ke dono saath chale darya ke kinare ek kashti thi un se apne saath le jaane ki baat cheet karne lage unhon ne Khizr A.S ko pehchan liya aur baghair kiraya liye dono ko sawar kar liya. Kuch hi door chale honge ke Hazrat Musa A.S ne dekha ke Khizr A.S chup chap kashti ke takhte kulhare se tod rahe hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya yeh kya? In logon ne to hamare saath ehsan kiya baghair kiraya liye kashti mein sawar kiya aur aap ne is ke takhte todne shuru kar diye jis se tamam ahl-e-kashti doob jayen yeh to bada hi na-khushgawar kaam karne lage. Isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho main ne to tum se pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Musa A.S ma'zrat karne lage ke khata ho gayi bhoole se pooch baitha maaf farmaiye aur sakhti na kijiye. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain waqai yeh pehli ghalti bhool se hi thi farmate hain kashti ke ek takhte par ek chidiya aa baithi aur samundar mein chonch daal kar pani le kar ud gayi, us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne Hazrat Musa A.S se farmaya mere aur tere ilm ne Allah ke ilm mein se utna hi kam kiya hai jitna pani samundar mein se is chidiya ki chonch ne kam kiya hai. Ab kashti kinare lagi aur sahil par dono chalne lage ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ki nigah chand khelte hue bachon par padi un mein se ek bache ka sar pakad kar Hazrat Khizr A.S ne is tarah marod diya ke isi waqt us ka dam nikal gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ghabra gaye aur farmane lage baghair kisi qatl ke is bache ko aap ne na-haq maar dala? Aap ne bada hi munkar kaam kiya. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho isi ko main ne pehle hi se keh diya tha ke tumhari hamari nibh nahin sakti us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne pehle se zyada sakhti ki. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya achha ab agar main koi sawal kar baithun to beshak aap mujhe apne saath na rakhna yaqeenan ab aap ma'zoor ho gaye, chunancha phir dono hamrah chale ek basti walon ke paas pahunche un se khana manga lekin unhon ne un ki mehmandari se saaf inkar kar diya, wahin ek deewar dekhi jo jhuk gayi thi aur girne ke qareeb thi, isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne haath laga kar use theek aur durust kar diya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya khayal to farmaiye hum yahan aaye in logon se khana talab kiya unhon ne na diya mehman nawazi ke khilaf kiya un ka yeh kaam tha aap in se ujrat le sakte the. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya yeh hai mujh mein aur tum mein judai ab main tumhein in kamon ki asliyat batla dunga. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain kaash ke Hazrat Musa A.S sabr se kaam lete to in dono ki aur bhi bahut si baatein hamare samne Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qira'at mein 'wa kana wara'ahum' ke badle 'wa kana amamahum' hai aur 'safinatin' ke baad 'salihatan' ka lafz bhi hai aur 'wa ammal ghulamu' ke baad 'fa kana kafiran' ke lafz bhi hain. Aur sanad se bhi yeh hadith marwi hai is mein hai ke is patthar ke paas Hazrat Musa A.S ruk gaye wahin ek chashma tha jis ka naam 'Nahr-e-Hayat' tha is ka pani jis cheez ko lag jata hai woh zinda ho jati thi. Is mein chiriya ki chonch ka pani is samundar ke muqable mein, al-kh. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ke ghar mein un ke paas tha aap ne farmaya ke jis ko jo sawal karna ho kar le main ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe aap par fida kare Kufe mein ek wa'iz hain jin ka naam Nauf hai phir puri hadith bayan ki jaisa ke upar guzri is mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ke is khutbe se aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dilon mein narmi aa gayi thi, jab aap jaane lage to ek shakhs aap ke paas pahuncha aur us ne sawal kiya ke roo-e-zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin is par Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko itaab kiya kyunke unhon ne Allah ki taraf ilm ko na lautaya is mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne nishan talab kiya to irshad hua ke ek machhli apne saath rakh lo jis jagah is mein rooh parh jaye wahin par aap ki is shakhs se mulaqat ho gayi. Chunancha aap ne machhli li zanbeel mein rakh li aur apne saathi se kaha aap ka sirf itna hi kaam hai ke jahan machhli aap ke paas se chali jaye wahan aap mujhe khabar kar dena unhon ne kaha yeh to bilkul aasaan si baat hai. Un ka naam Yusha bin Noon tha. 'Laftan' se yahi murad hai. Yeh dono buzurg tar jagah mein ek darakht tale the Hazrat Musa A.S ko neend aa gayi thi aur Hazrat Yusha jaag rahe the jo machhli kood gayi unhon ne khayal kiya ke jagana to theek nahin jab aankh khule gi zikr kar doon ga. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke pani mein jaane ke waqt jo soorakh ho gaya tha use rawi-e-hadith Amr ne apne angoothe aur us ke paas ki dono ungliyon ka halqa kar ke dikhaya ke is tarah ka tha jaise patthar mein hota hai. Wapsi par Hazrat Khizr A.S samundar ke kinare sabz gaddi bichaye mile ek chadar mein lipte hue the is ka ek sira to dono pairon ke neeche rakha hua tha aur dusra kinara sar tale tha, Hazrat Musa A.S ke salam par aap ne munh khola. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya ke aap ke haath mein Taurat maujood hai wahi aasman se aa rahi hai kya yeh bas nahin? Aur mera ilm aap ke laiq bhi nahin aur na main aap ke ilm ke qabil hoon. Is mein hai ke kashti ka takhta tor kar aap ne ek taant se baandh diya tha. Pehli dafa ka aap ka sawal to bhoole se hi tha dusri martaba ka bator-e-shart ke tha haan teesri baar ka sawal qasdan alaihadgi ki wajah se tha. Is mein hai ke larkon mein ek larka tha kafir hoshiyar use Hazrat Khizr ne lita kar chhuri se zibah kar diya ek qira'at mein 'zakiyatan muslimatan' bhi hai.

Wara'ahum ki qira'at imamahum bhi hai. Is zalim badshah ka naam is mein Hado bin Bado hai aur jis bachay ko qatl kiya gaya tha us ka naam Jesoor tha. Kehte hain ke is larkay ke badlay un ke yahan ek larki hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) khutba kar rahe thay aur farmaya ke Allah ko aur us ke Amr-e-Ilahi ko mujh se zyada koi nahin janta. Al-kh. Yeh Nauf Ka'ab (R.A) ki biwi ke larkay ka qaul tha ke jis Musa ka in ayaton mein zikr hai yeh Musa bin Mesha thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke ae Allah agar tere bandon mein mujh se bada aalim koi ho to mujhe aagah farma, is mein hai ke namak charhi hui machli aap ne apne sath rakhi thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ne farmaya tum yahan kyun aaye? Aap ko to abhi Bani Israel mein hi mashghool-e-kaar rehna hai. Is mein hai ke chupi hui baatein Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ko maloom karayi jati thin to aap ne farmaya ke tum mere sath theher nahin sakte kyunke aap to zahir ko dekh kar faisla karenge aur mujhe raaz par ittila hoti hai, chunancha shart ho gayi ke go aap kaisa hi khilaf dekhein lekin lab na hilayein jab tak ke Hazrat Khizr khud na batlayein. Kehte hain ke yeh kashti tamam kashtiyon se mazboot, umda aur achi thi, woh bacha ek bemisal bacha tha, bada haseen, bada hoshiyar, bada hi tarar. Hazrat Khizr ne usay pakar kar pathar se us ka sar kuchal kar usay maar dala. Hazrat Musa khauf-e-Allah se kanp uthay ke nanha sa pyara beganah bacha is bedardi se baghair kisi sabab ke Hazrat Khizr ne jaan se maar dala. Deewar girti hui dekh kar theher gaye, pehle to usay baqaida giraya aur phir ba-aram chunne baithay. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ukta gaye ke baithe bithaye acha dhanda le baithe. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is deewar ke neeche ka khana sirf ilm tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur aap ki qoum Misr par ghalib aa gayi aur yahan aa kar woh ba-aram rehne sehne lage to hukm-e-Ilahi hua ke inhe Allah ke ehsanat yaad dila'o. Aap khutbay ke liye kharay hue aur Allah ke ehsanat bayan karne lage ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhe yeh yeh ne'matein ata farmayin, Aal-e-Firaun se us ne tumhe nijat di, tumhare dushmanon ko gharat aur gharq kar diya, phir tumhe un ki zameen ka malik kar diya, tumhare Nabi se baatein keen, usay apne liye pasand farma liya, us par apni mohabbat daal di, tumhari tamam hajatein poori keen, tumhare Nabi tamam zameen walon se afzal hain, us ne tumhe Taurat ata farmayi. Al-gharaz pooray zoron se Allah ki beshumar aur anginat ne'matein inhe yaad dilayin. Is par ek Bani Israel ne kaha fi-al-waqay baat yahi hai ae Nabi-e-Allah kya zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne besakhta farmaya ke nahin hai. Isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko bheja ke un se kaho ke tumhe kya maloom ke main apna ilm kahan kahan rakhta hoon? Beshak samundar ke kinare par ek shakhs hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Khizr (A.S) hain. Pas Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke un ko main dekh loon. Wahi hui ke achha samundar ke kinare jao, wahan tumhein ek machhli milegi, use le lo, apne sathi ko sonp do, phir kinare chal do, jahan tum machhli ko bhool jao aur woh tujh se gum ho jaye, wahin tum mere is nek bande ko paoge. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab chalte chalte thak gaye to apne sathi se, jo un ka ghulam tha, machhli ke bare mein sawal kiya. Us ne jawab diya ke jis patthar ke paas hum thehre the, wahin main machhli ko bhool gaya aur tujh se zikr karna shaitan ne bilkul bhula diya. Main ne dekha ke machhli to goya surang banati hui dariya mein ja rahi hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) bhi apni lakri se pani ko cheerte hue us ke peeche ho liye. Machhli jahan se guzarti thi us ke dono taraf ka pani patthar ban jata tha, is se bhi Allah ke Nabi sakht muta'ajjib hue. Ab machhli ek jazeere mein aap ko le gayi al-kh. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Hur bin Qais mein ikhtilaf tha ke Musa (A.S) ke yeh sahib kaun the. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne unhein bula kar apna ikhtilaf bayan kiya. Unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui woh hadith bayan ki jo taqreeban oopar guzar chuki hai. Is mein sail ke sawal ke alfaz yeh hain ke kya aap us shakhs ka hona bhi jante hain jo aap se zyada ilm wala ho?

Hazrat Musa A.S aur Allah ka ek banda. Hazrat Musa A.S se zikr kiya gaya ke Allah ka ek banda do darya milne ki jagah hai, us ke paas woh ilm hai jo tumhein hasil nahin. Aap ne usi waqt un se mulaqat karne ki thaan li. Ab apne saathi se farmate hain ke main toh pahunche baghair dam na loonga. Kehte hain yeh do samundar ek toh Bahira-e-Fars mashriqi aur dusra Bahira-e-Room maghribi hai. Yeh jagah Tanja ke paas maghrib ke shehron ke aakhir mein hai, wallahu aalam. Toh farmate hain ke go mujhe qarnon tak chalna pade koi harj nahin. Kehte hain ke Qais ki lughat mein baras ko huqab kehte hain. Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain, huqab se murad assi baras hain. Mujahid R.H sattar baras kehte hain. Ibn Abbas R.A zamana batlate hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hukum mila tha ke apne saath namak chadhee hui ek machhli lein, jahan woh gum ho jaye wahin hamara banda milega. Yeh dono machhli ko saath liye chale, Majma-ul-Bahrain mein pahunch gaye. Wahan Nehr-e-Hayat thi, wahin dono lait gaye. Us nehr ke pani ke chheente machhli par pade, machhli hilne julne lag gayi. Aap ke saath Hazrat Yusha A.S ki zanbeel mein yeh machhli rakhi hui thi aur woh samundar ke kinare tha. Machhli ne samundar ke andar kood jaane ke liye just lagayi aur Hazrat Yusha ki aankh khul gayi. Machhli un ke dekhte hue pani mein gayi aur pani mein seedha soorakh hota chala gaya, pas jis tarah zameen mein soorakh aur surang ban jati hai, isi tarah pani mein jahan se woh gayi soorakh ho gaya, idhar udhar pani khada ho gaya aur woh soorakh bilkul khula hua raha. Patthar ki tarah pani mein chhed ho gaya, jahan jis pani ko lagti hui woh machhli gayi wahan ka woh pani patthar jaisa ho gaya aur woh soorakh banta chala gaya. Muhammad bin Ishaq marfoo'an laye hain ke Huzoor ﷺ is baat ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke pani is tarah ibtida-e-duniya se nahin jama siwaye us machhli ke chale jaane ki jagah ke ird-gird ke pani ke. Yeh nishan misl soorakh-e-zameen ke barabar Musa A.S ke wapas pahunchne tak baqi hi rahe. Is nishan ko dekhte hi Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki talash mein toh hum thay. Jab machhli ko bhool kar yeh dono aage badhe. Yahan yeh baat yaad rakhne ki hai ke ek ka kaam dono sathiyon ki taraf mansoob hua hai. Bhoolne wale sirf Yusha thay. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yakhruju minhuma al-lu'lu'u wal-marjan) yani in dono samundaron mein se moti aur moongay nikalte hain. Halankeh do qaulon mein se ek yeh hai ke lu'lu aur marjan sirf khari pani mein se nikalte hain. Jab wahan se ek marhala aur tay kar gaye toh Hazrat Musa A.S ne apne saathi se nashta talab kiya aur safar ki takleef bhi bayan ki, yeh takleef maqsood se aage nikal aane ke baad hui. Is par aap ke saathi ko machhli ka chala jana yaad aaya aur kaha jis chattan ke paas hum thehre thay us waqt main machhli bhool gaya aur aap se zikr karna bhi Shaitan ne yaad se hata diya. Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat "an adhkurahu" hai. Farmate hain ke is machhli ne toh ajeeb-o-ghareeb taur par pani mein apni raah pakdi.

Hazrat Musa A.S ghabra gaye aur farmane lage baghair kisi qatl ke is bache ko aap ne na-haq maar dala? Aap ne bada hi munkar kaam kiya. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho isi ko main ne pehle hi se keh diya tha ke tumhari hamari nibh nahin sakti us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne pehle se zyada sakhti ki. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya achha ab agar main koi sawal kar baithun to beshak aap mujhe apne saath na rakhna yaqeenan ab aap ma'zoor ho gaye, chunancha phir dono hamrah chale ek basti walon ke paas pahunche un se khana manga lekin unhon ne un ki mehmandari se saaf inkar kar diya, wahin ek deewar dekhi jo jhuk gayi thi aur girne ke qareeb thi, isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne haath laga kar use theek aur durust kar diya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya khayal to farmaiye hum yahan aaye in logon se khana talab kiya unhon ne na diya mehman nawazi ke khilaf kiya un ka yeh kaam tha aap in se ujrat le sakte the. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya yeh hai mujh mein aur tum mein judai ab main tumhein in kamon ki asliyat batla dunga. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain kaash ke Hazrat Musa A.S sabr se kaam lete to in dono ki aur bhi bahut si baatein hamare samne Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qira'at mein 'wa kana wara'ahum' ke badle 'wa kana amamahum' hai aur 'safinatin' ke baad 'salihatan' ka lafz bhi hai aur 'wa ammal ghulamu' ke baad 'fa kana kafiran' ke lafz bhi hain. Aur sanad se bhi yeh hadith marwi hai is mein hai ke is patthar ke paas Hazrat Musa A.S ruk gaye wahin ek chashma tha jis ka naam 'Nahr-e-Hayat' tha is ka pani jis cheez ko lag jata hai woh zinda ho jati thi. Is mein chiriya ki chonch ka pani is samundar ke muqable mein, al-kh. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ke ghar mein un ke paas tha aap ne farmaya ke jis ko jo sawal karna ho kar le main ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe aap par fida kare Kufe mein ek wa'iz hain jin ka naam Nauf hai phir puri hadith bayan ki jaisa ke upar guzri is mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ke is khutbe se aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dilon mein narmi aa gayi thi, jab aap jaane lage to ek shakhs aap ke paas pahuncha aur us ne sawal kiya ke roo-e-zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin is par Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko itaab kiya kyunke unhon ne Allah ki taraf ilm ko na lautaya is mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne nishan talab kiya to irshad hua ke ek machhli apne saath rakh lo jis jagah is mein rooh parh jaye wahin par aap ki is shakhs se mulaqat ho gayi. Chunancha aap ne machhli li zanbeel mein rakh li aur apne saathi se kaha aap ka sirf itna hi kaam hai ke jahan machhli aap ke paas se chali jaye wahan aap mujhe khabar kar dena unhon ne kaha yeh to bilkul aasaan si baat hai. Un ka naam Yusha bin Noon tha. 'Laftan' se yahi murad hai. Yeh dono buzurg tar jagah mein ek darakht tale the Hazrat Musa A.S ko neend aa gayi thi aur Hazrat Yusha jaag rahe the jo machhli kood gayi unhon ne khayal kiya ke jagana to theek nahin jab aankh khule gi zikr kar doon ga. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke pani mein jaane ke waqt jo soorakh ho gaya tha use rawi-e-hadith Amr ne apne angoothe aur us ke paas ki dono ungliyon ka halqa kar ke dikhaya ke is tarah ka tha jaise patthar mein hota hai. Wapsi par Hazrat Khizr A.S samundar ke kinare sabz gaddi bichaye mile ek chadar mein lipte hue the is ka ek sira to dono pairon ke neeche rakha hua tha aur dusra kinara sar tale tha, Hazrat Musa A.S ke salam par aap ne munh khola. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya ke aap ke haath mein Taurat maujood hai wahi aasman se aa rahi hai kya yeh bas nahin? Aur mera ilm aap ke laiq bhi nahin aur na main aap ke ilm ke qabil hoon. Is mein hai ke kashti ka takhta tor kar aap ne ek taant se baandh diya tha. Pehli dafa ka aap ka sawal to bhoole se hi tha dusri martaba ka bator-e-shart ke tha haan teesri baar ka sawal qasdan alaihadgi ki wajah se tha. Is mein hai ke larkon mein ek larka tha kafir hoshiyar use Hazrat Khizr ne lita kar chhuri se zibah kar diya ek qira'at mein 'zakiyatan muslimatan' bhi hai.

Wara'ahum ki qira'at imamahum bhi hai. Is zalim badshah ka naam is mein Hado bin Bado hai aur jis bachay ko qatl kiya gaya tha us ka naam Jesoor tha. Kehte hain ke is larkay ke badlay un ke yahan ek larki hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) khutba kar rahe thay aur farmaya ke Allah ko aur us ke Amr-e-Ilahi ko mujh se zyada koi nahin janta. Al-kh. Yeh Nauf Ka'ab (R.A) ki biwi ke larkay ka qaul tha ke jis Musa ka in ayaton mein zikr hai yeh Musa bin Mesha thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke ae Allah agar tere bandon mein mujh se bada aalim koi ho to mujhe aagah farma, is mein hai ke namak charhi hui machli aap ne apne sath rakhi thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ne farmaya tum yahan kyun aaye? Aap ko to abhi Bani Israel mein hi mashghool-e-kaar rehna hai. Is mein hai ke chupi hui baatein Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ko maloom karayi jati thin to aap ne farmaya ke tum mere sath theher nahin sakte kyunke aap to zahir ko dekh kar faisla karenge aur mujhe raaz par ittila hoti hai, chunancha shart ho gayi ke go aap kaisa hi khilaf dekhein lekin lab na hilayein jab tak ke Hazrat Khizr khud na batlayein. Kehte hain ke yeh kashti tamam kashtiyon se mazboot, umda aur achi thi, woh bacha ek bemisal bacha tha, bada haseen, bada hoshiyar, bada hi tarar. Hazrat Khizr ne usay pakar kar pathar se us ka sar kuchal kar usay maar dala. Hazrat Musa khauf-e-Allah se kanp uthay ke nanha sa pyara beganah bacha is bedardi se baghair kisi sabab ke Hazrat Khizr ne jaan se maar dala. Deewar girti hui dekh kar theher gaye, pehle to usay baqaida giraya aur phir ba-aram chunne baithay. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ukta gaye ke baithe bithaye acha dhanda le baithe. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is deewar ke neeche ka khana sirf ilm tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur aap ki qoum Misr par ghalib aa gayi aur yahan aa kar woh ba-aram rehne sehne lage to hukm-e-Ilahi hua ke inhe Allah ke ehsanat yaad dila'o. Aap khutbay ke liye kharay hue aur Allah ke ehsanat bayan karne lage ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhe yeh yeh ne'matein ata farmayin, Aal-e-Firaun se us ne tumhe nijat di, tumhare dushmanon ko gharat aur gharq kar diya, phir tumhe un ki zameen ka malik kar diya, tumhare Nabi se baatein keen, usay apne liye pasand farma liya, us par apni mohabbat daal di, tumhari tamam hajatein poori keen, tumhare Nabi tamam zameen walon se afzal hain, us ne tumhe Taurat ata farmayi. Al-gharaz pooray zoron se Allah ki beshumar aur anginat ne'matein inhe yaad dilayin. Is par ek Bani Israel ne kaha fi-al-waqay baat yahi hai ae Nabi-e-Allah kya zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne besakhta farmaya ke nahin hai. Isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko bheja ke un se kaho ke tumhe kya maloom ke main apna ilm kahan kahan rakhta hoon? Beshak samundar ke kinare par ek shakhs hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Khizr (A.S) hain. Pas Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke un ko main dekh loon. Wahi hui ke achha samundar ke kinare jao, wahan tumhein ek machhli milegi, use le lo, apne sathi ko sonp do, phir kinare chal do, jahan tum machhli ko bhool jao aur woh tujh se gum ho jaye, wahin tum mere is nek bande ko paoge. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab chalte chalte thak gaye to apne sathi se, jo un ka ghulam tha, machhli ke bare mein sawal kiya. Us ne jawab diya ke jis patthar ke paas hum thehre the, wahin main machhli ko bhool gaya aur tujh se zikr karna shaitan ne bilkul bhula diya. Main ne dekha ke machhli to goya surang banati hui dariya mein ja rahi hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) bhi apni lakri se pani ko cheerte hue us ke peeche ho liye. Machhli jahan se guzarti thi us ke dono taraf ka pani patthar ban jata tha, is se bhi Allah ke Nabi sakht muta'ajjib hue. Ab machhli ek jazeere mein aap ko le gayi al-kh. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Hur bin Qais mein ikhtilaf tha ke Musa (A.S) ke yeh sahib kaun the. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne unhein bula kar apna ikhtilaf bayan kiya. Unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui woh hadith bayan ki jo taqreeban oopar guzar chuki hai. Is mein sail ke sawal ke alfaz yeh hain ke kya aap us shakhs ka hona bhi jante hain jo aap se zyada ilm wala ho?

Hazrat Musa A.S aur Allah ka ek banda. Hazrat Musa A.S se zikr kiya gaya ke Allah ka ek banda do darya milne ki jagah hai, us ke paas woh ilm hai jo tumhein hasil nahin. Aap ne usi waqt un se mulaqat karne ki thaan li. Ab apne saathi se farmate hain ke main toh pahunche baghair dam na loonga. Kehte hain yeh do samundar ek toh Bahira-e-Fars mashriqi aur dusra Bahira-e-Room maghribi hai. Yeh jagah Tanja ke paas maghrib ke shehron ke aakhir mein hai, wallahu aalam. Toh farmate hain ke go mujhe qarnon tak chalna pade koi harj nahin. Kehte hain ke Qais ki lughat mein baras ko huqab kehte hain. Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain, huqab se murad assi baras hain. Mujahid R.H sattar baras kehte hain. Ibn Abbas R.A zamana batlate hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hukum mila tha ke apne saath namak chadhee hui ek machhli lein, jahan woh gum ho jaye wahin hamara banda milega. Yeh dono machhli ko saath liye chale, Majma-ul-Bahrain mein pahunch gaye. Wahan Nehr-e-Hayat thi, wahin dono lait gaye. Us nehr ke pani ke chheente machhli par pade, machhli hilne julne lag gayi. Aap ke saath Hazrat Yusha A.S ki zanbeel mein yeh machhli rakhi hui thi aur woh samundar ke kinare tha. Machhli ne samundar ke andar kood jaane ke liye just lagayi aur Hazrat Yusha ki aankh khul gayi. Machhli un ke dekhte hue pani mein gayi aur pani mein seedha soorakh hota chala gaya, pas jis tarah zameen mein soorakh aur surang ban jati hai, isi tarah pani mein jahan se woh gayi soorakh ho gaya, idhar udhar pani khada ho gaya aur woh soorakh bilkul khula hua raha. Patthar ki tarah pani mein chhed ho gaya, jahan jis pani ko lagti hui woh machhli gayi wahan ka woh pani patthar jaisa ho gaya aur woh soorakh banta chala gaya. Muhammad bin Ishaq marfoo'an laye hain ke Huzoor ﷺ is baat ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke pani is tarah ibtida-e-duniya se nahin jama siwaye us machhli ke chale jaane ki jagah ke ird-gird ke pani ke. Yeh nishan misl soorakh-e-zameen ke barabar Musa A.S ke wapas pahunchne tak baqi hi rahe. Is nishan ko dekhte hi Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki talash mein toh hum thay. Jab machhli ko bhool kar yeh dono aage badhe. Yahan yeh baat yaad rakhne ki hai ke ek ka kaam dono sathiyon ki taraf mansoob hua hai. Bhoolne wale sirf Yusha thay. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yakhruju minhuma al-lu'lu'u wal-marjan) yani in dono samundaron mein se moti aur moongay nikalte hain. Halankeh do qaulon mein se ek yeh hai ke lu'lu aur marjan sirf khari pani mein se nikalte hain. Jab wahan se ek marhala aur tay kar gaye toh Hazrat Musa A.S ne apne saathi se nashta talab kiya aur safar ki takleef bhi bayan ki, yeh takleef maqsood se aage nikal aane ke baad hui. Is par aap ke saathi ko machhli ka chala jana yaad aaya aur kaha jis chattan ke paas hum thehre thay us waqt main machhli bhool gaya aur aap se zikr karna bhi Shaitan ne yaad se hata diya. Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat "an adhkurahu" hai. Farmate hain ke is machhli ne toh ajeeb-o-ghareeb taur par pani mein apni raah pakdi.

Usi waqt Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya lo aur suno isi jagah ki talash mein hum thay toh woh dono apne raaste par apne nishanat-e-qadam ke khoj par wapas lautay. Wahan hamare bandon mein se ek banday ko paya jisay hum ne apne paas ki rahmat aur apne paas ka ilm ata farma rakha tha. Yeh Hazrat Khizr A.S hain. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se kaha ke Hazrat Nauf ka khayal hai ke Khizr A.S se milne wale Musa, Bani Israel ke Musa na thay. Ibn Abbas R.A ne farmaya woh dushman-e-Rab jhoota hai, hum se Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne farmaya hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se unhon ne suna ke Hazrat Musa A.S kharay ho kar Bani Israel mein khutba kar rahe thay jo aap se sawal hua ke sab se bada aalim kaun hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke main. Toh chunke aap ne is ke jawab mein yeh na farmaya ke Allah janay is liye Rab ko yeh kalma na-pasand aaya, usi waqt wahi aayi ke haan Majma-ul-Bahrain mein hamara ek banda hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai. Is par Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya phir Parwardigar main us tak kaisay pahunch sakta hoon? Hukm hua ke apne sath ek machli rakh lo usay toshay-daan mein daal lo jahan woh machli gum ho jaye wahin woh mil jayenge. Toh aap apne sath apne sathi Yusha bin Nun A.S ko le kar chalay, pathar ke paas pahunch kar apne sar us par rakh kar do ghari so rahay. Machli us toshay-daan mein tarpi aur kood kar us se nikal gayi, samundar mein aisi gayi jaise koi surang laga kar zameen mein utar gaya ho, pani ka chalna behna Allah Ta'ala ne mauqoof kar diya aur taaq ki tarah woh surakh baqi reh gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S jab jaagay toh aap ke sathi yeh zikr aap se bhool gaye, usi waqt wahan se chal paray, din poora honay ke baad raat bhar chaltay rahay, subah Hazrat Musa A.S ko thakan aur bhook mehsoos hui, Allah ne jahan janay ka hukm diya tha jab tak wahan se aagay na nikal gaye thakan ka naam tak na tha, ab aap ne sathi se khana manga aur takleef bayan ki, us waqt aap ke sathi ne farmaya ke pathar ke paas jab hum ne aaram liya tha wahin usi waqt machli toh main bhool gaya aur is ke zikr ko bhi Shaitan ne bhula diya aur is machli ne toh samundar mein ajeeb taur par apni raah nikal li. Machli ke liye surang ban gayi aur un ke liye hairat ka baais ban gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki toh talash thi, chunancha apne nishan-e-qadam dekhte hue dono wapas huay, usi pathar ke paas pahunchay dekha ke ek sahib kapron mein liptay huay baithay hain. Aap ne salam kiya, us ne kaha ta'ajjub hai aap ki sar-zameen mein yeh salam kahan? Aap ne farmaya main Musa hoon, unhon ne poocha kya Bani Israel ke Musa? Aap ne farmaya haan aur main is liye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe woh sikhayen jo bhalai aap ko Allah ki taraf se sikhayi gayi hai. Aap ne farmaya Musa A.S aap mere sath sabr nahin kar sakte. Is liye ke mujhe jo ilm hai woh aap ko nahin aur aap ko jo ilm hai woh mujhe nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne dono ko judagana ilm ata farma rakha hai.

Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya Insha'Allah aap dekhenge ke main sabr karunga aur aap ke kisi farman ki nafarmani na karunga. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya achha agar tum mera saath chahte ho to mujh se khud kisi baat ka sawal na karna yahan tak ke main aap ko is ki babat khabardar karun. Itni baatein tay kar ke dono saath chale darya ke kinare ek kashti thi un se apne saath le jaane ki baat cheet karne lage unhon ne Khizr A.S ko pehchan liya aur baghair kiraya liye dono ko sawar kar liya. Kuch hi door chale honge ke Hazrat Musa A.S ne dekha ke Khizr A.S chup chap kashti ke takhte kulhare se tod rahe hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya yeh kya? In logon ne to hamare saath ehsan kiya baghair kiraya liye kashti mein sawar kiya aur aap ne is ke takhte todne shuru kar diye jis se tamam ahl-e-kashti doob jayen yeh to bada hi na-khushgawar kaam karne lage. Isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho main ne to tum se pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Musa A.S ma'zrat karne lage ke khata ho gayi bhoole se pooch baitha maaf farmaiye aur sakhti na kijiye.
