Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya ke aap ke haath mein Taurat maujood hai wahi aasman se aa rahi hai kya yeh bas nahin? Aur mera ilm aap ke laiq bhi nahin aur na main aap ke ilm ke qabil hoon. Is mein hai ke kashti ka takhta tor kar aap ne ek taant se baandh diya tha. Pehli dafa ka aap ka sawal to bhoole se hi tha dusri martaba ka bator-e-shart ke tha haan teesri baar ka sawal qasdan alaihadgi ki wajah se tha. Is mein hai ke larkon mein ek larka tha kafir hoshiyar use Hazrat Khizr ne lita kar chhuri se zibah kar diya ek qira'at mein 'zakiyatan muslimatan' bhi hai.

Wara'ahum ki qira'at imamahum bhi hai. Is zalim badshah ka naam is mein Hado bin Bado hai aur jis bachay ko qatl kiya gaya tha us ka naam Jesoor tha. Kehte hain ke is larkay ke badlay un ke yahan ek larki hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) khutba kar rahe thay aur farmaya ke Allah ko aur us ke Amr-e-Ilahi ko mujh se zyada koi nahin janta. Al-kh. Yeh Nauf Ka'ab (R.A) ki biwi ke larkay ka qaul tha ke jis Musa ka in ayaton mein zikr hai yeh Musa bin Mesha thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke ae Allah agar tere bandon mein mujh se bada aalim koi ho to mujhe aagah farma, is mein hai ke namak charhi hui machli aap ne apne sath rakhi thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ne farmaya tum yahan kyun aaye? Aap ko to abhi Bani Israel mein hi mashghool-e-kaar rehna hai. Is mein hai ke chupi hui baatein Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ko maloom karayi jati thin to aap ne farmaya ke tum mere sath theher nahin sakte kyunke aap to zahir ko dekh kar faisla karenge aur mujhe raaz par ittila hoti hai, chunancha shart ho gayi ke go aap kaisa hi khilaf dekhein lekin lab na hilayein jab tak ke Hazrat Khizr khud na batlayein. Kehte hain ke yeh kashti tamam kashtiyon se mazboot, umda aur achi thi, woh bacha ek bemisal bacha tha, bada haseen, bada hoshiyar, bada hi tarar. Hazrat Khizr ne usay pakar kar pathar se us ka sar kuchal kar usay maar dala. Hazrat Musa khauf-e-Allah se kanp uthay ke nanha sa pyara beganah bacha is bedardi se baghair kisi sabab ke Hazrat Khizr ne jaan se maar dala. Deewar girti hui dekh kar theher gaye, pehle to usay baqaida giraya aur phir ba-aram chunne baithay. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ukta gaye ke baithe bithaye acha dhanda le baithe. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is deewar ke neeche ka khana sirf ilm tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur aap ki qoum Misr par ghalib aa gayi aur yahan aa kar woh ba-aram rehne sehne lage to hukm-e-Ilahi hua ke inhe Allah ke ehsanat yaad dila'o. Aap khutbay ke liye kharay hue aur Allah ke ehsanat bayan karne lage ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhe yeh yeh ne'matein ata farmayin, Aal-e-Firaun se us ne tumhe nijat di, tumhare dushmanon ko gharat aur gharq kar diya, phir tumhe un ki zameen ka malik kar diya, tumhare Nabi se baatein keen, usay apne liye pasand farma liya, us par apni mohabbat daal di, tumhari tamam hajatein poori keen, tumhare Nabi tamam zameen walon se afzal hain, us ne tumhe Taurat ata farmayi. Al-gharaz pooray zoron se Allah ki beshumar aur anginat ne'matein inhe yaad dilayin. Is par ek Bani Israel ne kaha fi-al-waqay baat yahi hai ae Nabi-e-Allah kya zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne besakhta farmaya ke nahin hai. Isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko bheja ke un se kaho ke tumhe kya maloom ke main apna ilm kahan kahan rakhta hoon? Beshak samundar ke kinare par ek shakhs hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai.

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Khizr (A.S) hain. Pas Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke un ko main dekh loon. Wahi hui ke achha samundar ke kinare jao, wahan tumhein ek machhli milegi, use le lo, apne sathi ko sonp do, phir kinare chal do, jahan tum machhli ko bhool jao aur woh tujh se gum ho jaye, wahin tum mere is nek bande ko paoge. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab chalte chalte thak gaye to apne sathi se, jo un ka ghulam tha, machhli ke bare mein sawal kiya. Us ne jawab diya ke jis patthar ke paas hum thehre the, wahin main machhli ko bhool gaya aur tujh se zikr karna shaitan ne bilkul bhula diya. Main ne dekha ke machhli to goya surang banati hui dariya mein ja rahi hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) bhi apni lakri se pani ko cheerte hue us ke peeche ho liye. Machhli jahan se guzarti thi us ke dono taraf ka pani patthar ban jata tha, is se bhi Allah ke Nabi sakht muta'ajjib hue. Ab machhli ek jazeere mein aap ko le gayi al-kh. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Hur bin Qais mein ikhtilaf tha ke Musa (A.S) ke yeh sahib kaun the. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne unhein bula kar apna ikhtilaf bayan kiya. Unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui woh hadith bayan ki jo taqreeban oopar guzar chuki hai. Is mein sail ke sawal ke alfaz yeh hain ke kya aap us shakhs ka hona bhi jante hain jo aap se zyada ilm wala ho?

Hazrat Musa A.S aur Allah ka ek banda. Hazrat Musa A.S se zikr kiya gaya ke Allah ka ek banda do darya milne ki jagah hai, us ke paas woh ilm hai jo tumhein hasil nahin. Aap ne usi waqt un se mulaqat karne ki thaan li. Ab apne saathi se farmate hain ke main toh pahunche baghair dam na loonga. Kehte hain yeh do samundar ek toh Bahira-e-Fars mashriqi aur dusra Bahira-e-Room maghribi hai. Yeh jagah Tanja ke paas maghrib ke shehron ke aakhir mein hai, wallahu aalam. Toh farmate hain ke go mujhe qarnon tak chalna pade koi harj nahin. Kehte hain ke Qais ki lughat mein baras ko huqab kehte hain. Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain, huqab se murad assi baras hain. Mujahid R.H sattar baras kehte hain. Ibn Abbas R.A zamana batlate hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hukum mila tha ke apne saath namak chadhee hui ek machhli lein, jahan woh gum ho jaye wahin hamara banda milega. Yeh dono machhli ko saath liye chale, Majma-ul-Bahrain mein pahunch gaye. Wahan Nehr-e-Hayat thi, wahin dono lait gaye. Us nehr ke pani ke chheente machhli par pade, machhli hilne julne lag gayi. Aap ke saath Hazrat Yusha A.S ki zanbeel mein yeh machhli rakhi hui thi aur woh samundar ke kinare tha. Machhli ne samundar ke andar kood jaane ke liye just lagayi aur Hazrat Yusha ki aankh khul gayi. Machhli un ke dekhte hue pani mein gayi aur pani mein seedha soorakh hota chala gaya, pas jis tarah zameen mein soorakh aur surang ban jati hai, isi tarah pani mein jahan se woh gayi soorakh ho gaya, idhar udhar pani khada ho gaya aur woh soorakh bilkul khula hua raha. Patthar ki tarah pani mein chhed ho gaya, jahan jis pani ko lagti hui woh machhli gayi wahan ka woh pani patthar jaisa ho gaya aur woh soorakh banta chala gaya. Muhammad bin Ishaq marfoo'an laye hain ke Huzoor ﷺ is baat ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke pani is tarah ibtida-e-duniya se nahin jama siwaye us machhli ke chale jaane ki jagah ke ird-gird ke pani ke. Yeh nishan misl soorakh-e-zameen ke barabar Musa A.S ke wapas pahunchne tak baqi hi rahe. Is nishan ko dekhte hi Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki talash mein toh hum thay. Jab machhli ko bhool kar yeh dono aage badhe. Yahan yeh baat yaad rakhne ki hai ke ek ka kaam dono sathiyon ki taraf mansoob hua hai. Bhoolne wale sirf Yusha thay. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yakhruju minhuma al-lu'lu'u wal-marjan) yani in dono samundaron mein se moti aur moongay nikalte hain. Halankeh do qaulon mein se ek yeh hai ke lu'lu aur marjan sirf khari pani mein se nikalte hain. Jab wahan se ek marhala aur tay kar gaye toh Hazrat Musa A.S ne apne saathi se nashta talab kiya aur safar ki takleef bhi bayan ki, yeh takleef maqsood se aage nikal aane ke baad hui. Is par aap ke saathi ko machhli ka chala jana yaad aaya aur kaha jis chattan ke paas hum thehre thay us waqt main machhli bhool gaya aur aap se zikr karna bhi Shaitan ne yaad se hata diya. Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat "an adhkurahu" hai. Farmate hain ke is machhli ne toh ajeeb-o-ghareeb taur par pani mein apni raah pakdi.

Usi waqt Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya lo aur suno isi jagah ki talash mein hum thay toh woh dono apne raaste par apne nishanat-e-qadam ke khoj par wapas lautay. Wahan hamare bandon mein se ek banday ko paya jisay hum ne apne paas ki rahmat aur apne paas ka ilm ata farma rakha tha. Yeh Hazrat Khizr A.S hain. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se kaha ke Hazrat Nauf ka khayal hai ke Khizr A.S se milne wale Musa, Bani Israel ke Musa na thay. Ibn Abbas R.A ne farmaya woh dushman-e-Rab jhoota hai, hum se Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne farmaya hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se unhon ne suna ke Hazrat Musa A.S kharay ho kar Bani Israel mein khutba kar rahe thay jo aap se sawal hua ke sab se bada aalim kaun hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke main. Toh chunke aap ne is ke jawab mein yeh na farmaya ke Allah janay is liye Rab ko yeh kalma na-pasand aaya, usi waqt wahi aayi ke haan Majma-ul-Bahrain mein hamara ek banda hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai. Is par Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya phir Parwardigar main us tak kaisay pahunch sakta hoon? Hukm hua ke apne sath ek machli rakh lo usay toshay-daan mein daal lo jahan woh machli gum ho jaye wahin woh mil jayenge. Toh aap apne sath apne sathi Yusha bin Nun A.S ko le kar chalay, pathar ke paas pahunch kar apne sar us par rakh kar do ghari so rahay. Machli us toshay-daan mein tarpi aur kood kar us se nikal gayi, samundar mein aisi gayi jaise koi surang laga kar zameen mein utar gaya ho, pani ka chalna behna Allah Ta'ala ne mauqoof kar diya aur taaq ki tarah woh surakh baqi reh gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S jab jaagay toh aap ke sathi yeh zikr aap se bhool gaye, usi waqt wahan se chal paray, din poora honay ke baad raat bhar chaltay rahay, subah Hazrat Musa A.S ko thakan aur bhook mehsoos hui, Allah ne jahan janay ka hukm diya tha jab tak wahan se aagay na nikal gaye thakan ka naam tak na tha, ab aap ne sathi se khana manga aur takleef bayan ki, us waqt aap ke sathi ne farmaya ke pathar ke paas jab hum ne aaram liya tha wahin usi waqt machli toh main bhool gaya aur is ke zikr ko bhi Shaitan ne bhula diya aur is machli ne toh samundar mein ajeeb taur par apni raah nikal li. Machli ke liye surang ban gayi aur un ke liye hairat ka baais ban gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki toh talash thi, chunancha apne nishan-e-qadam dekhte hue dono wapas huay, usi pathar ke paas pahunchay dekha ke ek sahib kapron mein liptay huay baithay hain. Aap ne salam kiya, us ne kaha ta'ajjub hai aap ki sar-zameen mein yeh salam kahan? Aap ne farmaya main Musa hoon, unhon ne poocha kya Bani Israel ke Musa? Aap ne farmaya haan aur main is liye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe woh sikhayen jo bhalai aap ko Allah ki taraf se sikhayi gayi hai. Aap ne farmaya Musa A.S aap mere sath sabr nahin kar sakte. Is liye ke mujhe jo ilm hai woh aap ko nahin aur aap ko jo ilm hai woh mujhe nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne dono ko judagana ilm ata farma rakha hai.

Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya Insha'Allah aap dekhenge ke main sabr karunga aur aap ke kisi farman ki nafarmani na karunga. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya achha agar tum mera saath chahte ho to mujh se khud kisi baat ka sawal na karna yahan tak ke main aap ko is ki babat khabardar karun. Itni baatein tay kar ke dono saath chale darya ke kinare ek kashti thi un se apne saath le jaane ki baat cheet karne lage unhon ne Khizr A.S ko pehchan liya aur baghair kiraya liye dono ko sawar kar liya. Kuch hi door chale honge ke Hazrat Musa A.S ne dekha ke Khizr A.S chup chap kashti ke takhte kulhare se tod rahe hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya yeh kya? In logon ne to hamare saath ehsan kiya baghair kiraya liye kashti mein sawar kiya aur aap ne is ke takhte todne shuru kar diye jis se tamam ahl-e-kashti doob jayen yeh to bada hi na-khushgawar kaam karne lage. Isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho main ne to tum se pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Musa A.S ma'zrat karne lage ke khata ho gayi bhoole se pooch baitha maaf farmaiye aur sakhti na kijiye. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain waqai yeh pehli ghalti bhool se hi thi farmate hain kashti ke ek takhte par ek chidiya aa baithi aur samundar mein chonch daal kar pani le kar ud gayi, us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne Hazrat Musa A.S se farmaya mere aur tere ilm ne Allah ke ilm mein se utna hi kam kiya hai jitna pani samundar mein se is chidiya ki chonch ne kam kiya hai. Ab kashti kinare lagi aur sahil par dono chalne lage ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ki nigah chand khelte hue bachon par padi un mein se ek bache ka sar pakad kar Hazrat Khizr A.S ne is tarah marod diya ke isi waqt us ka dam nikal gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ghabra gaye aur farmane lage baghair kisi qatl ke is bache ko aap ne na-haq maar dala? Aap ne bada hi munkar kaam kiya. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho isi ko main ne pehle hi se keh diya tha ke tumhari hamari nibh nahin sakti us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne pehle se zyada sakhti ki. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya achha ab agar main koi sawal kar baithun to beshak aap mujhe apne saath na rakhna yaqeenan ab aap ma'zoor ho gaye, chunancha phir dono hamrah chale ek basti walon ke paas pahunche un se khana manga lekin unhon ne un ki mehmandari se saaf inkar kar diya, wahin ek deewar dekhi jo jhuk gayi thi aur girne ke qareeb thi, isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne haath laga kar use theek aur durust kar diya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya khayal to farmaiye hum yahan aaye in logon se khana talab kiya unhon ne na diya mehman nawazi ke khilaf kiya un ka yeh kaam tha aap in se ujrat le sakte the. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya yeh hai mujh mein aur tum mein judai ab main tumhein in kamon ki asliyat batla dunga. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain kaash ke Hazrat Musa A.S sabr se kaam lete to in dono ki aur bhi bahut si baatein hamare samne Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qira'at mein 'wa kana wara'ahum' ke badle 'wa kana amamahum' hai aur 'safinatin' ke baad 'salihatan' ka lafz bhi hai aur 'wa ammal ghulamu' ke baad 'fa kana kafiran' ke lafz bhi hain. Aur sanad se bhi yeh hadith marwi hai is mein hai ke is patthar ke paas Hazrat Musa A.S ruk gaye wahin ek chashma tha jis ka naam 'Nahr-e-Hayat' tha is ka pani jis cheez ko lag jata hai woh zinda ho jati thi. Is mein chiriya ki chonch ka pani is samundar ke muqable mein, al-kh. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ke ghar mein un ke paas tha aap ne farmaya ke jis ko jo sawal karna ho kar le main ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe aap par fida kare Kufe mein ek wa'iz hain jin ka naam Nauf hai phir puri hadith bayan ki jaisa ke upar guzri is mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ke is khutbe se aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dilon mein narmi aa gayi thi, jab aap jaane lage to ek shakhs aap ke paas pahuncha aur us ne sawal kiya ke roo-e-zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin is par Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko itaab kiya kyunke unhon ne Allah ki taraf ilm ko na lautaya is mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne nishan talab kiya to irshad hua ke ek machhli apne saath rakh lo jis jagah is mein rooh parh jaye wahin par aap ki is shakhs se mulaqat ho gayi. Chunancha aap ne machhli li zanbeel mein rakh li aur apne saathi se kaha aap ka sirf itna hi kaam hai ke jahan machhli aap ke paas se chali jaye wahan aap mujhe khabar kar dena unhon ne kaha yeh to bilkul aasaan si baat hai. Un ka naam Yusha bin Noon tha. 'Laftan' se yahi murad hai. Yeh dono buzurg tar jagah mein ek darakht tale the Hazrat Musa A.S ko neend aa gayi thi aur Hazrat Yusha jaag rahe the jo machhli kood gayi unhon ne khayal kiya ke jagana to theek nahin jab aankh khule gi zikr kar doon ga. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Hazrat Khizr (A.S) hain. Pas Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke un ko main dekh loon. Wahi hui ke achha samundar ke kinare jao, wahan tumhein ek machhli milegi, use le lo, apne sathi ko sonp do, phir kinare chal do, jahan tum machhli ko bhool jao aur woh tujh se gum ho jaye, wahin tum mere is nek bande ko paoge. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab chalte chalte thak gaye to apne sathi se, jo un ka ghulam tha, machhli ke bare mein sawal kiya. Us ne jawab diya ke jis patthar ke paas hum thehre the, wahin main machhli ko bhool gaya aur tujh se zikr karna shaitan ne bilkul bhula diya. Main ne dekha ke machhli to goya surang banati hui dariya mein ja rahi hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) bhi apni lakri se pani ko cheerte hue us ke peeche ho liye. Machhli jahan se guzarti thi us ke dono taraf ka pani patthar ban jata tha, is se bhi Allah ke Nabi sakht muta'ajjib hue. Ab machhli ek jazeere mein aap ko le gayi al-kh. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Hur bin Qais mein ikhtilaf tha ke Musa (A.S) ke yeh sahib kaun the. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne unhein bula kar apna ikhtilaf bayan kiya. Unhon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hui woh hadith bayan ki jo taqreeban oopar guzar chuki hai. Is mein sail ke sawal ke alfaz yeh hain ke kya aap us shakhs ka hona bhi jante hain jo aap se zyada ilm wala ho?

Hazrat Musa A.S aur Allah ka ek banda. Hazrat Musa A.S se zikr kiya gaya ke Allah ka ek banda do darya milne ki jagah hai, us ke paas woh ilm hai jo tumhein hasil nahin. Aap ne usi waqt un se mulaqat karne ki thaan li. Ab apne saathi se farmate hain ke main toh pahunche baghair dam na loonga. Kehte hain yeh do samundar ek toh Bahira-e-Fars mashriqi aur dusra Bahira-e-Room maghribi hai. Yeh jagah Tanja ke paas maghrib ke shehron ke aakhir mein hai, wallahu aalam. Toh farmate hain ke go mujhe qarnon tak chalna pade koi harj nahin. Kehte hain ke Qais ki lughat mein baras ko huqab kehte hain. Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain, huqab se murad assi baras hain. Mujahid R.H sattar baras kehte hain. Ibn Abbas R.A zamana batlate hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hukum mila tha ke apne saath namak chadhee hui ek machhli lein, jahan woh gum ho jaye wahin hamara banda milega. Yeh dono machhli ko saath liye chale, Majma-ul-Bahrain mein pahunch gaye. Wahan Nehr-e-Hayat thi, wahin dono lait gaye. Us nehr ke pani ke chheente machhli par pade, machhli hilne julne lag gayi. Aap ke saath Hazrat Yusha A.S ki zanbeel mein yeh machhli rakhi hui thi aur woh samundar ke kinare tha. Machhli ne samundar ke andar kood jaane ke liye just lagayi aur Hazrat Yusha ki aankh khul gayi. Machhli un ke dekhte hue pani mein gayi aur pani mein seedha soorakh hota chala gaya, pas jis tarah zameen mein soorakh aur surang ban jati hai, isi tarah pani mein jahan se woh gayi soorakh ho gaya, idhar udhar pani khada ho gaya aur woh soorakh bilkul khula hua raha. Patthar ki tarah pani mein chhed ho gaya, jahan jis pani ko lagti hui woh machhli gayi wahan ka woh pani patthar jaisa ho gaya aur woh soorakh banta chala gaya. Muhammad bin Ishaq marfoo'an laye hain ke Huzoor ﷺ is baat ka bayan karte hue farmaya ke pani is tarah ibtida-e-duniya se nahin jama siwaye us machhli ke chale jaane ki jagah ke ird-gird ke pani ke. Yeh nishan misl soorakh-e-zameen ke barabar Musa A.S ke wapas pahunchne tak baqi hi rahe. Is nishan ko dekhte hi Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki talash mein toh hum thay. Jab machhli ko bhool kar yeh dono aage badhe. Yahan yeh baat yaad rakhne ki hai ke ek ka kaam dono sathiyon ki taraf mansoob hua hai. Bhoolne wale sirf Yusha thay. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yakhruju minhuma al-lu'lu'u wal-marjan) yani in dono samundaron mein se moti aur moongay nikalte hain. Halankeh do qaulon mein se ek yeh hai ke lu'lu aur marjan sirf khari pani mein se nikalte hain. Jab wahan se ek marhala aur tay kar gaye toh Hazrat Musa A.S ne apne saathi se nashta talab kiya aur safar ki takleef bhi bayan ki, yeh takleef maqsood se aage nikal aane ke baad hui. Is par aap ke saathi ko machhli ka chala jana yaad aaya aur kaha jis chattan ke paas hum thehre thay us waqt main machhli bhool gaya aur aap se zikr karna bhi Shaitan ne yaad se hata diya. Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat "an adhkurahu" hai. Farmate hain ke is machhli ne toh ajeeb-o-ghareeb taur par pani mein apni raah pakdi.

Usi waqt Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya lo aur suno isi jagah ki talash mein hum thay toh woh dono apne raaste par apne nishanat-e-qadam ke khoj par wapas lautay. Wahan hamare bandon mein se ek banday ko paya jisay hum ne apne paas ki rahmat aur apne paas ka ilm ata farma rakha tha. Yeh Hazrat Khizr A.S hain. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se kaha ke Hazrat Nauf ka khayal hai ke Khizr A.S se milne wale Musa, Bani Israel ke Musa na thay. Ibn Abbas R.A ne farmaya woh dushman-e-Rab jhoota hai, hum se Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A ne farmaya hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se unhon ne suna ke Hazrat Musa A.S kharay ho kar Bani Israel mein khutba kar rahe thay jo aap se sawal hua ke sab se bada aalim kaun hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke main. Toh chunke aap ne is ke jawab mein yeh na farmaya ke Allah janay is liye Rab ko yeh kalma na-pasand aaya, usi waqt wahi aayi ke haan Majma-ul-Bahrain mein hamara ek banda hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai. Is par Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya phir Parwardigar main us tak kaisay pahunch sakta hoon? Hukm hua ke apne sath ek machli rakh lo usay toshay-daan mein daal lo jahan woh machli gum ho jaye wahin woh mil jayenge. Toh aap apne sath apne sathi Yusha bin Nun A.S ko le kar chalay, pathar ke paas pahunch kar apne sar us par rakh kar do ghari so rahay. Machli us toshay-daan mein tarpi aur kood kar us se nikal gayi, samundar mein aisi gayi jaise koi surang laga kar zameen mein utar gaya ho, pani ka chalna behna Allah Ta'ala ne mauqoof kar diya aur taaq ki tarah woh surakh baqi reh gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S jab jaagay toh aap ke sathi yeh zikr aap se bhool gaye, usi waqt wahan se chal paray, din poora honay ke baad raat bhar chaltay rahay, subah Hazrat Musa A.S ko thakan aur bhook mehsoos hui, Allah ne jahan janay ka hukm diya tha jab tak wahan se aagay na nikal gaye thakan ka naam tak na tha, ab aap ne sathi se khana manga aur takleef bayan ki, us waqt aap ke sathi ne farmaya ke pathar ke paas jab hum ne aaram liya tha wahin usi waqt machli toh main bhool gaya aur is ke zikr ko bhi Shaitan ne bhula diya aur is machli ne toh samundar mein ajeeb taur par apni raah nikal li. Machli ke liye surang ban gayi aur un ke liye hairat ka baais ban gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya isi ki toh talash thi, chunancha apne nishan-e-qadam dekhte hue dono wapas huay, usi pathar ke paas pahunchay dekha ke ek sahib kapron mein liptay huay baithay hain. Aap ne salam kiya, us ne kaha ta'ajjub hai aap ki sar-zameen mein yeh salam kahan? Aap ne farmaya main Musa hoon, unhon ne poocha kya Bani Israel ke Musa? Aap ne farmaya haan aur main is liye aaya hoon ke aap mujhe woh sikhayen jo bhalai aap ko Allah ki taraf se sikhayi gayi hai. Aap ne farmaya Musa A.S aap mere sath sabr nahin kar sakte. Is liye ke mujhe jo ilm hai woh aap ko nahin aur aap ko jo ilm hai woh mujhe nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne dono ko judagana ilm ata farma rakha hai.

Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya Insha'Allah aap dekhenge ke main sabr karunga aur aap ke kisi farman ki nafarmani na karunga. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya achha agar tum mera saath chahte ho to mujh se khud kisi baat ka sawal na karna yahan tak ke main aap ko is ki babat khabardar karun. Itni baatein tay kar ke dono saath chale darya ke kinare ek kashti thi un se apne saath le jaane ki baat cheet karne lage unhon ne Khizr A.S ko pehchan liya aur baghair kiraya liye dono ko sawar kar liya. Kuch hi door chale honge ke Hazrat Musa A.S ne dekha ke Khizr A.S chup chap kashti ke takhte kulhare se tod rahe hain. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya yeh kya? In logon ne to hamare saath ehsan kiya baghair kiraya liye kashti mein sawar kiya aur aap ne is ke takhte todne shuru kar diye jis se tamam ahl-e-kashti doob jayen yeh to bada hi na-khushgawar kaam karne lage. Isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho main ne to tum se pehle hi keh diya tha ke tum mere saath sabr nahin kar sakte. Hazrat Musa A.S ma'zrat karne lage ke khata ho gayi bhoole se pooch baitha maaf farmaiye aur sakhti na kijiye. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain waqai yeh pehli ghalti bhool se hi thi farmate hain kashti ke ek takhte par ek chidiya aa baithi aur samundar mein chonch daal kar pani le kar ud gayi, us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne Hazrat Musa A.S se farmaya mere aur tere ilm ne Allah ke ilm mein se utna hi kam kiya hai jitna pani samundar mein se is chidiya ki chonch ne kam kiya hai. Ab kashti kinare lagi aur sahil par dono chalne lage ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ki nigah chand khelte hue bachon par padi un mein se ek bache ka sar pakad kar Hazrat Khizr A.S ne is tarah marod diya ke isi waqt us ka dam nikal gaya. Hazrat Musa A.S ghabra gaye aur farmane lage baghair kisi qatl ke is bache ko aap ne na-haq maar dala? Aap ne bada hi munkar kaam kiya. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya dekho isi ko main ne pehle hi se keh diya tha ke tumhari hamari nibh nahin sakti us waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne pehle se zyada sakhti ki. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya achha ab agar main koi sawal kar baithun to beshak aap mujhe apne saath na rakhna yaqeenan ab aap ma'zoor ho gaye, chunancha phir dono hamrah chale ek basti walon ke paas pahunche un se khana manga lekin unhon ne un ki mehmandari se saaf inkar kar diya, wahin ek deewar dekhi jo jhuk gayi thi aur girne ke qareeb thi, isi waqt Hazrat Khizr A.S ne haath laga kar use theek aur durust kar diya. Hazrat Musa A.S ne farmaya khayal to farmaiye hum yahan aaye in logon se khana talab kiya unhon ne na diya mehman nawazi ke khilaf kiya un ka yeh kaam tha aap in se ujrat le sakte the. Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya yeh hai mujh mein aur tum mein judai ab main tumhein in kamon ki asliyat batla dunga. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain kaash ke Hazrat Musa A.S sabr se kaam lete to in dono ki aur bhi bahut si baatein hamare samne Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ki qira'at mein 'wa kana wara'ahum' ke badle 'wa kana amamahum' hai aur 'safinatin' ke baad 'salihatan' ka lafz bhi hai aur 'wa ammal ghulamu' ke baad 'fa kana kafiran' ke lafz bhi hain. Aur sanad se bhi yeh hadith marwi hai is mein hai ke is patthar ke paas Hazrat Musa A.S ruk gaye wahin ek chashma tha jis ka naam 'Nahr-e-Hayat' tha is ka pani jis cheez ko lag jata hai woh zinda ho jati thi. Is mein chiriya ki chonch ka pani is samundar ke muqable mein, al-kh. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki ek aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ke ghar mein un ke paas tha aap ne farmaya ke jis ko jo sawal karna ho kar le main ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe aap par fida kare Kufe mein ek wa'iz hain jin ka naam Nauf hai phir puri hadith bayan ki jaisa ke upar guzri is mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ke is khutbe se aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dilon mein narmi aa gayi thi, jab aap jaane lage to ek shakhs aap ke paas pahuncha aur us ne sawal kiya ke roo-e-zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin is par Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko itaab kiya kyunke unhon ne Allah ki taraf ilm ko na lautaya is mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne nishan talab kiya to irshad hua ke ek machhli apne saath rakh lo jis jagah is mein rooh parh jaye wahin par aap ki is shakhs se mulaqat ho gayi. Chunancha aap ne machhli li zanbeel mein rakh li aur apne saathi se kaha aap ka sirf itna hi kaam hai ke jahan machhli aap ke paas se chali jaye wahan aap mujhe khabar kar dena unhon ne kaha yeh to bilkul aasaan si baat hai. Un ka naam Yusha bin Noon tha. 'Laftan' se yahi murad hai. Yeh dono buzurg tar jagah mein ek darakht tale the Hazrat Musa A.S ko neend aa gayi thi aur Hazrat Yusha jaag rahe the jo machhli kood gayi unhon ne khayal kiya ke jagana to theek nahin jab aankh khule gi zikr kar doon ga. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke pani mein jaane ke waqt jo soorakh ho gaya tha use rawi-e-hadith Amr ne apne angoothe aur us ke paas ki dono ungliyon ka halqa kar ke dikhaya ke is tarah ka tha jaise patthar mein hota hai. Wapsi par Hazrat Khizr A.S samundar ke kinare sabz gaddi bichaye mile ek chadar mein lipte hue the is ka ek sira to dono pairon ke neeche rakha hua tha aur dusra kinara sar tale tha, Hazrat Musa A.S ke salam par aap ne munh khola. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr A.S ne farmaya ke aap ke haath mein Taurat maujood hai wahi aasman se aa rahi hai kya yeh bas nahin? Aur mera ilm aap ke laiq bhi nahin aur na main aap ke ilm ke qabil hoon. Is mein hai ke kashti ka takhta tor kar aap ne ek taant se baandh diya tha. Pehli dafa ka aap ka sawal to bhoole se hi tha dusri martaba ka bator-e-shart ke tha haan teesri baar ka sawal qasdan alaihadgi ki wajah se tha. Is mein hai ke larkon mein ek larka tha kafir hoshiyar use Hazrat Khizr ne lita kar chhuri se zibah kar diya ek qira'at mein 'zakiyatan muslimatan' bhi hai.

Wara'ahum ki qira'at imamahum bhi hai. Is zalim badshah ka naam is mein Hado bin Bado hai aur jis bachay ko qatl kiya gaya tha us ka naam Jesoor tha. Kehte hain ke is larkay ke badlay un ke yahan ek larki hui. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) khutba kar rahe thay aur farmaya ke Allah ko aur us ke Amr-e-Ilahi ko mujh se zyada koi nahin janta. Al-kh. Yeh Nauf Ka'ab (R.A) ki biwi ke larkay ka qaul tha ke jis Musa ka in ayaton mein zikr hai yeh Musa bin Mesha thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke ae Allah agar tere bandon mein mujh se bada aalim koi ho to mujhe aagah farma, is mein hai ke namak charhi hui machli aap ne apne sath rakhi thi. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ne farmaya tum yahan kyun aaye? Aap ko to abhi Bani Israel mein hi mashghool-e-kaar rehna hai. Is mein hai ke chupi hui baatein Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ko maloom karayi jati thin to aap ne farmaya ke tum mere sath theher nahin sakte kyunke aap to zahir ko dekh kar faisla karenge aur mujhe raaz par ittila hoti hai, chunancha shart ho gayi ke go aap kaisa hi khilaf dekhein lekin lab na hilayein jab tak ke Hazrat Khizr khud na batlayein. Kehte hain ke yeh kashti tamam kashtiyon se mazboot, umda aur achi thi, woh bacha ek bemisal bacha tha, bada haseen, bada hoshiyar, bada hi tarar. Hazrat Khizr ne usay pakar kar pathar se us ka sar kuchal kar usay maar dala. Hazrat Musa khauf-e-Allah se kanp uthay ke nanha sa pyara beganah bacha is bedardi se baghair kisi sabab ke Hazrat Khizr ne jaan se maar dala. Deewar girti hui dekh kar theher gaye, pehle to usay baqaida giraya aur phir ba-aram chunne baithay. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ukta gaye ke baithe bithaye acha dhanda le baithe. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is deewar ke neeche ka khana sirf ilm tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur aap ki qoum Misr par ghalib aa gayi aur yahan aa kar woh ba-aram rehne sehne lage to hukm-e-Ilahi hua ke inhe Allah ke ehsanat yaad dila'o. Aap khutbay ke liye kharay hue aur Allah ke ehsanat bayan karne lage ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhe yeh yeh ne'matein ata farmayin, Aal-e-Firaun se us ne tumhe nijat di, tumhare dushmanon ko gharat aur gharq kar diya, phir tumhe un ki zameen ka malik kar diya, tumhare Nabi se baatein keen, usay apne liye pasand farma liya, us par apni mohabbat daal di, tumhari tamam hajatein poori keen, tumhare Nabi tamam zameen walon se afzal hain, us ne tumhe Taurat ata farmayi. Al-gharaz pooray zoron se Allah ki beshumar aur anginat ne'matein inhe yaad dilayin. Is par ek Bani Israel ne kaha fi-al-waqay baat yahi hai ae Nabi-e-Allah kya zameen par aap se zyada ilm wala bhi koi hai? Aap ne besakhta farmaya ke nahin hai. Isi waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko bheja ke un se kaho ke tumhe kya maloom ke main apna ilm kahan kahan rakhta hoon? Beshak samundar ke kinare par ek shakhs hai jo tujh se bhi zyada aalim hai.

Shauq-e-Ta'leem-o-Ta'allum: Yahan is guftagu ka zikr ho raha hai jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ke darmiyan hui thi. Hazrat Khizr is ilm ke sath makhsoos kiye gaye thay jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko na tha. Aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke paas woh ilm tha jis se Hazrat Khizr (A.S) be-khabar thay. Pas Hazrat Musa (A.S) adab se aur is liye ke Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ko meharban kar lein, un se sawal karte hain. Shagird ko isi tarah adab ke sath apne ustad se daryaft karna chahiye. Poochte hain ke agar ijazat ho to main aap ke sath rahoon, aap ki khidmat karta rahoon aur aap se ilm hasil karoon jis se mujhe nafa pahunche aur mere amal nek ho jayen.

Hazrat Khizr (A.S) is ke jawab mein farmate hain ke tum mera sath nahin nibha sakte. Mere kaam aap ko apne ilm ke khilaf nazar ayenge. Mera ilm aap ko nahin aur aap ko jo ilm hai woh Allah ne mujhe nahin sikhaya. Pas main apni ek alag khidmat par muqarrar hoon aur aap alag khidmat par. Namumkin hai ke aap apni maloomat ke khilaf mere af'aal dekhein aur phir sabr kar sakein. Aur waqia mein aap is haal mein ma'zoor bhi hain, kyunke batini hikmat aur maslahat aap ko maloom nahin aur mujhe Allah Ta'ala un par muttala farma diya karta hai.

Is par Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne jawab diya ke aap jo kuch karenge main use sabr se bardasht karta rahoonga, kisi baat mein aap ke khilaf na karoon ga. Phir Hazrat Khizr (A.S) ne ek shart pesh ki ke achha, kisi cheez ke bare mein tum mujh se sawal na karna, main jo kahoon woh sun lena, tum apni taraf se kisi sawal ki ibtida na karna.

Ibn-e-Jareer mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen Azza-wa-Jall se sawal kiya ke tujhe apne bandon se zyada pyara kaun hai? Jawab mila ke jo har waqt meri yaad mein rahe aur mujhe na bhulaye. Poocha ke tamam bandon mein se achha faisla karne wala kaun hai? Farmaya jo haq ke sath faisle kare aur khwahish ke peeche na pade. Daryaft kiya ke sab se bada aalim kaun hai? Farmaya woh jo aalim zyada ilm ki justuju mein rahe, har ek se seekhta rahe ke mumkin hai koi hidayat ka kalma mil jaye aur mumkin hai koi baat gumrahi se nikalne ki hath lag jaye.

Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne phir daryaft kiya ke kya zameen mein tera koi banda mujh se bhi zyada aalim hai? Farmaya haan. Poocha woh kaun hai? Farmaya Khizr. Farmaya main use kahan talash karoon? Beshak tum nihayat munkar kaam karte ho. Alhamdulillah, Tafsir-e-Muhammadi ka pandrahwan para khatam hua. Allah Ta'ala ise qabool farmaye. Aameen. Summa Aameen.

Ek roz farmane lage hum par Allah ki rahmat ho aur Musa par kaash ke woh apne sathi ke sath aur bhi thehrte aur sabr karte to aur yani bohat si ta'ajjub-khez baatein maloom hotin. Ek aur anokhi baat. Do dafa ke is waqiye ke baad phir dono sahab mil kar chale aur ek basti mein pahunche. Marwi hai woh basti ek thi, yahan ke log bade hi bakheel thay. Inteha yeh ke do bhooke musafiron ke talab karne par unhon ne roti khilane se bhi saaf inkar kar diya. Wahan dekhte hain ke ek deewar girna hi chahti hai, jagah chhod chuki hai, jhuk padi hai. Deewar ki taraf irade ki isnad bator-e-istiyara ke hai. Ise dekhte hi kamar kas kar lag gaye aur dekhte hi dekhte ise mazboot kar diya aur bilkul durust kar diya. Pehle hadith bayan ho chuki hai ke aap ne apne dono hathon se ise lota diya. Zakhm theek ho gaya aur deewar durust ban gayi. Is waqt phir Kaleemullah (A.S) bol uthe ke SubhanAllah, in logon ne to hamein khane tak ko na poocha balki mangne par bhag gaye. Ab jo tum ne in ki yeh mazdoori kar di, is par kuch ujrat kyun na le li jo bilkul hamara haq tha? Is waqt woh banda-e-Ilahi bol uthe, lo sahab ab mujh mein aur aap mein hasb-e-mua'hida khud judai ho gayi. Kyunke bachche ke qatl par aap ne sawal kiya tha, us waqt jab main ne aap ko is ghalti par mutanabbeh kiya tha to aap ne khud hi kaha tha ke ab agar kisi baat ko poochun to mujhe apne sath se alag kar dena. Ab suno, jin baton par aap ne ta'ajjub se sawal kiya aur bardasht na kar sake, un ki asli hikmat aap par zahir kiye deta hoon.

Ek aur anokhi baat. Do dafa ke is waqiye ke baad phir dono sahab mil kar chale aur ek basti mein pahunche. Marwi hai woh basti ek thi, yahan ke log bade hi bakheel thay. Inteha yeh ke do bhooke musafiron ke talab karne par unhon ne roti khilane se bhi saaf inkar kar diya. Wahan dekhte hain ke ek deewar girna hi chahti hai, jagah chhod chuki hai, jhuk padi hai. Deewar ki taraf irade ki isnad bator-e-istiyara ke hai. Ise dekhte hi kamar kas kar lag gaye aur dekhte hi dekhte ise mazboot kar diya aur bilkul durust kar diya. Pehle hadith bayan ho chuki hai ke aap ne apne dono hathon se ise lota diya. Zakhm theek ho gaya aur deewar durust ban gayi. Is waqt phir Kaleemullah (A.S) bol uthe ke SubhanAllah, in logon ne to hamein khane tak ko na poocha balki mangne par bhag gaye. Ab jo tum ne in ki yeh mazdoori kar di, is par kuch ujrat kyun na le li jo bilkul hamara haq tha? Is waqt woh banda-e-Ilahi bol uthe, lo sahab ab mujh mein aur aap mein hasb-e-mua'hida khud judai ho gayi. Kyunke bachche ke qatl par aap ne sawal kiya tha, us waqt jab main ne aap ko is ghalti par mutanabbeh kiya tha to aap ne khud hi kaha tha ke ab agar kisi baat ko poochun to mujhe apne sath se alag kar dena. Ab suno, jin baton par aap ne ta'ajjub se sawal kiya aur bardasht na kar sake, un ki asli hikmat aap par zahir kiye deta hoon.

Allah ki maslahaton ki wazahat. Baat yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne in baaton ke anjam se Hazrat Khizr ko muttala kar diya tha aur unhein jo hukum mila tha Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko us raaz ka ilm na tha is liye bazahir ise khilaf samajh kar is par inkar karte the lehaza Hazrat Khizr ne ab asal mamla samjha diya. Farmaya ke kashti ko aib-dar karne mein toh yeh maslahat thi ke agar sahih salim hoti toh aage chal kar ek zalim badshah tha jo har ek achi kashti ko zulman chheen leta tha. Jab use woh tooti phooti dekhe ga toh chhor de ga agar yeh theek thak aur sabit hoti toh sari kashti hi in maskeenon ke hath se chhin jati aur un ki rozi kamane ka yahi ek zariya tha jo bilkul jata rehta. Marwi hai ke is kashti ke malik chand yateem bachay thay. Ibn Juraij kehte hain is badshah ka naam Hado-bin-Bado tha. Bukhari Sharif ke hawalay se yeh riwayat pehle guzar chuki hai. Taurat mein hai ke yeh Ais bin Ishaq ki nasl se tha Taurat mein jin badshahon ka sareeh zikr hai un mein ek yeh bhi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Allah ki raza aur insaan. Pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke us naujawan ka naam Haithoor tha. Hadees mein hai ke uski jibillat mein hi kufr tha. Hazrat Khizr (A.S) farmate hain ke bahut mumkin tha ke is bachay ki mohabbat uske maa baap ko bhi kufr ki taraf mail kar de. Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain iski paidaish se uske maa baap bahut khush hue thay aur uski halakat se woh bahut ghamgeen hue halankeh uski zindagi unke liye halakat thi. Pas insaan ko chahiye ke Allah ki qaza par raazi rahe. Rabb anjaam ko jaanta hai aur hum us se ghaafil hain. Momin jo kaam apne liye pasand karta hai, uski apni pasand se woh achha hai jo Allah uske liye pasand farmata hai. Sahih hadees mein hai ke momin ke liye Allah ke faislay hote hain woh sarasar behtari aur umdagi walay hi hote hain. Quran-e-Kareem mein hai (Fa'asa an takrahu shai'an wa yaj'alallahu feehi khairan katheera) (Surah An-Nisa: 19) yani bahut mumkin hai ke ek kaam tum apne liye bura aur zarar wala samajhte ho aur woh darasal tumhare liye bhala aur mufeed ho. Hazrat Khizr (A.S) farmate hain ke hum ne chaha ke Allah unhein aisa bacha de jo bahut parhezgar ho aur jis par maa baap ko zyada pyaar ho. Ya yeh ke jo maa baap ke saath nek sulook karta ho. Pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke us larkay ke badlay Allah ne unke haan ek larki di. Marwi hai ke us bachay ke qatl ke waqt uski walida ke hamal se ek musalman larka tha aur woh hamila thin.

Hazrat Khizr (A.S) farmate hain ke hum ne chaha ke Allah unhein aisa bacha de jo bahut parhezgar ho aur jis par maa baap ko zyada pyaar ho. Ya yeh ke jo maa baap ke saath nek sulook karta ho. Pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke us larkay ke badlay Allah ne unke haan ek larki di. Marwi hai ke us bachay ke qatl ke waqt uski walida ke hamal se ek musalman larka tha aur woh hamila thin.

Allah ki hifazat ka ek andaaz. Is aayat se saabit hua ke bade shehar par bhi qarya ka itlaaq ho sakta hai kyunke pehle (اِذَآ اَتَيَآ اَهْلَ قَرْيَـةِ 77؀) (18-Al-Kahf: 77) farmaya tha aur yahan fi-al-madinati farmaya. Isi tarah Makkah Sharif ko bhi qarya kaha gaya hai. Farman hai (وَكَاَيِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّنْ قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِيْٓ اَخْرَجَتْكَ ۚ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ 13؀) (47-Muhammad: 13) aur aayat mein Makkah aur Taif dono shehron ko qarya farmaya gaya hai chunancha irshad hai (وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَـتَيْنِ عَظِيْمٍ 31؀) (43-Az-Zukhruf: 31). Aayat mein bayaan ho raha hai ke is deewar ko durust kar dene mein maslahat-e-Ilahi yeh thi ke yeh is shehar ke do yateemon ki thi, iske neeche unka maal dafan tha. Theek tafseer toh yahi hai goya yeh bhi marwi hai ke woh ilmi khazana tha. Balkay ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai ke jis khazane ka zikr Kitabullah mein hai yeh khaalis sone ki takhtiyan thin jin par likha hua tha ke ta'ajjub hai us shakhs par jo taqdeer ka qail hote hue apni jaan ko mehnat-o-mashaqqat mein daal raha hai aur ranj-o-gham bardasht kar raha hai. Ta'ajjub hai ke jo Jahannam ke azaabon ka maanne wala hai phir bhi hansi khel mein mashghool hai. Ta'ajjub hai ke maut ka yaqeen rakhte hue ghaflat mein pada hua hai. La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah. Yeh ibarat un takhtiyon par likhi hui thi lekin is mein ek raawi Bishr bin Munzir hain. Kaha gaya hai ke yeh Masisa ke qazi thay unki hadith mein wahm hai. Salaf se bhi is baare mein baaz aasar marwi hain. Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yeh sone ki takhti thi jis mein Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim ke baad qareeb qareeb mandaraja baala nasihaten aur aakhir mein Kalima-e-Tayyaba tha. Umar Maula Ghafrah se bhi taqreeban yahi marwi hai. Imam Jafar bin Muhammad (Rahimahullah) farmate hain is mein dhai satrein thin poori teen na thin, al-kh. Mazkoor hai ke yeh dono yateem bajah apne saatwein dada ki nekiyon ke mehfooz rakhe gaye thay. Jin buzurgon ne yeh tafseer ki hai woh bhi pehli tafseer ke khilaf nahin kyunke is mein bhi hai ke yeh ilmi baatein sone ki takhti par likhi hui thin aur zahir hai ke sone ki takhti khud maal hai aur bahut badi raqam ki cheez hai. Wallahu A'lam. Is aayat se yeh bhi saabit hota hai ke insaan ki nekiyon ki wajah se uske baal bachay bhi duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ki meherbani hasil kar lete hain. Jaise Quran mein sarahatan mazkoor hai dekhiye aayat mein unki koi salahiyat bayaan nahin hui haan unke walid ki nek-bakhti aur neki amlan bayaan hui hai. Aur pehle guzar chuka hai yeh baap jis ki neki ki wajah se unki hifazat hui yeh un bachon ka saatwan dada tha Wallahu A'lam. Aayat mein hai tere Rab ne chaha, yeh isnaad Allah ki taraf is liye ki gayi hai ke jawani tak pahunchane par bajuz uske aur koi qadir nahin. Dekhiye bachay ke baare mein aur kashti ke baare mein iraday ki nisbat apni taraf ki gayi hai, fa-aradna aur fa-aradtu ke lafz hain Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmate hain ke darasal yeh teeno baatein jinhein tum ne khatarnak samjhein sarasar rahmat thin. Kashti walon ko go qadre nuqsan hua lekin is se poori kashti bach gayi. Bachay ke marne ki wajah se go maa baap ko ranj hua lekin hamesha ke ranj aur azab-e-Ilahi se bach gaye aur phir nek badla hathon hath mil gaya. Aur yahan is nek shakhs ki aulad ka bhala hua. Yeh kaam main ne apni khushi nahin kiye balkay ahkam-e-Ilahi baja laya. Is se baaz logon ne Hazrat Khizr A.S ki nabuwat par istidlal kiya hai aur poori behas pehle guzar chuki hai aur log kehte hain yeh Rasool thay. Ek qaul hai ke yeh farishtay thay lekin aksar buzurgon ka farman hai ke yeh Wali-e-Allah thay. Imam Ibn-e-Qutaiba ne Ma'arif mein likha hai ke un ka naam Bilya bin Malkan bin Khaligh bin Aajar bin Shanh bin Arfakhshad bin Sam bin Nuh A.S tha. Un ki kuniyat Abu-ul-Abbas hai, laqab Khizr hai. Imam Nawawi R.H ne Tehzeeb-ul-Asma mein likha hai ke yeh shehzaday thay. Yeh aur Ibn-e-Salah toh qail hain ke woh ab tak zinda hain aur Qayamat tak zinda rahenge. Go baaz ahadees mein bhi yeh zikr aaya hai lekin un mein se ek bhi sahih nahin. Sab se zyada mashhoor hadees is baray mein woh hai jis mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki ta'ziyat ke liye aap tashreef laye thay lekin is ki sanad bhi za'eef hai. Aksar muhaddiseen waghera is ke barkhilaf hain aur woh hayat-e-Khizr ke qail nahin. Un ki ek daleel aayat-e-Qurani hai (وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ ۭ اَفَا۟ىِٕنْ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخٰلِدُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 34) hai yani tujh se pehle bhi hum ne kisi ko hamesha ki zindagi nahin di. Aur daleel Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ka Ghazwa-e-Badr mein yeh farmana hai ke Ilahi agar meri jamaat halak ho gayi toh zameen mein teri ibadat phir na ki jaye gi. Ek daleel yeh bhi hai ke agar Hazrat Khizr R.H zinda hotay toh Aan-Hazrat ﷺ tamam jinn-o-ins ki taraf Allah ke Rasool bana kar bheje gaye thay. Aap ne toh yahan tak farmaya ke agar Musa A.S aur Isa A.S zinda (zameen par) hotay toh unhein bhi bajuz meri tabedari ke chara na tha. Aap apni wafat se kuch din pehle farmate hain ke aaj jo zameen par hain un mein se ek bhi aaj se le kar sau saal tak baqi nahin rahe ga. In ke ilawa aur bhi bohat se dalail hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Khizr ko Khizr is liye kaha gaya ke woh safaid rang sookhi ghaas par baith gaye thay yahan tak ke us ke neechay sabza ug aaya. Aur mumkin hai ke is se murad yeh ho ke aap khushk zameen par baith gaye thay aur phir woh lehlaane lagi. Al-gharaz Hazrat Khizr A.S ne Hazrat Musa A.S ke samne jab yeh ghutthi suljha di aur in kamon ki asal hikmat bayan kar di toh farmaya ke yeh thay woh raaz jin ke aashkara karne ke liye aap jaldi kar rahe thay. Chunke pehle shauq-o-mushaqqat zyada thi is liye lafz lam tastati' kaha aur ab bayan kar dene ke baad woh baat na rahi is liye lafz lam tastati' kaha. Yehi sifat aayat (فَمَا اسْطَاعُوْٓا اَنْ يَّظْهَرُوْهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوْا لَهٗ نَقْبًا) (Surah Al-Kahf: 97) mein hai.

(Al-Kahf: 97) mein hai yani Yajuj Majuj na is deewar par charh sake aur na is mein koi surakh kar sake. Pas charhne mein takleef ba-nisbat surakh karne ke kam hai is liye saqeel ka muqabla saqeel se aur khafeef ka muqabla khafeef se kiya gaya aur lafzi aur manvi munasibat qaim kar di. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke sathi ka zikr ibtida-e-qissa mein to tha lekin phir nahin is liye ke maqsood sirf Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke baad Bani Israel ke wali banaye gaye thay. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unhon ne Aab-e-Hayat pi liya tha is liye unhein kashti mein bitha kar beech samundar ke chhor diya woh kashti yunhi hamesha tak maujon ke talatum mein rahegi. Yeh bilkul za'eef hai kyunke is waqiye ke rawiyon mein ek mein to Hasan hai jo matrook hai dusra is ka baap hai jo ghair maroof hai. Yeh waqiya sanadan theek hai.

Kuffar ke sawalat ke jawabat. Pehle guzar chuka hai ke kuffar-e-Makkah ne Ahl-e-Kitab se kehwaya tha ke hamein kuch aisi baatein batlao jo hum Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft karein aur un ke jawab aap se na ban padein. Toh unhon ne sikhaya tha ke ek toh un se us shakhs ka waqia pucho jis ne roo-e-zameen ki sayahat ki thi. Dusra sawal un se un naujawanon ki ba-nisbat karo jo bilkul la-pata ho gaye hain aur teesra sawal un se rooh ki babat karo. Un ke in sawalon ke jawab mein yeh Surah nazil hui. Yeh bhi riwayat hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Zulqarnain ka qissa daryaft karne ko aayi thi. Toh aap ne unhein dekhte hi farmaya ke tum is liye aaye ho. Phir aap ne woh waqia bayan farmaya. Is mein hai ke woh ek Roomi naujawan tha isi ne Iskandariya banaya. Use ek farishta aasman tak chadha le gaya tha aur deewar tak le gaya tha us ne kuch logon ko dekha jin ke munh kutton jaise thay waghera. Lekin is mein bahut tool hai aur bekar hai aur za'f hai is ka marfoo hona sabit nahin. Dar-asal yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat hain. Ta'ajjub hai ke Imam Abu Zur'ah Razi jaise Allama-e-Zaman ne ise apni kitab Dalail-e-Nabuwwat mein mukammal warid kiya hai. Fi-al-waq'i yeh un jaise buzurg se toh ta'ajjub-khaiz cheez hi hai. Is mein jo hai ke yeh Roomi tha yeh bhi theek nahin. Iskandar-e-Sani albatta Roomi tha woh Qailis Mafzooni ka ladka hai jis se Room ki tareekh shuru hoti hai aur Iskandar-e-Awwal toh ba-qol Azraqi waghera Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke zamane mein tha. Us ne aap ke sath Baitullah Sharif ki bina ke baad tawaf-e-Baitullah kiya hai. Aap par iman laya tha, aap ka tabe-dar bana tha. Inhi ke wazir Hazrat Khizr (A.S / Alaihis Salam) thay. Aur Iskandar-e-Sani ka wazir Aristatalis mashhoor falsafi tha wallahu a'lam. Isi ne mamlikat-e-Room ki tareekh likhi yeh Hazrat Masih (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se taqreeban teen sau saal pehle tha aur Iskandar-e-Awwal jis ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein hai yeh Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke zamane mein tha jaise ke Azraqi waghera ne zikr kiya hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Baitullah banaya toh us ne aap ke sath tawaf kiya tha aur Allah ke naam bahut si qurbaniyan ki thin. Hum ne Allah ke fazl se un ke bahut se waqiat apni kitab Al-Bidayah wan-Nihayah mein zikr kar diye hain. Wahab kehte hain yeh badshah thay chunke un ke sar ke dono taraf tanba rehta tha is liye unhein Zulqarnain kaha gaya yeh wajah bhi batlai gayi hai ke yeh Room ka aur Fars ka dono ka badshah tha. Ba'az ka qaul hai ke fi-al-waq'i us ke sar ke dono taraf kuch seeng se thay. Hazrat Ali (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain is naam ki wajah yeh hai ke yeh Allah ke nek bande thay apni qoum ko Allah ki taraf bulaya yeh log mukhalif ho gaye aur un ke sar ke ek janib is qadar mara ke yeh shaheed ho gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein dobara zinda kar diya qoum ne phir sar ke dusri taraf isi qadar mara jis se yeh phir mar gaye is liye unhein Zulqarnain kaha jata hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke chunke yeh mashriq se maghrib ki taraf sayahat kar aaye thay is liye unhein Zulqarnain kaha gaya hai.

Hum ne use bari saltanat de rakhi thi. Saath hi quwwat-e-lashkar, aalaat-e-harb, sab kuch hi de rakha tha. Mashriq se maghrib tak us ki saltanat thi, Arab-o-Ajam sab us ke matahat thay. Har cheez ka use ilm de rakha tha. Zameen ke adna-o-aala nishanaat batla diye thay. Tamam zabanain jantay thay. Jis qoum se larai hoti us ki zaban bol letay thay. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H) se Hazrat Ameer Mu'awiyah (R.A) ne farmaya tha, kya tum kehtay ho ke Zulqarnain ne apne ghoray Surayya se bandhay thay? Unhon ne jawab diya ke agar aap yeh farmatay hain to suniye, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai hum ne use har cheez ka saman diya tha. Haqeeqat mein is baat mein haq Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ke saath hai, is liye bhi ke Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ko jo kuch kahin likha milta tha riwayat kar diya kartay thay go woh jhoot hi ho. Isi liye aap ne farmaya hai ke Ka'ab ka kazb to baara samne aa chuka hai, yani khud to jhoot nahin gharte thay lekin jo riwayat milti go be-sanad ho bayan karne se na chooktay. Aur yeh zahir hai ke Bani Israel ki riwayaat jhoot, khurafaat, tahreef, tabdeeli se mehfooz na thin. Baat yeh hai ke hamain in Israeli riwayat ki taraf iltifaat karne ki bhi kya zaroorat? Jab ke hamaray hathon mein Allah ki Kitab aur us ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sachi aur sahih ahadees majood hain. Afsos! Inhi Bani Israeli riwayaat ne bohat si burai musalmanon mein daal di aur fasaad phail gaya. Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne is Bani Israel ki riwayat ke suboot mein Quran ki is aayat ka aakhri hissa jo pesh kiya hai yeh bhi kuch theek nahin, kyunke yeh to bilkul zahir baat hai ke kisi insaan ko Allah Ta'ala ne aasmanon par aur Surayya par pohanchne ki taqat nahin di. Dekhiye, Bilqees ke haq mein bhi Quran ne yahi alfaaz kahe hain (وَاُوْتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّ لَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيْمٌ) (Surah An-Naml: 23). Woh har cheez di gayi thi, is se bhi murad sirf isi qadar hai ke badshahon ke haan umooman jo hota hai woh sab us ke paas bhi tha. Isi tarah Hazrat Zulqarnain ko Allah ne tamam raastay aur zaraye muhayya kar diye thay ke woh apni futoohat ko wus'at detay jayain aur zameen sarkashon aur kafiron se khali karate jayain aur us ki tauheed ke saath muwahhideen ki badshahat duniya par phailayain aur Allah walon ki hukoomat jamayain. In kamon mein jin asbaab ki zaroorat parti hai woh sab Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne Hazrat Zulqarnain ko de rakhay thay, Wallahu A'alam. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se poocha jata hai ke yeh mashriq-o-maghrib tak kaisay pohanch gaye? Aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah. Allah Ta'ala ne badalon ko un ke liye musakhar kar diya tha aur tamam asbaab unhain muhayya kar diye thay aur poori quwwat-o-taqat de di thi.

Kuffar ke sawalat ke jawabat. Pehle guzar chuka hai ke kuffar-e-Makkah ne Ahl-e-Kitab se kehwaya tha ke hamein kuch aisi baatein batlao jo hum Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft karein aur un ke jawab aap se na ban padein. Toh unhon ne sikhaya tha ke ek toh un se us shakhs ka waqia pucho jis ne roo-e-zameen ki sayahat ki thi. Dusra sawal un se un naujawanon ki ba-nisbat karo jo bilkul la-pata ho gaye hain aur teesra sawal un se rooh ki babat karo. Un ke in sawalon ke jawab mein yeh Surah nazil hui. Yeh bhi riwayat hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Zulqarnain ka qissa daryaft karne ko aayi thi. Toh aap ne unhein dekhte hi farmaya ke tum is liye aaye ho. Phir aap ne woh waqia bayan farmaya. Is mein hai ke woh ek Roomi naujawan tha isi ne Iskandariya banaya. Use ek farishta aasman tak chadha le gaya tha aur deewar tak le gaya tha us ne kuch logon ko dekha jin ke munh kutton jaise thay waghera. Lekin is mein bahut tool hai aur bekar hai aur za'f hai is ka marfoo hona sabit nahin. Dar-asal yeh Bani Israel ki riwayat hain. Ta'ajjub hai ke Imam Abu Zur'ah Razi jaise Allama-e-Zaman ne ise apni kitab Dalail-e-Nabuwwat mein mukammal warid kiya hai. Fi-al-waq'i yeh un jaise buzurg se toh ta'ajjub-khaiz cheez hi hai. Is mein jo hai ke yeh Roomi tha yeh bhi theek nahin. Iskandar-e-Sani albatta Roomi tha woh Qailis Mafzooni ka ladka hai jis se Room ki tareekh shuru hoti hai aur Iskandar-e-Awwal toh ba-qol Azraqi waghera Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke zamane mein tha. Us ne aap ke sath Baitullah Sharif ki bina ke baad tawaf-e-Baitullah kiya hai. Aap par iman laya tha, aap ka tabe-dar bana tha. Inhi ke wazir Hazrat Khizr (A.S / Alaihis Salam) thay. Aur Iskandar-e-Sani ka wazir Aristatalis mashhoor falsafi tha wallahu a'lam. Isi ne mamlikat-e-Room ki tareekh likhi yeh Hazrat Masih (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se taqreeban teen sau saal pehle tha aur Iskandar-e-Awwal jis ka zikr Quran-e-Kareem mein hai yeh Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke zamane mein tha jaise ke Azraqi waghera ne zikr kiya hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Baitullah banaya toh us ne aap ke sath tawaf kiya tha aur Allah ke naam bahut si qurbaniyan ki thin. Hum ne Allah ke fazl se un ke bahut se waqiat apni kitab Al-Bidayah wan-Nihayah mein zikr kar diye hain. Wahab kehte hain yeh badshah thay chunke un ke sar ke dono taraf tanba rehta tha is liye unhein Zulqarnain kaha gaya yeh wajah bhi batlai gayi hai ke yeh Room ka aur Fars ka dono ka badshah tha. Ba'az ka qaul hai ke fi-al-waq'i us ke sar ke dono taraf kuch seeng se thay. Hazrat Ali (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain is naam ki wajah yeh hai ke yeh Allah ke nek bande thay apni qoum ko Allah ki taraf bulaya yeh log mukhalif ho gaye aur un ke sar ke ek janib is qadar mara ke yeh shaheed ho gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein dobara zinda kar diya qoum ne phir sar ke dusri taraf isi qadar mara jis se yeh phir mar gaye is liye unhein Zulqarnain kaha jata hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke chunke yeh mashriq se maghrib ki taraf sayahat kar aaye thay is liye unhein Zulqarnain kaha gaya hai.

Hum ne use bari saltanat de rakhi thi. Saath hi quwwat-e-lashkar, aalaat-e-harb, sab kuch hi de rakha tha. Mashriq se maghrib tak us ki saltanat thi, Arab-o-Ajam sab us ke matahat thay. Har cheez ka use ilm de rakha tha. Zameen ke adna-o-aala nishanaat batla diye thay. Tamam zabanain jantay thay. Jis qoum se larai hoti us ki zaban bol letay thay. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H) se Hazrat Ameer Mu'awiyah (R.A) ne farmaya tha, kya tum kehtay ho ke Zulqarnain ne apne ghoray Surayya se bandhay thay? Unhon ne jawab diya ke agar aap yeh farmatay hain to suniye, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai hum ne use har cheez ka saman diya tha. Haqeeqat mein is baat mein haq Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ke saath hai, is liye bhi ke Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ko jo kuch kahin likha milta tha riwayat kar diya kartay thay go woh jhoot hi ho. Isi liye aap ne farmaya hai ke Ka'ab ka kazb to baara samne aa chuka hai, yani khud to jhoot nahin gharte thay lekin jo riwayat milti go be-sanad ho bayan karne se na chooktay. Aur yeh zahir hai ke Bani Israel ki riwayaat jhoot, khurafaat, tahreef, tabdeeli se mehfooz na thin. Baat yeh hai ke hamain in Israeli riwayat ki taraf iltifaat karne ki bhi kya zaroorat? Jab ke hamaray hathon mein Allah ki Kitab aur us ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sachi aur sahih ahadees majood hain. Afsos! Inhi Bani Israeli riwayaat ne bohat si burai musalmanon mein daal di aur fasaad phail gaya. Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne is Bani Israel ki riwayat ke suboot mein Quran ki is aayat ka aakhri hissa jo pesh kiya hai yeh bhi kuch theek nahin, kyunke yeh to bilkul zahir baat hai ke kisi insaan ko Allah Ta'ala ne aasmanon par aur Surayya par pohanchne ki taqat nahin di. Dekhiye, Bilqees ke haq mein bhi Quran ne yahi alfaaz kahe hain (وَاُوْتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّ لَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيْمٌ) (Surah An-Naml: 23). Woh har cheez di gayi thi, is se bhi murad sirf isi qadar hai ke badshahon ke haan umooman jo hota hai woh sab us ke paas bhi tha. Isi tarah Hazrat Zulqarnain ko Allah ne tamam raastay aur zaraye muhayya kar diye thay ke woh apni futoohat ko wus'at detay jayain aur zameen sarkashon aur kafiron se khali karate jayain aur us ki tauheed ke saath muwahhideen ki badshahat duniya par phailayain aur Allah walon ki hukoomat jamayain. In kamon mein jin asbaab ki zaroorat parti hai woh sab Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ne Hazrat Zulqarnain ko de rakhay thay, Wallahu A'alam. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se poocha jata hai ke yeh mashriq-o-maghrib tak kaisay pohanch gaye? Aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah. Allah Ta'ala ne badalon ko un ke liye musakhar kar diya tha aur tamam asbaab unhain muhayya kar diye thay aur poori quwwat-o-taqat de di thi.

Zulqarnain ka ta'aruf. Zulqarnain ek rah lag gaye, zameen ki ek simt yani maghribi janib kuch kar diya. Jo nishanat zameen par thay un ke saharay chal kharay huay. Jahan tak maghribi rukh chal saktay thay chaltay rahay yahan tak ke ab suraj ke ghuroob honay ki jagah tak pahunch gaye. Yeh yaad rahay ke is se murad aasman ka woh hissa nahin jahan suraj ghuroob hota hai kyunke wahan tak to kisi ka jana namumkin hai. Haan is rukh jahan tak zameen par jana mumkin hai, Hazrat Zulqarnain pahunch gaye. Aur yeh jo ba'az qissay mashhoor hain ke suraj ke ghuroob honay ki jagah se bhi aap tajawuz kar gaye aur suraj muddaton un ki pusht par ghuroob hota raha yeh be-bunyaad baatein hain aur umooman Ahl-e-Kitab ki khurafaat hain aur in mein se bhi bad-deeno ki gharat hain aur mehez darogh-e-be-farogh hain. Al-gharz jab intiha-e-maghrib ki simt pahunch gaye to yeh maloom hua ke goya bahr-e-muheet mein suraj ghuroob ho raha hai. Jo bhi kisi samundar ke kinaray khara ho kar suraj ko ghuroob hotay huay dekhay ga to bazahir yahi manzar us ke samnay hoga ke goya suraj pani mein doob raha hai. Halankeh suraj chauthay aasman par hai aur us se alag kabhi nahin hota. Hami'ah ya to mushtaq hai hama'ah se yani chikni mitti. Aayat-e-Qurani (Wa iz qala rabbuka lil-mala'ikati inni khliqum basharam min salsalim min hama'im masnoon) (15. Al-Hijr: 28) mein is ka bayan guzar chuka hai. Yahi matlab Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se sun kar Hazrat Nafi ne suna ke Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) farmatay thay tum hum se zyada Quran ke aalim ho lekin main to kitab mein dekhta hoon ke woh siyah rang mitti mein ghaib ho jata tha. Ek qira'at mein fi ain-e-hamiyah hai yani garam chashmay mein ghuroob hona paya. Yeh dono qira'atein mashhoor hain aur dono durust hain khwah koi si qira'at parhay aur un ke ma'ani mein bhi koi tafawat nahin kyunke suraj ki nazdiki ki wajah se pani garam ho aur wahan ki mitti ke siyah rang ki wajah se us ka pani keechar jaisa hi ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba suraj ko ghuroob hotay dekh kar farmaya Allah ki bharki aag mein agar Allah ke hukum se us ki sozish kam na ho jati to yeh to zameen ki tamam cheezon ko jhulas dalta. Is ki sehat mein nazar hai balkeh marfoo' honay mein bhi bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Abdullah bin Amr ka apna kalam ho aur un do thailon ki kitabon se liya gaya ho jo unhein Yarmook se milay thay, Wallahu A'alam. Ibn-e-Hatim mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan (R.A) ne Surah Kahf ki yahi aayat tilawat farmayi to aap ne (ain-e-hamiyah) parha, is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke hum to hami'ah parhtay hain. Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se poocha aap kis tarah parhtay hain unhon ne jawab diya jis tarah aap ne parha. Is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya mere ghar mein Quran-e-Kareem nazil hua hai. Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ke paas aadmi bheja ke batlao suraj kahan ghuroob hota hai? Taurat mein is ke mutaliq kuch hai? Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne jawab diya ke isay Arabiyat walon se poochna chahiye, wahi is ke pooray aalim hain.

Haan Taurat mein toh main yeh paata hoon ke woh paani aur mitti mein yaani keechad mein chhip jaata hai aur maghrib ki taraf apne haath se ishara kiya. Yeh sab qissa sun kar Ibn-e-Hazir ne kaha agar main us waqt hota toh aap ki ta'eed mein Tubba ke woh do sher padh deta jis mein us ne Zul-Qarnain ka zikr karte hue kaha hai ke woh mashriq-o-maghrib tak pahuncha kyunke Allah ke hukm ne use har qisam ke saamaan muhayya farmaye thay us ne dekha ke suraj siyah mitti jaise keechad mein ghuroob hota nazar aata hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne poocha is sher mein teen lafz hain khalb, sa'at aur harmad. In ke kya ma'ani hain? Mitti, keechad aur siyah. Usi waqt Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne apne ghulam se ya kisi aur shakhs se farmaya yeh jo kehte hain likh lo. Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se Surah Kahf ki tilawat Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne suni aur jab aap ne Hami'atin padha toh kaha ke Wallah jis tarah Taurat mein hai usi tarah padhte hue main ne aap hi ko suna Taurat mein bhi yahi hai ke woh siyah rang keechad mein doobta hai wahin ek shehar tha jo bahut bada tha us ke baarah hazaar darwaze thay agar wahan shor-o-ghul na ho toh kya ajab ke un logon ko suraj ke ghuroob hone ki aawaz tak aaye wahan ek bahut badi ummat ko aap ne basta hua paya. Allah Ta'ala ne is basti walon par bhi unhein ghalba diya ab un ke ikhtiyar mein tha ke yeh un par jabr-o-zulm karein ya un mein adl-o-insaf karein. Is par Zul-Qarnain ne apne adl-o-imaan ka suboot diya aur arz kiya ke jo apne kufr-o-shirk par ada rahe ga use toh hum saza denge qatl-o-gharat se ya yeh ke taanbe ke bartan ko garm aag kar ke us mein daal denge ke wahin us ka marinda ho jaye ga ya yeh ke sipahiyon ke hathon unhein badtareen sazayein karayenge Wallah A'alam. Aur phir jab woh apne Rab ki taraf lautaya jaye ga toh woh use sakht tar aur dardnaak azab kare ga. Is se Qayamat ke din ka bhi suboot hota hai. Aur jo imaan laye hamari tauheed ki dawat qabool kar le Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se dast-bardari kar le use Allah apne haan behtareen badla de ga aur khud hum bhi us ki izzat afzai karenge aur bhali baat kahenge.

Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se Surah Kahf ki tilawat Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne suni aur jab aap ne Hami'atin padha toh kaha ke Wallah jis tarah Taurat mein hai usi tarah padhte hue main ne aap hi ko suna Taurat mein bhi yahi hai ke woh siyah rang keechad mein doobta hai wahin ek shehar tha jo bahut bada tha us ke baarah hazaar darwaze thay agar wahan shor-o-ghul na ho toh kya ajab ke un logon ko suraj ke ghuroob hone ki aawaz tak aaye wahan ek bahut badi ummat ko aap ne basta hua paya. Allah Ta'ala ne is basti walon par bhi unhein ghalba diya ab un ke ikhtiyar mein tha ke yeh un par jabr-o-zulm karein ya un mein adl-o-insaf karein. Is par Zul-Qarnain ne apne adl-o-imaan ka suboot diya aur arz kiya ke jo apne kufr-o-shirk par ada rahe ga use toh hum saza denge qatl-o-gharat se ya yeh ke taanbe ke bartan ko garm aag kar ke us mein daal denge ke wahin us ka marinda ho jaye ga ya yeh ke sipahiyon ke hathon unhein badtareen sazayein karayenge Wallah A'alam. Aur phir jab woh apne Rab ki taraf lautaya jaye ga toh woh use sakht tar aur dardnaak azab kare ga. Is se Qayamat ke din ka bhi suboot hota hai. Aur jo imaan laye hamari tauheed ki dawat qabool kar le Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se dast-bardari kar le use Allah apne haan behtareen badla de ga aur khud hum bhi us ki izzat afzai karenge aur bhali baat kahenge.

Zulqarnain ka ta'aruf. Zulqarnain ek rah lag gaye, zameen ki ek simt yani maghribi janib kuch kar diya. Jo nishanat zameen par thay un ke saharay chal kharay huay. Jahan tak maghribi rukh chal saktay thay chaltay rahay yahan tak ke ab suraj ke ghuroob honay ki jagah tak pahunch gaye. Yeh yaad rahay ke is se murad aasman ka woh hissa nahin jahan suraj ghuroob hota hai kyunke wahan tak to kisi ka jana namumkin hai. Haan is rukh jahan tak zameen par jana mumkin hai, Hazrat Zulqarnain pahunch gaye. Aur yeh jo ba'az qissay mashhoor hain ke suraj ke ghuroob honay ki jagah se bhi aap tajawuz kar gaye aur suraj muddaton un ki pusht par ghuroob hota raha yeh be-bunyaad baatein hain aur umooman Ahl-e-Kitab ki khurafaat hain aur in mein se bhi bad-deeno ki gharat hain aur mehez darogh-e-be-farogh hain. Al-gharz jab intiha-e-maghrib ki simt pahunch gaye to yeh maloom hua ke goya bahr-e-muheet mein suraj ghuroob ho raha hai. Jo bhi kisi samundar ke kinaray khara ho kar suraj ko ghuroob hotay huay dekhay ga to bazahir yahi manzar us ke samnay hoga ke goya suraj pani mein doob raha hai. Halankeh suraj chauthay aasman par hai aur us se alag kabhi nahin hota. Hami'ah ya to mushtaq hai hama'ah se yani chikni mitti. Aayat-e-Qurani (Wa iz qala rabbuka lil-mala'ikati inni khliqum basharam min salsalim min hama'im masnoon) (15. Al-Hijr: 28) mein is ka bayan guzar chuka hai. Yahi matlab Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se sun kar Hazrat Nafi ne suna ke Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) farmatay thay tum hum se zyada Quran ke aalim ho lekin main to kitab mein dekhta hoon ke woh siyah rang mitti mein ghaib ho jata tha. Ek qira'at mein fi ain-e-hamiyah hai yani garam chashmay mein ghuroob hona paya. Yeh dono qira'atein mashhoor hain aur dono durust hain khwah koi si qira'at parhay aur un ke ma'ani mein bhi koi tafawat nahin kyunke suraj ki nazdiki ki wajah se pani garam ho aur wahan ki mitti ke siyah rang ki wajah se us ka pani keechar jaisa hi ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba suraj ko ghuroob hotay dekh kar farmaya Allah ki bharki aag mein agar Allah ke hukum se us ki sozish kam na ho jati to yeh to zameen ki tamam cheezon ko jhulas dalta. Is ki sehat mein nazar hai balkeh marfoo' honay mein bhi bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Abdullah bin Amr ka apna kalam ho aur un do thailon ki kitabon se liya gaya ho jo unhein Yarmook se milay thay, Wallahu A'alam. Ibn-e-Hatim mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan (R.A) ne Surah Kahf ki yahi aayat tilawat farmayi to aap ne (ain-e-hamiyah) parha, is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke hum to hami'ah parhtay hain. Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se poocha aap kis tarah parhtay hain unhon ne jawab diya jis tarah aap ne parha. Is par Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya mere ghar mein Quran-e-Kareem nazil hua hai. Hazrat Mu'awiyah (R.A) ne Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ke paas aadmi bheja ke batlao suraj kahan ghuroob hota hai? Taurat mein is ke mutaliq kuch hai? Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne jawab diya ke isay Arabiyat walon se poochna chahiye, wahi is ke pooray aalim hain.

Haan Taurat mein toh main yeh paata hoon ke woh paani aur mitti mein yaani keechad mein chhip jaata hai aur maghrib ki taraf apne haath se ishara kiya. Yeh sab qissa sun kar Ibn-e-Hazir ne kaha agar main us waqt hota toh aap ki ta'eed mein Tubba ke woh do sher padh deta jis mein us ne Zul-Qarnain ka zikr karte hue kaha hai ke woh mashriq-o-maghrib tak pahuncha kyunke Allah ke hukm ne use har qisam ke saamaan muhayya farmaye thay us ne dekha ke suraj siyah mitti jaise keechad mein ghuroob hota nazar aata hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne poocha is sher mein teen lafz hain khalb, sa'at aur harmad. In ke kya ma'ani hain? Mitti, keechad aur siyah. Usi waqt Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne apne ghulam se ya kisi aur shakhs se farmaya yeh jo kehte hain likh lo. Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se Surah Kahf ki tilawat Hazrat Ka'ab (R.H) ne suni aur jab aap ne Hami'atin padha toh kaha ke Wallah jis tarah Taurat mein hai usi tarah padhte hue main ne aap hi ko suna Taurat mein bhi yahi hai ke woh siyah rang keechad mein doobta hai wahin ek shehar tha jo bahut bada tha us ke baarah hazaar darwaze thay agar wahan shor-o-ghul na ho toh kya ajab ke un logon ko suraj ke ghuroob hone ki aawaz tak aaye wahan ek bahut badi ummat ko aap ne basta hua paya. Allah Ta'ala ne is basti walon par bhi unhein ghalba diya ab un ke ikhtiyar mein tha ke yeh un par jabr-o-zulm karein ya un mein adl-o-insaf karein. Is par Zul-Qarnain ne apne adl-o-imaan ka suboot diya aur arz kiya ke jo apne kufr-o-shirk par ada rahe ga use toh hum saza denge qatl-o-gharat se ya yeh ke taanbe ke bartan ko garm aag kar ke us mein daal denge ke wahin us ka marinda ho jaye ga ya yeh ke sipahiyon ke hathon unhein badtareen sazayein karayenge Wallah A'alam. Aur phir jab woh apne Rab ki taraf lautaya jaye ga toh woh use sakht tar aur dardnaak azab kare ga. Is se Qayamat ke din ka bhi suboot hota hai. Aur jo imaan laye hamari tauheed ki dawat qabool kar le Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se dast-bardari kar le use Allah apne haan behtareen badla de ga aur khud hum bhi us ki izzat afzai karenge aur bhali baat kahenge.

Ek wahshi basti. Zulqarnain maghrib se wapas mashriq ki taraf chale. Raaste mein jo qaumein miltein Allah ki ibadat aur uski tauheed ki unhein dawat dete. Agar woh qabool kar lete toh bahut achha warna un se ladai hoti aur Allah ke aur Allah ke fazl se woh haarte, aap unhein apna mat-hat kar ke wahan ke maal-o-maweshi aur khadim waghera le kar aage ko chalte. Bani Israel ki khabron mein hai ke yeh ek hazar chhe sau saal tak zinda rahe. Aur barabar zameen par Deen-e-Ilahi ki tableegh mein rahe saath hi badshahat bhi phailti rahi. Jab aap suraj nikalne ki jagah pahunche wahan dekha ke ek basti abad hai lekin wahan ke log bilkul neem-wahshi jaise hain. Na woh makanat banate hain na wahan koi darakht hai, suraj ki dhoop se panah dene wali koi cheez wahan unhein nazar na aayi. Un ke rang surkh thay, un ke qad past thay, aam khorak un ki machhli thi. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain suraj ke nikalne ke waqt woh pani mein chale jaya karte thay aur ghuroob hone ke baad janwaron ki tarah idhar udhar ho jaya karte thay. Qatada ka qaul hai ke wahan toh kuch ugta na tha, suraj ke nikalne ke waqt woh pani mein chale jate aur zawal ke baad door-daraz apni khetiyon waghera mein mashghool ho jate. Salma ka qaul hai ke un ke kaan bade bade thay, ek odh lete, ek bichha lete. Qatada (R.H) kehte hain yeh wahshi habshi thay. Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain ke wahan kabhi koi makan ya deewar ya ihata nahi bana, suraj ke nikalne ke waqt yeh log pani mein ghus jate, wahan koi pahad bhi nahin. Pehle kisi waqt un ke paas ek lashkar pahuncha toh unhon ne un se kaha dekho suraj nikalte waqt bahar nahin theharna, unhon ne kaha nahin hum toh raat hi raat yahan se chale jayenge lekin yeh toh batao ke yeh haddiyon ke chamkeele dher kaise hain? Unhon ne kaha yahan se pehle ek lashkar aaya tha, suraj ke nikalne ke waqt woh yahin thehra raha sab mar gaye yeh un ki haddiyan hain, yeh sunte hi woh wahan se wapas ho gaye. Phir farmata hai ke Zulqarnain ki, us ke sathiyon ki koi harkat, koi guftar aur raftar hum par posheeda na thi. Go us ka lao-lashkar bahut tha, zameen ke har hisse par phaila hua tha lekin hamara ilm zameen-o-aasman par haawi hai. Hum se koi cheez makhfi nahin.

Yajooj Majooj. Apne sharqi safar ko khatam karke phir Zulqarnain wahin mashriq ki taraf ek raah chale dekha ke do pahar hain jo mile hue hain lekin un ke darmiyan ek ghati hai jahan se Yajooj Majooj nikal kar turkon par tabahi dala karte hain unhein qatl karte hain khet baghat tabah karte hain baal bachon ko bhi halak karte hain aur sakht fasad barpa karte rehte hain. Yajooj Majooj bhi insaan hain jaise ke Bukhari Muslim ki hadith se sabit hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se farmaye ga ke Ae Adam! Aap labbaik-o-sa'daik ke sath jawab denge, hukm hoga aag ka hissa alag kar. Poochhenge kitna hissa? Hukm hoga har hazar mein se nau sau ninnanve dozakh mein aur ek jannat mein. Yehi woh waqt hoga ke bache boorhe ho jayenge aur har hamila ka haml gir jaye ga. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum mein do ummatein hain ke woh jin mein hon unhein kasrat ko pahuncha deti hain yani Yajooj Majooj. Imam Nawawi (R.H / Rahimahullah) ne Sharh Sahih Muslim mein ek ajeeb baat likhi hai woh likhte hain ke Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke khas pani ke chand qatre jo mitti mein gire the unhi se Yajooj Majooj paida kiye gaye hain goya woh Hazrat Hawwa aur Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki nasal se nahin balkay sirf nasal-e-Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se hain lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yeh qaul bilkul hi ghareeb hai na is par aqli daleel hai na naqli aur aisi baatein jo Ahl-e-Kitab se pahunchti hain woh manne ke qabil nahin hotin. Balkay un ke han ke aise qisse milawati aur banawati hote hain. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke Hazrat Nooh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke teen larke the Sam, Ham aur Yafis. Sam ki nasal se kul Arab hain aur Ham ki nasal se kul Habshi hain aur Yafis ki nasal se kul Turk hain. Ba'az ulama ka qaul hai ke Yajooj Majooj turkon ke is jadd-e-a'la Yafis ki hi aulad hain unhein Turk is liye kaha gaya hai ke unhein ba-wajah un ke fasad aur shararat ke insanon ki aur abadi ke pas-e-pusht paharon ki aar mein chhor diya gaya tha. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H / Rahimahullah) ne Zulqarnain ke safar ke mutaliq aur is deewar ke banane ke mutaliq aur Yajooj Majooj ke jismon un ki shaklon aur un ke kanon waghera ke mutaliq Wahab bin Munabbah se ek bahut lamba chora waqea apni tafsir mein bayan kiya hai jo alawa ajeeb-o-ghareeb hone ke sehat se door hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi aise bahut se waqeat darj hain lekin sab ghareeb aur ghair sahih hain. In paharon ke darre mein Zulqarnain ne insanon ki ek abadi payi jo ba-wajah duniya ke aur logon se doori ke aur un ki apni makhsoos zaban ke auron ki baat bhi taqreeban nahin samajh sakte the. In logon ne Zulqarnain ki quwwat-o-taqat aql-o-hunar ko dekh kar darkhwast ki ke agar aap razamand hon to hum aap ke liye bahut sa maal jama kar dein aur aap in paharon ke darmiyan ki ghati ko kisi mazboot deewar se band kar dein taake hum in fasadiyon ki rozmarra ki in takaleef se bach jayen. Is ke jawab mein Hazrat Zulqarnain ne farmaya mujhe tumhare maal ki zaroorat nahin Allah ka diya sab kuch mere paas majood hai aur woh tumhare maal se bahut behtar hai.

Yehi jawab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki taraf se Malika-e-Saba ke qasidon ko diya gaya tha. Zulqarnain ne apne is jawab ke baad farmaya ke haan tum apni quwwat-o-taqat aur kaam kaaj se mera saath do toh main tum mein aur un mein ek mazboot deewar khadi kar deta hoon. Zabar jama hai Zubrat ki. Zulqarnain farmate hain ke lohay ke tukray eenton ki tarah ke mere paas lao. Jab yeh tukray jama ho gaye toh aap ne deewar banani shuru kara di aur woh lambai chaudai mein itni ho gayi ke tamam jagah gher gayi aur pahar ki choti ke barabar pahunch gayi. Is ke tool-o-arz aur motai ki naap mein bahut se mukhtalif aqwal hain. Jab yeh deewar bilkul ban gayi toh hukum diya ke ab is ke charon taraf aag bharkao, jab woh lohay ki deewar bilkul angaray jaisi surkh ho gayi toh hukum diya ke ab pighla hua tamba lao aur har taraf se is ke oopar baha do, chunancha yeh bhi kiya gaya, pas thandi ho kar yeh deewar bahut mazboot aur pukhta ho gayi aur dekhne mein aisi maloom hone lagi jaise koi dhari-dar chadar ho. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A ne Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke main ne woh deewar dekhi hai, aap ne farmaya kaisi hai? Us ne kaha dhari-dar chadar jaisi hai jis mein surkh-o-siyah dhariyan hain, toh aap ne farmaya theek hai lekin yeh riwayat mursal hai. Khalifa Wasiq ne apne zamane mein apne amiron ko ek wafar lashkar aur bahut sa saman de kar rawana kiya tha ke woh is deewar ki khabar layein, yeh lashkar do saal se zyada safar mein raha aur mulk dar mulk phirta hua aakhir is deewar tak pahuncha, dekha ke lohay aur tambay ki deewar hai, is mein ek bahut bada nihayat pukhta azeem-ush-shan darwaza bhi isi ka hai jis par manon ke wazni qufl lagay hue hain aur jo maal-o-masala deewar ka bacha hua hai woh wahin par ek burj mein rakha hua hai jahan pehra choki muqarrar hai. Deewar behad buland hai, kitni hi koshish ki jaye lekin is par charhna namumkin hai, is se mila hua pahariyon ka silsila dono taraf barabar chala gaya hai aur bhi bahut se ajaib-o-gharaib umoor dekhe jo unhon ne wapas aa kar Khalifa ki khidmat mein arz kiye.

Sam ki nasal se kul Arab hain aur Ham ki nasal se kul Habshi hain aur Yafis ki nasal se kul Turk hain. Ba'az ulama ka qaul hai ke Yajooj Majooj turkon ke is jadd-e-a'la Yafis ki hi aulad hain unhein Turk is liye kaha gaya hai ke unhein ba-wajah un ke fasad aur shararat ke insanon ki aur abadi ke pas-e-pusht paharon ki aar mein chhor diya gaya tha. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi aise bahut se waqeat darj hain lekin sab ghareeb aur ghair sahih hain. In paharon ke darre mein Zulqarnain ne insanon ki ek abadi payi jo ba-wajah duniya ke aur logon se doori ke aur un ki apni makhsoos zaban ke auron ki baat bhi taqreeban nahin samajh sakte the.
