Deewar banadi gayi. Is deewar par na toh charhne ki taqat Yajooj Majooj ko hai, na woh is mein koi soorakh karsakte hain ke wahan se nikal aayein. Choonke charhna ba-nisbat torne ke zyada aasaan hai isi liye charhne mein 'ma-istatau' ka lafz laye aur torne mein 'ma-istatau' ka lafz laye. Garz na toh woh charh kar aasakte hain na soorakh kar ke. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har roz Yajooj Majooj is deewar ko khodte hain yahan tak ke qareeb hota hai ke suraj ki shua un ko nazar aajayein, choonke din guzar jata hai, is liye un ke sardar ka hukum hota hai ke ab bas karo kal aakar tor denge lekin jab woh doosre din aate hain, toh use pehle din se zyada mazboot paate hain. Qayamat ke qareeb jab un ka nikalna Allah ko manzoor hoga toh yeh khodte hue jab deewar ko chhilke jaisi kardenge toh un ka sardar kahega ab chor do kal Insha'Allah ise tor dalenge, pas Insha'Allah keh lene ki barkat se doosre din jab woh aayenge toh jaisi chor gaye the, waisi hi payenge, foran gira denge aur bahar nikal parenge. Tamam pani chaat jayenge, log tang aakar qilon mein panah-guzin hojayenge. Yeh apne teer aasman ki taraf chalayenge aur misl khoon-aalood teeron ke un ki taraf lautaye jayenge toh yeh kahenge zameen wale sab dab gaye aasman walon par bhi hum ghalib aagaye, ab un ki gardanon mein giltiyan niklengi aur sab ke sab ba-hukum-e-Ilahi isi waba se halak kar diye jayenge. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai ke zameen ke janwaron ki khorak un ke jism-o-khoon honge jis se woh khoob mote taze hojayenge. Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) bhi ise laye hain aur farmaya hai yeh riwayat ghareeb hai siwaye is sanad ke mashhoor nahin. Is ki sanad bahut qawi hai lekin is ka matan nakarat se khali nahin. Is liye ke aayat ke zahiri alfaaz saaf hain ke na woh charh sakte hain na soorakh karsakte hain kyunke deewar, nihayat, mazboot, bahut pukhta aur sakht hai. Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H) se marwi hai ke Yajooj Majooj rozana ise chaat-te hain aur bilkul chhilke jaisi kardete hain phir kehte hain chalo kal tor denge, doosre din jo aate hain toh jaisi asal mein thi waisi hi paate hain, aakhri din woh ba-ilham-e-Ilahi jaate waqt Insha'Allah kahenge, doosre din jo aayenge toh jaisi chor gaye the, waisi hi payenge aur tor dalenge. Bahut mumkin hai ke inhi Ka'ab se Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne yeh baat suni ho phir bayan ki ho aur kisi rawi ko wahm hogaya ho aur us ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman samajh kar ise marfoo'an bayan kardiya ho, Wallahu A'alam. Yeh jo hum keh rahe hain is ki ta'eed is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) neend se bedaar hue, chehra mubarak surkh ho raha tha aur farmate jaate the.

La ilaha illallah, Arab ki kharabi ka waqt qareeb aa gaya, aaj Yajuj Majuj ki deewar mein itna soorakh ho gaya, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni ungliyon se halqa bana kar dikhaya. Is par Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), kya hum bhale logon ki maujoodgi mein bhi halak kar diye jayenge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Haan, jab khabees logon ki kasrat ho jaye. Yeh hadith bilkul sahih hai, Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai. Haan, Bukhari Sharif mein rawiyon ke zikr mein Hazrat Umm-e-Habiba (R.A) ka zikr nahin, Muslim mein hai aur bhi is ki sanad mein bahut si aisi baatein hain jo bahut hi kam payi gayi hain, maslan Zuhri ki riwayat Urwah se, halankeh yeh dono buzurg tabiyi hain aur chaar aurton ka aapas mein ek dusre se riwayat karna, phir charon auratein Sahabiya (R.A). Phir in mein bhi do Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ki ladkiyan aur do Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan (R.A). Bazzar mein yahi riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se bhi marwi hai. (Mutarjim kehta hai is takalluf ki aur in marfoo ahadith ke mutaliq is qaul ki zaroorat hi kya hai? Hum ayat-e-Qurani aur in sahih marfoo ahadith ke darmiyan bahut aasani se yeh tatbeeq de sakte hain ke koi aisa soorakh nahin kar sakte jis mein se nikal ayen. Patli kar dena ya halqe ke barabar soorakh kar dena aur baat hai, jo maqsood Zulqarnain ka is deewar ke banane se tha woh ba-fazl-e-Allah hasil hai ke na woh oopar se utar sakein na tod kar ya soorakh kar ke nikal sakein aur isi ki khabar ayat mein hai aur is ke khilaf koi hadith nahin. Wallahu A'lam, Mutarjim). Is deewar ko bana kar Zulqarnain itminan ka saans lete hain aur Allah ka shukr karte hain aur farmate hain ke logo! Yeh bhi Rabb ki rahmat hai ke us ne in shareeron ki shararat se makhlooq ko ab aman de diya. Haan, jab Allah ka wada aa jayega to is ka dher ho jayega. Yeh zameen-doz ho jayegi. Mazbooti kuch kaam na aayegi. Oontni ka kohan jab us ki peeth se mila hua ho to Arab mein use Naqata-e-Dakka kehte hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke samne pahad par Rabb ne tajalli ki to woh pahad zameen-doz ho gaya, wahan bhi lafz Ja'alahu Dakka hai. Pas qareeb-e-Qayamat yeh deewar pash-pash ho jayegi aur in ke nikalne ka rasta ban jayega. Allah ke wade atal hain, Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni hai. Is deewar ke toot-te hi yeh log nikal padenge aur logon mein ghus jayenge, apnon beganon ki tameez uth jayegi. Yeh waqia Dajjal ke aa jane ke baad Qayamat ke qayam se pehle hoga. Is ka poora bayan ayat (اِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَاْجُوْجُ وَمَاْجُوْجُ وَهُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنْسِلُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 96) ki tafseer mein aayega Insha'Allah. Is ke baad Soor phoonka jayega aur sab jama ho jayenge.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad yeh hai ke Qayamat ke din insaan jin sab khalt-malt ho jayenge. Bani Khuzara ke ek Sheikh ka bayan Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke jab jin insaan aapas mein guthm-gutha ho jayenge us waqt Iblees kahega ke main jata hoon maloom karta hoon ke yeh kya baat hai? Mashriq ki taraf bhagega lekin wahan farishton ki jamaton ko dekh kar ruk jayega aur laut kar Maghrib ko pahunchega, wahan bhi yahi rang dekh kar dayen bayen bhagega lekin charon taraf se farishton ka muhasra dekh kar na-umeed ho kar cheekh pukar shuru kar dega. Achanak use ek chhota sa rasta dikhayi dega, apni sari zurriyat ko le kar us mein chal padega. Aage ja kar dekhega ke Dozakh bhadak rahi hai. Ek darogha-e-Jahannam us se kahega ke aye moozi khabees! Kya Allah ne tera martaba nahin badhaya tha? Kya tu jannatiyon mein na tha? Yeh kahega aaj daant kyun karte ho? Aaj to chhutkare ka rasta batao main ibadat-e-Ilahi ke liye tayyar hoon agar hukum ho to itni aur aisi ibadat karoon ke roo-e-zameen par kisi ne na ki ho. Darogha farmayega Allah Ta'ala tere liye ek fareeza muqarrar karta hai. Woh khush ho kar kahega main us ke hukum ki baja-awari ke liye poori musta'idi se majood hoon. Hukum hoga ke yahi ke tum sab Jahannam mein chale jao. Ab yeh khabees hakka-bakka reh jayega, wahin farishta apne par se use aur us ki tamam zurriyat ko ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal dega. Jahannam unhein le kar aadobochegi aur ek martaba to woh jhulayegi ke tamam muqarrab farishte aur tamam Nabi Rasool ghutnon ke bal Allah ke samne aajizi mein gir padenge. Tabrani mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Yajuj Majuj Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki nasal se hain agar woh chhod diye jayen to duniya ki ma'ash mein fasaad daal dein, ek ek apne peeche hazar hazar balkay zyada chhod kar marta hai phir un ke siwa teen ummatein aur hain Taweel, Maris aur Mansak. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai balkay munkar aur za'eef hai. Nasai mein hai ke un ki biwiyan bachay ek ek apne peeche hazar hazar balkay zyada chhod kar marta hai. Phir farmaya Soor phoonk diya jayega jaise hadees mein hai ke woh ek qarn hai jis mein Soor phoonk diya jayega, phoonkne wale Hazrat Israfeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) honge. Jaise ke lambi hadees bayan ho chuki hai. Aur bhi bahut si hadees se is ka suboot hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main kaise chain aur aaram se baithoon? Soor ko munh se lagaye hue, peshani jhukaye hue, kaan lagaye hue, muntazir baitha hai ke kab hukum ho aur main phoonk doon. Logon ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir hum kya kahein? Farmaya (Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel, 'alallahi tawakkalna). Phir farmata hai hum sab ko hisab ke liye jama karenge, sab ka hashr hamare samne hoga jaise Surah Waqi'ah mein hai ke aglay pichlay sab ke sab muqarrara din ke waqt ikathay kiye jayenge aur aayat mein hai (Wa hasharnahum falam nughadir minhum ahada) (18. Al-Kahf: 47) hum sab ko jama karenge ek bhi to baqi na bachega.

Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai ke zameen ke janwaron ki khorak un ke jism-o-khoon honge jis se woh khoob mote taze hojayenge. Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) bhi ise laye hain aur farmaya hai yeh riwayat ghareeb hai siwaye is sanad ke mashhoor nahin. Is ki sanad bahut qawi hai lekin is ka matan nakarat se khali nahin. Is liye ke aayat ke zahiri alfaaz saaf hain ke na woh charh sakte hain na soorakh karsakte hain kyunke deewar, nihayat, mazboot, bahut pukhta aur sakht hai. Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H) se marwi hai ke Yajooj Majooj rozana ise chaat-te hain aur bilkul chhilke jaisi kardete hain phir kehte hain chalo kal tor denge, doosre din jo aate hain toh jaisi asal mein thi waisi hi paate hain, aakhri din woh ba-ilham-e-Ilahi jaate waqt Insha'Allah kahenge, doosre din jo aayenge toh jaisi chor gaye the, waisi hi payenge aur tor dalenge. Bahut mumkin hai ke inhi Ka'ab se Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne yeh baat suni ho phir bayan ki ho aur kisi rawi ko wahm hogaya ho aur us ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman samajh kar ise marfoo'an bayan kardiya ho, Wallahu A'alam. Yeh jo hum keh rahe hain is ki ta'eed is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) neend se bedaar hue, chehra mubarak surkh ho raha tha aur farmate jaate the.

La ilaha illallah, Arab ki kharabi ka waqt qareeb aa gaya, aaj Yajuj Majuj ki deewar mein itna soorakh ho gaya, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni ungliyon se halqa bana kar dikhaya. Is par Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab bint-e-Jahsh (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), kya hum bhale logon ki maujoodgi mein bhi halak kar diye jayenge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Haan, jab khabees logon ki kasrat ho jaye. Yeh hadith bilkul sahih hai, Bukhari Muslim dono mein hai. Haan, Bukhari Sharif mein rawiyon ke zikr mein Hazrat Umm-e-Habiba (R.A) ka zikr nahin, Muslim mein hai aur bhi is ki sanad mein bahut si aisi baatein hain jo bahut hi kam payi gayi hain, maslan Zuhri ki riwayat Urwah se, halankeh yeh dono buzurg tabiyi hain aur chaar aurton ka aapas mein ek dusre se riwayat karna, phir charon auratein Sahabiya (R.A). Phir in mein bhi do Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyon ki ladkiyan aur do Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwiyan (R.A). Bazzar mein yahi riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se bhi marwi hai. (Mutarjim kehta hai is takalluf ki aur in marfoo ahadith ke mutaliq is qaul ki zaroorat hi kya hai? Hum ayat-e-Qurani aur in sahih marfoo ahadith ke darmiyan bahut aasani se yeh tatbeeq de sakte hain ke koi aisa soorakh nahin kar sakte jis mein se nikal ayen. Patli kar dena ya halqe ke barabar soorakh kar dena aur baat hai, jo maqsood Zulqarnain ka is deewar ke banane se tha woh ba-fazl-e-Allah hasil hai ke na woh oopar se utar sakein na tod kar ya soorakh kar ke nikal sakein aur isi ki khabar ayat mein hai aur is ke khilaf koi hadith nahin. Wallahu A'lam, Mutarjim). Is deewar ko bana kar Zulqarnain itminan ka saans lete hain aur Allah ka shukr karte hain aur farmate hain ke logo! Yeh bhi Rabb ki rahmat hai ke us ne in shareeron ki shararat se makhlooq ko ab aman de diya. Haan, jab Allah ka wada aa jayega to is ka dher ho jayega. Yeh zameen-doz ho jayegi. Mazbooti kuch kaam na aayegi. Oontni ka kohan jab us ki peeth se mila hua ho to Arab mein use Naqata-e-Dakka kehte hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke samne pahad par Rabb ne tajalli ki to woh pahad zameen-doz ho gaya, wahan bhi lafz Ja'alahu Dakka hai. Pas qareeb-e-Qayamat yeh deewar pash-pash ho jayegi aur in ke nikalne ka rasta ban jayega. Allah ke wade atal hain, Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni hai. Is deewar ke toot-te hi yeh log nikal padenge aur logon mein ghus jayenge, apnon beganon ki tameez uth jayegi. Yeh waqia Dajjal ke aa jane ke baad Qayamat ke qayam se pehle hoga. Is ka poora bayan ayat (اِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَاْجُوْجُ وَمَاْجُوْجُ وَهُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنْسِلُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 96) ki tafseer mein aayega Insha'Allah. Is ke baad Soor phoonka jayega aur sab jama ho jayenge.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad yeh hai ke Qayamat ke din insaan jin sab khalt-malt ho jayenge. Bani Khuzara ke ek Sheikh ka bayan Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke jab jin insaan aapas mein guthm-gutha ho jayenge us waqt Iblees kahega ke main jata hoon maloom karta hoon ke yeh kya baat hai? Mashriq ki taraf bhagega lekin wahan farishton ki jamaton ko dekh kar ruk jayega aur laut kar Maghrib ko pahunchega, wahan bhi yahi rang dekh kar dayen bayen bhagega lekin charon taraf se farishton ka muhasra dekh kar na-umeed ho kar cheekh pukar shuru kar dega. Achanak use ek chhota sa rasta dikhayi dega, apni sari zurriyat ko le kar us mein chal padega. Aage ja kar dekhega ke Dozakh bhadak rahi hai. Ek darogha-e-Jahannam us se kahega ke aye moozi khabees! Kya Allah ne tera martaba nahin badhaya tha? Kya tu jannatiyon mein na tha? Yeh kahega aaj daant kyun karte ho? Aaj to chhutkare ka rasta batao main ibadat-e-Ilahi ke liye tayyar hoon agar hukum ho to itni aur aisi ibadat karoon ke roo-e-zameen par kisi ne na ki ho. Darogha farmayega Allah Ta'ala tere liye ek fareeza muqarrar karta hai. Woh khush ho kar kahega main us ke hukum ki baja-awari ke liye poori musta'idi se majood hoon. Hukum hoga ke yahi ke tum sab Jahannam mein chale jao. Ab yeh khabees hakka-bakka reh jayega, wahin farishta apne par se use aur us ki tamam zurriyat ko ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal dega. Jahannam unhein le kar aadobochegi aur ek martaba to woh jhulayegi ke tamam muqarrab farishte aur tamam Nabi Rasool ghutnon ke bal Allah ke samne aajizi mein gir padenge. Tabrani mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Yajuj Majuj Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki nasal se hain agar woh chhod diye jayen to duniya ki ma'ash mein fasaad daal dein, ek ek apne peeche hazar hazar balkay zyada chhod kar marta hai phir un ke siwa teen ummatein aur hain Taweel, Maris aur Mansak. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai balkay munkar aur za'eef hai. Nasai mein hai ke un ki biwiyan bachay ek ek apne peeche hazar hazar balkay zyada chhod kar marta hai. Phir farmaya Soor phoonk diya jayega jaise hadees mein hai ke woh ek qarn hai jis mein Soor phoonk diya jayega, phoonkne wale Hazrat Israfeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) honge. Jaise ke lambi hadees bayan ho chuki hai. Aur bhi bahut si hadees se is ka suboot hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main kaise chain aur aaram se baithoon? Soor ko munh se lagaye hue, peshani jhukaye hue, kaan lagaye hue, muntazir baitha hai ke kab hukum ho aur main phoonk doon. Logon ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir hum kya kahein? Farmaya (Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel, 'alallahi tawakkalna). Phir farmata hai hum sab ko hisab ke liye jama karenge, sab ka hashr hamare samne hoga jaise Surah Waqi'ah mein hai ke aglay pichlay sab ke sab muqarrara din ke waqt ikathay kiye jayenge aur aayat mein hai (Wa hasharnahum falam nughadir minhum ahada) (18. Al-Kahf: 47) hum sab ko jama karenge ek bhi to baqi na bachega.

Jahannam ko dekh kar. Kafir Jahannam mein jaane se pehle Jahannam ko aur us ke azab ko dekh lenge aur yeh yaqeen kar ke ke woh isi mein dakhil hone wale hain dakhil hone se pehle hi jalne-kadhne lagenge, gham-o-ranj, darr-o-khauf ke maare ghulne lagenge. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Jahannam ko Qayamat ke din ghaseet kar laya jayega jis ki sattar hazar lagamein hongi, har ek lagam par sattar-sattar hazar farishte honge. Yeh kafir duniya ki sari zindagi mein apni aankhon aur kanon ko bekar kiye baithe rahe, na haq dekha, na haq suna, na mana, na amal kiya. Shaitan ka sath diya aur Rahman ke zikr se ghaflat barti. Allah ke ahkam aur muman'at ko pas-e-pusht dale rahe. Yehi samajhte rahe ke un ke jhoote mabood hi unhein sare nafa pahunchayenge aur kul sakhtiyan door karenge. Mehez ghalat khayal hai, balkeh woh to un ki ibadat ke bhi munkir ho jayenge aur un ke dushman ban kar khade honge. Un kafiron ki manzil to Jahannam hi hai jo abhi se tayyar hai.

Ibadat-o-Ita'at ka tariqa. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) se unke sahibzade Mus'ab ne sawal kiya ke kya is ayat se murad Khariji hain? Aap ne farmaya nahin, balkeh murad is se Yahood-o-Nasara hain. Yahudiyon ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutlaya aur Nasraniyon ne Jannat ko saccha na jana aur kaha ke wahan khana peena kuch nahin. Kharijiyon ne Allah ke wade ko uski mazbooti ke baad tod diya. Pas Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) Kharijiyon ko fasiq kehte the. Hazrat Ali (R.A) waghera farmate hain is se murad Khariji hain. Matlab yeh hai ke jaise yeh ayat Yahood-o-Nasara waghera kuffar ko shamil hai, isi tarah Kharijiyon ka hukum bhi is mein hai kyunke ayat aam hai. Jo bhi Allah ki ibadat-o-ita'at us tariqe se baja laye jo tariqa Allah ko pasand nahin, toh go woh apne a'amal se khush ho aur samajh raha hai ke main ne aakhirat ka tosha bahut kuch jama kar liya hai, mere nek a'amal Allah ke pasandida hain aur mujhe un par ajr-o-sawab zaroor milega, lekin uska yeh guman ghalat hai. Uske a'amal maqbool nahin balkeh mardood hain aur woh ghalat guman shakhs hai. Ayat Makki hai aur zahir hai ke Makkah mein Yahood-o-Nasara mukhatib na the aur Kharijiyon ka toh us waqt tak wajood bhi na tha. Pas in buzurgon ka yahi matlab hai ke ayat ke aam alfaaz in sab ko aur in jaise aur sab ko shamil hain. Jaise Surah Ghashiyah mein hai ke Qayamat ke din bahut se chehre zaleel-o-khwar honge jo duniya mein bahut mehnat karne wale balkeh a'amal se thake hue the aur sakht takleefein uthaye hote the, aaj woh bawajood riyazat-o-ibadat ke Jahannam wasil honge aur bhadakti hui aag mein daal diye jayenge. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa qadimna ila ma amilu min amalin fa ja'alnahu haba'an mansura) (25. Al-Furqan: 23). Unke tamam kiye karaye a'amal ko hum ne aage badh kar raddi aur bekar raddi kar diya. Aur ayat mein hai kafiron ke a'amal ki misal aisi hi hai jaise koi pyasa ret ke tode ko pani ka dariya samajh raha ho lekin jab paas aata hai toh ek boond pani ki nahin pata. Yeh woh log hain jo apne taur par ibadat-o-riyazat toh karte rahe aur dil mein bhi samajhte rahe ke hum bahut kuch nekiyan kar rahe hain aur woh maqbool aur Allah ke pasandida hain, lekin chunke woh Allah ke bataye hue tariqon ke mutabiq na thin, Nabiyon ke farman ke mutabiq na thin, is liye bajaye maqbool hone ke mardood ho gayin aur bajaye mehboob hone ke mabghooz ho gayin. Is liye woh Allah ki ayaton ko jhutlate rahe, Allah ki wahdaniyat aur uske Rasool ki risalat ke tamam tar suboot unke samne the lekin unhon ne aankhein band kar lin aur mane hi nahin. Unka neki ka palra bilkul khali rahega. Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai Qayamat ke din ek mota taza bada bhari aadmi aayega lekin Allah ke nazdeek uska wazan ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi na hoga, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar tum chaho is ayat ki tilawat kar lo (Fala nuqimu lahum yaumal qiyamati wazna) (18. Al-Kahf: 105).

(Al-Kahf: 105) Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai bahut zyada khane peene wale mote taaze insaan ko Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne laya jayega lekin us ka wazan anaaj ke ek daane ke barabar bhi na hoga. Phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Bazzar mein hai ek Quraishi kafir apne hulle mein itrata hua Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saamne se guzra toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Buraidah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se farmaya yeh un mein se hai jin ka koi wazan Qayamat ke din Allah ke paas na hoga. Marfoo hadith ki tarah Hazrat Ka'ab ka qaul bhi marwi hai. Yeh badla hai un ke kufr ka, Allah ki aayaton ka aur us ke Rasoolon ko hansi mazaq mein urane ka. Aur un ke na maanne balkay unhein jhutlane ka.

Aur ayat mein hai (Wa qadimna ila ma amilu min amalin fa ja'alnahu haba'an mansura) (25. Al-Furqan: 23). Unke tamam kiye karaye a'amal ko hum ne aage badh kar raddi aur bekar raddi kar diya. Aur ayat mein hai kafiron ke a'amal ki misal aisi hi hai jaise koi pyasa ret ke tode ko pani ka dariya samajh raha ho lekin jab paas aata hai toh ek boond pani ki nahin pata. Yeh woh log hain jo apne taur par ibadat-o-riyazat toh karte rahe aur dil mein bhi samajhte rahe ke hum bahut kuch nekiyan kar rahe hain aur woh maqbool aur Allah ke pasandida hain, lekin chunke woh Allah ke bataye hue tariqon ke mutabiq na thin, Nabiyon ke farman ke mutabiq na thin, is liye bajaye maqbool hone ke mardood ho gayin aur bajaye mehboob hone ke mabghooz ho gayin. Is liye woh Allah ki ayaton ko jhutlate rahe, Allah ki wahdaniyat aur uske Rasool ki risalat ke tamam tar suboot unke samne the lekin unhon ne aankhein band kar lin aur mane hi nahin. Unka neki ka palra bilkul khali rahega. Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai Qayamat ke din ek mota taza bada bhari aadmi aayega lekin Allah ke nazdeek uska wazan ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi na hoga, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar tum chaho is ayat ki tilawat kar lo (Fala nuqimu lahum yaumal qiyamati wazna) (18. Al-Kahf: 105).

(Al-Kahf: 105) Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai bahut zyada khane peene wale mote taaze insaan ko Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne laya jayega lekin us ka wazan anaaj ke ek daane ke barabar bhi na hoga. Phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Bazzar mein hai ek Quraishi kafir apne hulle mein itrata hua Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saamne se guzra toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Buraidah (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se farmaya yeh un mein se hai jin ka koi wazan Qayamat ke din Allah ke paas na hoga. Marfoo hadith ki tarah Hazrat Ka'ab ka qaul bhi marwi hai. Yeh badla hai un ke kufr ka, Allah ki aayaton ka aur us ke Rasoolon ko hansi mazaq mein urane ka. Aur un ke na maanne balkay unhein jhutlane ka.

Ibadat-o-Ita'at ka tariqa. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) se unke sahibzade Mus'ab ne sawal kiya ke kya is ayat se murad Khariji hain? Aap ne farmaya nahin, balkeh murad is se Yahood-o-Nasara hain. Yahudiyon ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutlaya aur Nasraniyon ne Jannat ko saccha na jana aur kaha ke wahan khana peena kuch nahin. Kharijiyon ne Allah ke wade ko uski mazbooti ke baad tod diya. Pas Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) Kharijiyon ko fasiq kehte the. Hazrat Ali (R.A) waghera farmate hain is se murad Khariji hain. Matlab yeh hai ke jaise yeh ayat Yahood-o-Nasara waghera kuffar ko shamil hai, isi tarah Kharijiyon ka hukum bhi is mein hai kyunke ayat aam hai. Jo bhi Allah ki ibadat-o-ita'at us tariqe se baja laye jo tariqa Allah ko pasand nahin, toh go woh apne a'amal se khush ho aur samajh raha hai ke main ne aakhirat ka tosha bahut kuch jama kar liya hai, mere nek a'amal Allah ke pasandida hain aur mujhe un par ajr-o-sawab zaroor milega, lekin uska yeh guman ghalat hai. Uske a'amal maqbool nahin balkeh mardood hain aur woh ghalat guman shakhs hai. Ayat Makki hai aur zahir hai ke Makkah mein Yahood-o-Nasara mukhatib na the aur Kharijiyon ka toh us waqt tak wajood bhi na tha. Al-Kahf: 105).

(Al-Kahf: 105) Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai bahut zyada khane peene wale mote taaze insaan ko Qayamat ke din Allah ke saamne laya jayega lekin us ka wazan anaaj ke ek daane ke barabar bhi na hoga. Aur un ke na maanne balkay unhein jhutlane ka.

Jannat-ul-Firdous ka ta'aruf. Allah par imaan rakhne wale, us ke Rasoolon ko saccha manne wale, un ki baton par amal karne wale, behtareen jannaton mein honge. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Jannat-ul-Firdous ka sawal karo, yeh sab se aala, sab se umdah jannat hai, isi se aur jannaton ki nehrein behti hain. Yehi un ka mehman khana hogi. Yeh yahan hamesha ke liye rahenge. Na nikale jayen, na nikalne ka khayal aaye, na is se behtar koi aur jagah, woh wahan ke rehne se ghabrayen kyunke har tarah ke aala aish muhayya hain. Ek par ek rahmat mil rahi hai, roz-ba-roz raghbat-o-mohabbat, uns-o-ulfat barhti ja rahi hai, is liye na tabiyat uktati hai na dil bharta hai, balkay roz shauq barhta hai aur nayi ne'mat milti hai.

Ek par ek rahmat mil rahi hai, roz-ba-roz raghbat-o-mohabbat, uns-o-ulfat barhti ja rahi hai, is liye na tabiyat uktati hai na dil bharta hai, balkay roz shauq barhta hai aur nayi ne'mat milti hai.

Allah Ta'ala ki azmaton ka shumar namumkin. Hukm hota hai ke Allah ki azmat samjhane ke liye duniya mein elaan kar dijiye ke agar roo-e-zameen ke samundaron ki siyahi ban jaye aur phir Allah ke kalimaat, Allah ki qudraton ke izhaar, Allah ki baatein, Allah ki hikmatein likhni shuru ki jayen to yeh tamam siyahi khatam ho jayegi lekin Allah ki tareefein khatam na hongi. Go phir aise hi dariya laye jayen aur phir laye jayen aur phir laye jayen lekin namumkin ke Allah ki qudratain, uski hikmatein, uski daleelein khatam ho jayen. Chunancha Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ka farman hai (وَلَوْ اَنَّ مَا فِي الْاَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَـرَةٍ اَقْلَامٌ وَّالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهٗ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ سَبْعَةُ اَبْحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمٰتُ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ 27) (Surah Luqman: 27) yani roo-e-zameen ke darakhton ki qalmein ban jayen aur tamam samundaron ki siyahiyan ban jayen phir un ke baad saat samundar aur bhi laye jayen lekin namumkin hai ke kalimaat-e-Ilahi pooray likh liye jayen. Allah ki izzat aur hikmat, uska ghalba aur qudrat wahi jaanta hai. Tamam insanon ka ilm Allah ke ilmi muqablay mein utna bhi nahin jitna samundar ke muqablay mein qatra. Tamam darakhton ki qalmein ghis ghis kar khatam ho jayen, tamam samundaron ki siyahiyan nibar jayen lekin kalimaat-e-Ilahi waise hi reh jayenge jaise thay, woh anginat hain. Kaun hai? Jo Allah ki sahih aur poori qadr-o-izzat jaan sake? Kaun hai jo uski poori sana-o-sifat baja la sake? Beshak hamara Rabb waisa hi hai jaisa woh khud farma raha hai. Beshak hum jo tareefein uski karein woh un sab se siwa hai aur un sab se barh charh kar hai. Yaad rakho jis tarah saari zameen ke muqablay par ek rai ka dana hai isi tarah jannat ki aur aakhirat ki nematon ke muqabil tamam duniya ki nematein hain.

Sayyid-ul-Bashar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Hazrat Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan (R.A) ka farman hai ke yeh sab se aakhri aayat hai jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utri. Hukm hota hai ke aap logon se farmayein ke main tum jaisa hi ek insaan hoon, tum bhi insaan ho, agar mujhe jhoota jaante ho to lao is Quran jaisa ek Quran tum bhi bana kar pesh kar do. Dekho main koi ghaib-daan to nahin, tum ne mujh se Zulqarnain ka waqia daryaft kiya. Ashab-e-Kahf ka qissa poocha to main ne un ke sahih waqiat tumhare samne bayan kar diye jo nafs-ul-amr ke mutabiq hain, agar mere paas Allah ki wahi na aati to main in guzashta waqiat ko jis tarah woh hue hain tumhare samne kis tarah bayan kar sakta? Suno tamam-tar wahi ka khulasa yeh hai ke tum muwahhid ban jao, shirk ko chhor do. Meri dawat yahi hai, jo bhi tum mein se Allah se mil kar ajr-o-sawab lena chahta ho use shariat ke mutabiq amal karne chahiyein aur shirk se bilkul bachna chahiye. In dono arkaan ke baghair koi amal Allah ke haan qabil-e-qubool nahin, khuloos ho aur mutabiqat-e-sunnat ho. Ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya tha ke bahut se nek kamon mein bawajood marzi-e-Ilahi ki talash ke mera irada yeh bhi hota hai ke log meri neki dekhein to mere liye kya hukm hai? Aap khamosh rahe aur yeh aayat utri, yeh hadith mursal hai. Hazrat Ubadah bin Samit (R.A) se ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke ek shakhs namaz, roza, sadaqa, khairat, hajj, zakat karta hai, Allah ki razamandi bhi dhoondta hai aur logon mein nek-nami aur barai bhi. Aap ne farmaya is ki kul ibadat akarat hai, Allah Ta'ala shirk se bezar hai, jo is ki ibadat mein aur niyat bhi kare to Allah Ta'ala farma deta hai ke yeh sab isi dusre ko de do, mujhe is ki kisi cheez ki zaroorat nahin. Hazrat Saeed Khudri (R.A) ka bayan hai ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas bari-bari aate, raat guzarte, kabhi aap ko koi kaam hota to farma dete, aise log bahut zyada the. Ek shab hum aapas mein kuch baatein kar rahe the, Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye aur farmaya yeh kya khusar-phusar kar rahe ho? Hum ne jawab diya ya Rasool Allah hamari tauba hai, hum Maseeh Dajjal ka zikr kar rahe the aur dil hamare khaufzada the. Aap ne farmaya main tumhein is se bhi zyada dehshat-naak baat bataoon? Woh posheeda shirk hai ke insaan dusre insaan ko dikhane ke liye namaz parhe. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Ibn-e-Ghanam kehte hain main aur Hazrat Abu Darda Jabiyah ki masjid mein gaye, wahan hamein Hazrat Ubadah bin Samit (R.A) mile, baayein haath se to unhon ne mera dahina haath thaam liya aur apne dahine haath se Hazrat Abu Darda ka bayan haath thaam liya aur isi tarah hum teeno wahan se baatein karte hue nikle. Aap farmane lage dekho agar tum dono ya tum mein se jo bhi zinda raha to mumkin hai is waqt ko bhi woh dekh le ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se Quran seekha hua bhala aadmi, halal ko halal aur haram ko haram samajhne wala aur har hukm ko munasib jagah rakhne wala aaye aur is ki qadr-o-manzilat logon mein aisi ho jaisi murda gadhe ke sar ki.

Abhi yeh baatein ho rahi thin ke Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus (R.A) aur Hazrat Auf bin Malik aa gaye aur baithte hi Hazrat Shaddad (R.A) ne farmaya logon mujhe toh tum par sab se zyada is ka dar hai jo main ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai yani posheeda khwahish aur shirk ka. Is par Hazrat Ubada (R.A) ne farmaya Allah maaf farmaye hum se Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke is baat se Shaitan mayoos ho gaya hai ke is Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein us ki ibadat ki jaye. Haan posheeda shahwat toh yahi khwahish ki cheezein auratein waghera hain lekin yeh shirk hamari samajh mein toh nahin aaya jis se aap hamein dara rahe hain. Hazrat Shaddad (R.A) farmane lage achha batao toh ek aadmi dusron ke dikhane ke liye namaz roza sadqa khairat karta hai. Is ka hukum tumhare nazdeek kya hai? Kya us ne shirk kiya? Sab ne jawab diya beshak aisa shakhs mushrik hai, aap ne farmaya main ne khud Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke jo shakhs dikhawe ke liye namaz padhe woh mushrik hai jo duniya ko dikhane ke liye rozay rakhe woh mushrik hai jo logon mein apni sakhawat jatane ke liye sadqa khairat kare woh bhi mushrik hai is par Hazrat Auf bin Malik ne kaha kya yeh nahin ho sakta ke aise aamal mein jo Allah ke liye ho Allah usay qabool farma le aur jo dusre ke liye ho usay rad kar de? Hazrat Shaddad (R.A) ne jawab diya yeh hargiz nahin hone ka main ne Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hai ke main sab se behtar hissay wala hoon, jo bhi mere sath kisi amal mein dusre ko shareek kare main apna hissa bhi usi dusre ke supurd kar deta hoon. Aur nihayat be-parwahi se juz-o-kul sab ko chhod deta hoon aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus (R.A) ek din rone lage hum ne poocha Hazrat aap kaise ro rahe hain farmane lage ek hadith yaad aa gayi hai aur us ne rula diya. Main ne Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai mujhe apni ummat par sab se zyada dar shirk aur posheeda shahwat ka hai. Main ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya aap ki ummat aap ke baad shirk karegi? Aap ne farmaya haan suno woh chand patthar but ko na pooje gi balkay apne aamal mein riyakari kare gi. Posheeda shahwat yeh hai ke subah rozay se hai aur koi khwahish samne aayi roza chhod diya (Ibn Majah, Musnad-e-Ahmad). Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai main tamam shareekon se behtar hoon. Mere sath jo bhi kisi ko mila le main us se bari hoon aur us ka woh poora amal us ghair ke liye hi hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai mujhe tumhari nisbat sab se zyada dar chhotay shirk ka hai logon ne poocha woh chhota shirk kya hai? Farmaya riyakari. Qayamat ke din riyakaron ko jawab mile ga ke jao jin ke liye amal kiye thay unhi ke paas jaza mango.

Dekho paate bhi ho? Abu Saeed bin Abu Fuzala Ansari Sahabi (R.A) se riwayat hai farmate hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna ke jab Allah Ta'ala tamam aglon pichlon ko jama karega jis din ke aane mein koi shak shuba nahin us din ek pukarne wala pukarega ke jis ne apne jis amal mein Allah ke sath dusre ko milaya ho use chahiye ke apne is amal ka badla is dusre se maang le kyunke Allah Ta'ala sajhe se bahut hi be-niyaz hai. Abu Bakr (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai riyakar ko azab bhi sab ko dikha kar hoga aur nek aamal logon ko sunane wale ko azab bhi sab ko suna kar hoga (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) se bhi yeh riwayat marwi hai. Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai apne nek aamal uchalne wale ko Allah Ta'ala zaroor ruswa karega us ke akhlaq bigad jayenge aur woh logon ki nigahon mein haqeer-o-zaleel hoga. Yeh bayan farma kar Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) rone lage (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Anas (R.A) rawi hain ke Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Qayamat ke din insan ke nek aamal ke mohar shuda saheefay Allah ke samne pesh honge. Janab-e-Bari Azza-o-Jal farmayega ise phenk do, ise qabool karo, ise qabool karo, ise phenk do. Us waqt farishtay arz karenge ke Aye Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala jahan tak hamara ilm hai hum to is shakhs ke aamal nek hi jante hain. Jawab milega ke jin ko main phenkwa raha hoon yeh woh aamal hain jin mein sirf meri hi razamandi matloob na thi balkay un ki riyakari thi. Aaj main to sirf un aamal ko qabool karunga jo sirf mere liye hi kiye gaye hon (Bazzar). Irshad hai ke jo dikhawe sunawe ke liye khada hua ho woh jab tak na baithe Allah ke gusse aur gazab mein hi rehta hai. Abu Ya'la ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs logon ke dekhte hue to thehar thehar kar achi kar ke namaz padhe aur tanhai mein buri tarah jaldi jaldi be-dili se ada kare us ne apne Parwardigar Azza-o-Jal ki tauheen ki. Pehle bayan ho chuka hai ke is ayat ko Hazrat Ameer Muawiyah (R.A) Quran ki akhri ayat batate hain lekin yeh qaul ishkal se khali nahin kyunke Surah Kahf poori ki poori Makkah Sharif mein nazil hui hai aur zahir hai ke is ke baad Madine mein barabar das saal tak Quran-e-Kareem utarta raha to bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Muawiyah (R.A) ka matlab yeh ho ke yeh ayat akhri hai yani kisi dusri ayat se mansookh nahin hui. Is mein jo hukm hai woh akhir tak badla nahin is ke baad koi aisi ayat nahin utri jis mein tabdeeli-o-taghayyur kare wallahu aalam. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith Hafiz Abu Bakr Bazzar (R.H) apni kitab mein laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke jo shakhs ayat (Man kana yarju) al-kh, ko raat ke waqt padhega Allah Ta'ala use itna bada noor ata farmayega jo Adan se Makkah Sharif tak pahunche.
